items.title_en: U-Statistics-Powered LLM Reasoning
items.title_zh: U-Statistics 驱动的 LLM 推理
items.abstract_en: Since its introduction by DeepSeek, group relative policy optimization (GRPO) has been widely adopted for training large reasoning models and agents, spurring a proliferation of its variants. Yet the group size, a crucial hyperparameter in these GRPO-type algorithms, remains largely chosen by trial and error. Exploiting the U-statistic structure of GRPO's policy gradient, we recast the selection of the group size as a classical statistical problem of variance ratio estimation. This problem is particularly challenging when the denominator of the ratio is small, rendering naive plug-in estimators unstable. To address this challenge, we propose a pessimistic ratio estimator that accounts for the denominator's estimation uncertainty. We characterise the statistical properties of this estimator across three sample-size regimes. Empirically, using %a jackknife-based pessimistic rule on synthetic tasks from Reasoning Gym and real-world benchmarks covering both mathematical reasoning and code generation, we show that our adaptive group size selection reduces the mean squared error of the resulting policy gradient and improves policy optimisation over fixed-group-size baselines, with modest additional computational cost.
items.abstract_zh: 自 DeepSeek 提出以来，组相对策略优化（GRPO）已被广泛用于训练大型推理模型和智能体，并催生大量变体。然而，这些 GRPO 类算法中的关键超参数——组大小，仍在很大程度上通过试错选择。利用 GRPO 策略梯度的 U 统计量结构，我们将组大小的选择重新表述为方差比估计的经典统计问题。当该比率的分母很小时，这个问题尤其具有挑战性，导致朴素的插入式估计器不稳定。为应对这一挑战，我们提出一种悲观比率估计器，计入分母的估计不确定性。我们刻画了该估计器在三种样本量情形下的统计性质。在实证上，使用基于 jackknife 的悲观规则，在 Reasoning Gym 的合成任务以及涵盖数学推理和代码生成的现实基准上，我们表明自适应组大小选择降低了所得策略梯度的均方误差，并在适度额外计算成本下改进了策略优化，优于固定组大小基线。

items.title_en: Escriba-OCR: A 1B Vision-Language Model for Error-Preserving Transcription of Handwritten Portuguese Essays
items.title_zh: Escriba-OCR：一个用于手写葡萄牙语作文保留错误转写的 1B 视觉语言模型
items.abstract_en: Feedback tools and research on learner writing need transcriptions of handwritten essays that keep exactly what the student wrote: misspellings, line breaks, struck-through words and insertions. Vision-language models (VLMs) read handwriting well, but they also tend to rewrite it into correct language. We measure this on BRESSAY, 1,000 handwritten Brazilian Portuguese essays, with a benchmark that adds error preservation, invented errors, edit-markup precision and recall and line structure to the character error rate (CER) and uses paired bootstrap confidence intervals. We restrict the study to open-weight models that schools can run on their own hardware. Of 22 open baselines, the best, Qwen3-VL 235B-A22B, reaches 5.6% CER on the 199 test pages; none reproduces the edit markup reliably, and every VLM replaces 39-78% of the words absent from a Portuguese dictionary with dictionary words. We fine-tune LightOnOCR-3-1B on the 647 training pages in 85 minutes on one GPU. The resulting Escriba-OCR-1B reaches 2.06% CER, 3.5 points below the best baseline (95% CI [-4.2, -2.9]); under the ICDAR 2024 competition metric it reaches 2.1% CER, below the best published page-level results (2.2-2.4%). It recovers 67% of insertions and 77% of illegible deletions, and reproduces the line structure of 97% of the pages, but still normalises 60% of likely misspellings. Three seeds agree within 0.04 CER points, and quantised to 4 bits the model runs on an ordinary CPU at about one minute per page. On 40 letters of another corpus it matches its base model (without that model's appended comments) but misreads unseen words more often; weight interpolation recovers half the gap. A teacher's review finds that 45% of the judgeable apparent corrections are errors in the BRESSAY ground truth, so dictionary-based scores likely understate preservation. We release the model, the benchmark code and the review data.
items.abstract_zh: 反馈工具和学习者写作研究需要对手写作文进行转写，且必须精确保留学生所写内容：拼写错误、换行、划掉词语和插入内容。视觉语言模型（VLM）能很好地阅读手写文本，但它们也倾向于将其改写为正确语言。我们在 BRESSAY（1,000 篇手写巴西葡萄牙语作文）上测量这一点，所用基准在字符错误率（CER）之外增加了错误保留、虚构错误、编辑标记精确率和召回率以及行结构，并使用配对 bootstrap 置信区间。我们将研究限制在学校可在自有硬件上运行的开放权重模型。在 22 个开放基线中，最佳的 Qwen3-VL 235B-A22B 在 199 个测试页面上达到 5.6% CER；没有一个能可靠复现编辑标记，而且每个 VLM 都会把葡萄牙语词典中不存在的单词中的 39–78% 替换为词典词。我们在 647 个训练页面上微调 LightOnOCR-3-1B，在一块 GPU 上耗时 85 分钟。所得 Escriba-OCR-1B 达到 2.06% CER，比最佳基线低 3.5 个百分点（95% CI [-4.2, -2.9]）；在 ICDAR 2024 竞赛指标下，它达到 2.1% CER，低于最佳已发表页面级结果（2.2–2.4%）。它恢复了 67% 的插入和 77% 的不可辨认删除，并复现了 97% 页面的行结构，但仍将 60% 的可能拼写错误正常化。三个随机种子在 0.04 CER 点内一致，量化为 4 比特后，模型在普通 CPU 上以每页约一分钟运行。在另一语料的 40 封信件上，它与基座模型匹配（不含该模型附加的评论），但更常误读未见词；权重插值恢复了一半差距。教师审查发现，在可判断的表观更正中有 45% 是 BRESSAY 真值中的错误，因此基于词典的分数可能低估了保留程度。我们发布模型、基准代码和审查数据。

items.title_en: Atomic Policy: Composing Atomic Manipulation Skills with Agentic Reasoning
items.title_zh: Atomic Policy：利用智能体推理组合原子操作技能
items.abstract_en: Long-horizon manipulation requires robots to translate task intent into physical interactions as the scene changes. Vision-language models (VLMs) offer semantic and spatial reasoning, while visuomotor policies provide fine-grained control. Yet ambiguous goals and dependencies between actions make their integration challenging. We introduce Atomic Policy, a framework that composes learned manipulation skills through grounded steering and execution feedback. A VLM estimates the symbolic state and goal, and a PDDL solver constructs a skill plan. An agentic harness steers each skill through language, visual pointing, or both, and verifies its outcome to guide phase transitions and replanning. A common phase-level interface supports specialized policies and generalist action models. Experiments in simulation and on a real robot show how Atomic Policy improves task following and supports recovery in complex, long-horizon manipulation. Project page: https://aaronzkd.github.io/atomic-policy/
items.abstract_zh: 长时程操作要求机器人在场景变化时把任务意图转化为物理交互。视觉语言模型（VLM）提供语义和空间推理，而视觉运动策略提供细粒度控制。然而，模糊的目标和动作之间的依赖关系使其集成具有挑战性。我们提出 Atomic Policy，一个通过基于 grounding 的引导和执行反馈组合已学习操作技能的框架。VLM 估计符号状态和目标，PDDL 求解器构建技能计划。一个智能体式执行框架通过语言、视觉指向或两者来引导每个技能，并验证其结果以指导阶段转换和重新规划。一个通用的阶段级接口支持专用策略和通用动作模型。仿真和真实机器人实验表明，Atomic Policy 如何改进任务遵循，并支持复杂长时程操作中的恢复。项目页面：https://aaronzkd.github.io/atomic-policy/

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: Physicl Scenes: An Artist-created 3D Dataset for Learning Perception and Action
items.title_zh: Physicl Scenes：一个由艺术家创建、用于学习感知与动作的3D数据集
items.abstract_en: We present Physicl Scenes, a high-quality artist-created and curated dataset of 6,499 3D scenes spanning household rooms, public interiors, and outdoor spaces. The dataset combines detailed geometry, physically based materials, and carefully composed environments with object- and part-level semantic annotations, providing rich, joint supervision for visual and embodied learning. We demonstrate its value as training data across inverse rendering, 3D reconstruction, scene understanding, and mobile manipulation. Across these tasks, training state-of-the-art methods with our scenes improves performance over alternative synthetic datasets. In addition, we introduce a mobile manipulation benchmark, evaluating vision-language-action models performing physical pick and place in diverse 3D scenes with realistic layouts, and using our part annotations to also score where each object is grasped. Our dataset will be released publicly to facilitate research in visual and embodied AI.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出Physicl Scenes，这是一个高质量、由艺术家创建并整理的3D场景数据集，包含6,499个3D场景，涵盖家庭房间、公共室内空间和室外空间。该数据集结合了详细几何、基于物理的材质和精心构建的环境，并带有物体级和部件级语义标注，为视觉与具身学习提供丰富的联合监督。我们展示了其作为训练数据在逆渲染、3D重建、场景理解和移动操作中的价值。在这些任务上，用我们的场景训练最先进方法相比其他合成数据集提升了性能。此外，我们引入一个移动操作基准，评估视觉-语言-动作模型在具有真实布局的多样3D场景中执行物理抓取和放置，并使用我们的部件标注来评分每个物体被抓取的位置。我们的数据集将公开发布，以促进视觉与具身AI研究。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为三维与定位，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Neural competition predicts speech production advantages in congenital amusia
items.title_zh: 神经竞争预测先天性失歌症中的言语产生优势
items.abstract_en: Mental health research has traditionally been deficit-focused, and cognitive advantages in mental conditions have almost always been documented retrospectively. Here we propose and test an a priori pathway for predicting such advantages from a conditions impaired neural basis, neural competition and brain-mind associations. Using congenital amusia (CA), a neurodevelopmental disorder with a well-defined deficit in right frontotemporal circuit (FTC), as a model, we predicted that interhemispheric competition would release the left homologue from inhibition, conferring advantages in speech production. Two independent studies, multimodal neuroimaging and behavioral testing, confirmed this prediction: MRI revealed right FTC impairment alongside competitive-like benefits of the left FTC in CA; and CA showed speech production advantages with intact episodic memory and constrained music learning. These findings provide the first empirical demonstration that cognitive advantages can be predicted in advance and then verified, offering a principled, mechanism-based alternative to the deficit-focused paradigm.
items.abstract_zh: 心理健康研究传统上以缺陷为重点，而心理状况中的认知优势几乎总是被回顾性地记录。在这里，我们提出并检验一条先验路径，用于从某状况受损的神经基础、神经竞争和脑-心智关联来预测此类优势。以先天性失歌症（CA）——一种在右侧额颞回路（FTC）具有明确缺陷的神经发育障碍——为模型，我们预测半球间竞争会解除左侧同源结构的抑制，从而赋予言语产生优势。两项独立研究——多模态神经影像和行为测试——证实了这一预测：MRI显示CA中右侧FTC受损，同时左侧FTC表现出类似竞争性获益；CA表现出言语产生优势，且情景记忆完整、音乐学习受限。这些发现首次实证表明，认知优势可以事先预测并随后验证，为以缺陷为重点的范式提供了一种有原则的、基于机制的替代方案。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Geometric Control of Electronic Decoherence in a Chiral Spin-Orbit Coupled Helix
items.title_zh: 手性自旋-轨道耦合螺旋中电子退相干的几何控制
items.abstract_en: While chirality is known to impact chemical and optical properties of molecular systems, as well as their biological function, far less is known about its impact on quantum coherence. By considering a chiral helix as a paradigmatic model, we show that within the Born-Markov regime, changing the degree of helical twist can be used to modulate the electronic decoherence rate. Moderate to strong spin-orbit coupling between next-nearest-neighbor sites along the helix are shown to give rise to a strong dependence of the electronic decoherence rate on the degree of chirality. The effect of chirality on electronic decoherence rates is also seen to be strongly impacted by the spatial and temporal correlations between the local environmental fluctuations to which the local excitations along the helix are subject. Our results show that chirality can serve as a tunable design parameter for quantum engineering and highlight the importance role environmental correlations can play in determining how chirality affects electronic decoherence rates.
items.abstract_zh: 尽管已知手性会影响分子体系的化学和光学性质及其生物功能，但对其量子相干性的影响了解得少得多。通过将手性螺旋视为一个范式模型，我们表明在Born-Markov区域，改变螺旋扭转程度可用于调制电子退相干速率。沿螺旋的次近邻位点之间的中等至强自旋-轨道耦合会导致电子退相干速率对 chiral 程度产生强依赖。手性对电子退相干速率的影响还受到沿螺旋的局域激发所经历的局域环境涨落之间空间和时间相关性的强烈影响。我们的结果表明，手性可作为量子工程的可调设计参数，并突出环境相关性在决定手性如何影响电子退相干速率方面可发挥的重要作用。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生物建模与实验，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: QoS-Constrained Sum-Rate Maximization in RIS-Assisted Pinching-Antenna NOMA Systems
items.title_zh: RIS辅助的Pinching-Antenna NOMA系统中QoS约束下的和速率最大化
items.abstract_en: This paper investigates a two-user downlink non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) system jointly assisted by a single-waveguide pinching-antenna system (PASS) and a reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS). To maximize the achievable sum rate under quality-of-service (QoS) constraints, the pinching antenna (PA) positions, RIS phase shifts, and power allocation coefficients are jointly optimized. The resulting non-convex optimization problem is addressed using an alternating optimization (AO) framework, where power allocation is obtained in closed form, while RIS phase shifts and PA positions are optimized through majorization-minimization (MM) and sequential quadratic programming (SQP), respectively. Numerical results show that the proposed architecture achieves higher sum rates than conventional-antenna and PASS-only benchmarks. Moreover, the MM- and SQP-based optimization stages achieve performance comparable to semidefinite relaxation (SDR) and grid-based exhaustive search, respectively, while the AO algorithm exhibits rapid convergence.
items.abstract_zh: 本文研究一个由单波导Pinching-Antenna系统（PASS）和可重构智能表面（RIS）联合辅助的两用户下行非正交多址接入（NOMA）系统。为在服务质量（QoS）约束下最大化可达和速率，对Pinching天线（PA）位置、RIS相移和功率分配系数进行联合优化。由此产生的非凸优化问题采用交替优化（AO）框架处理，其中功率分配以闭式获得，而RIS相移和PA位置分别通过majorization-minimization（MM）和序列二次规划（SQP）优化。数值结果表明，所提架构相比传统天线和仅PASS基准实现更高的和速率。此外，基于MM和SQP的优化阶段分别达到与半定松弛（SDR）和基于网格的穷举搜索相当的性能，而AO算法表现出快速收敛。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Modelling Billingual Learning Through LLM Training: A Critical-Period Exploration
items.title_zh: 通过LLM训练建模双语学习：一项关键期探索
items.abstract_en: Critical-period accounts of second-language (L2) acquisition suggest that the ability to learn a new language may depend on how easily previously acquired first-language (L1) knowledge can be modified. This exploratory computational study extends a neural language-model approach to critical period effects by examining internal representations rather than behavior. A small two-layer GPT-2 model was trained on English and then on German (a relatively related L2) or Finnish (a relatively distant L2) through either Sequential training or Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC), which limits change in parameters important for English. Mean-pooled hidden states for 20 held-out probe sentences per language were compared with those of the English-only model using cosine similarity at the embedding layer and two transformer layers after one and two L2 epochs. English similarity remained high in the transformer layers but became negative in the embedding layer. L2 similarity increased in the transformer layers, and German and Finnish differed more in the second transformer layer than in the first. EWC reduced Fisher-weighted parameter drift by about 6% but changed transformer-layer similarity by less than .001. With one training run per condition, these findings are preliminary.
items.abstract_zh: 第二语言（L2）习得的关键期解释表明，学习一门新语言的能力可能取决于先前习得的第一语言（L1）知识有多容易被修改。这项探索性计算研究通过考察内部表征而非行为，将神经语言模型方法扩展到关键期效应。一个小型两层GPT-2模型先在英语上训练，然后通过顺序训练或弹性权重巩固（EWC）在德语（相对相关的L2）或芬兰语（相对疏远的L2）上训练；EWC限制对英语重要的参数发生变化。每种语言20个留出探针句的均值池化隐藏状态，在嵌入层以及两个Transformer层中，在一个和两个L2 epoch后与仅英语模型使用余弦相似度进行比较。英语相似度在Transformer层中保持较高，但在嵌入层中变为负值。L2相似度在Transformer层中增加，且德语和芬兰语在第二个Transformer层中的差异大于第一个Transformer层。EWC将Fisher加权参数漂移减少约6%，但使Transformer层相似度变化小于0.001。由于每种条件仅进行一次训练运行，这些发现是初步的。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: AirLeg: A Robust and Accurate Self-Supervised Visual-Inertial-Leg SLAM System
items.title_zh: AirLeg：一个稳健且准确的自监督视觉-惯性-腿部SLAM系统
items.abstract_en: Visual-inertial-leg (VIL) state estimation offers cost-effective localization for legged robots, adding only a camera to the onboard IMU and joint encoders. However, learning-based leg odometry is limited by its supervision: networks trained in simulation suffer from the sim-to-real gap, while real-world labels require costly sensors or inherit the errors of visual estimates. To address this, we present AirLeg, a self-supervised VIL SLAM system in which vision and leg proprioception improve each other from training to deployment. We pre-train the leg odometry network in simulation and adapt it to the robot without ground truth through imperative learning, where multi-sensor bundle adjustment uses the leg odometry to refine the visual map, which in turn supervises the network. During deployment, the fused estimates adapt the network online. To improve both localization and this supervision, a dual-window estimator fuses vision, IMU, and leg odometry, relates loaded feet to the visually reconstructed terrain through a deformation-aware constraint, and weights the constraints by variance component estimation. AirLeg completes all 17 GrandTour sequences with the lowest average error (0.19 m) among 19 methods. On a low-cost quadruped, it achieves the lowest drift (0.6%) with only 0.5 h of unlabeled data, in real time on an embedded computer.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-惯性-腿部（VIL）状态估计为腿式机器人提供了一种成本有效的定位方案，只需在机载IMU和关节编码器之外增加一个相机。然而，基于学习的腿部里程计受其监督限制：在仿真中训练的网络存在仿真到现实的差距，而真实世界标签需要昂贵传感器或继承视觉估计的误差。为解决这一点，我们提出AirLeg，一个自监督VIL SLAM系统，其中视觉和腿部本体感觉从训练到部署相互改进。我们在仿真中预训练腿部里程计网络，并通过imperative learning在无真值情况下将其适配到机器人；在imperative learning中，多传感器光束法平差使用腿部里程计来优化视觉地图，而视觉地图反过来监督网络。在部署期间，融合估计在线适配网络。为改进定位和这种监督，双窗口估计器融合视觉、IMU和腿部里程计，通过形变感知约束将承载脚与视觉重建地形关联，并通过方差分量估计对约束加权。AirLeg完成了全部17个GrandTour序列，在19种方法中具有最低平均误差（0.19 m）。在低成本四足机器人上，它仅用0.5小时未标注数据就实现了最低漂移（0.6%），并在嵌入式计算机上实时运行。

items.title_en: HARI4D: Hand-Articulation Aware 4D Reconstruction of Human-Object Interaction
items.title_zh: HARI4D：手部关节感知的人-物交互4D重建
items.abstract_en: Reasoning about human-object interaction from RGB cameras is important for gaming, VR environments, and robot learning. Yet 4D reconstruction from a monocular RGB camera is challenging, especially when articulated hands are involved. Prior full-body works neglect hands during reconstruction, causing them to penetrate into, or float from the object. We present HARI4D, a hand-articulation-aware method for reconstructing spatially and temporally consistent 4D human-object interaction from monocular RGB video. We introduce a history-aware object tracker that provides robust and stable tracking. Based on these tracks, we improve the interaction configuration through coarse-to-fine reasoning that follows the order of object manipulation: ReachNet first brings the full body and arms to the object during contact, and TouchNet then finalizes hand articulation according to temporal context and local object geometry. On ARCTIC, unseen in training, our method reduces the object error by 56% and improves hand contact F1 from 0.866 to 0.921 over prior art. Our method recovers accurate full body-object interaction with coherent hand articulations and applies to online videos. Our code and pretrained models will be released.
items.abstract_zh: 从RGB相机推理人物交互对游戏、VR环境和机器人学习很重要。然而，从单目RGB相机进行4D重建具有挑战性，尤其是涉及关节手时。先前全身工作重建时忽略手，导致手穿入物体或漂浮于物体外。我们提出HARI4D，一种手部关节感知方法，从单目RGB视频重建空间和时间一致的4D人物交互。我们引入历史感知物体跟踪器，提供稳健稳定跟踪。基于这些轨迹，我们通过由粗到细推理改进交互配置，遵循物体操作顺序：ReachNet首先在接触期间将全身和手臂带到物体处，TouchNet随后根据时间上下文和局部物体几何最终确定手部关节。在训练中未见的ARCTIC上，我们的方法相比先前技术将物体误差降低56%，并将手部接触F1从0.866提高到0.921。我们的方法恢复准确的全身体-物体交互，具有连贯手部关节，并适用于在线视频。代码和预训练模型将发布。

items.title_en: A conserved ubiquitin signalling module controls membrane raft integrity at the neuronal synapse
items.title_zh: 一个保守的泛素信号模块控制神经元突触处的膜筏完整性
items.abstract_en: Activity-dependent ubiquitination of synaptic proteins is one of the key contributors of synaptic plasticity, along with localized protein synthesis and ubiquitin-dependent protein turnover. Substantial changes in the protein composition occur in the postsynaptic density upon chronic activation or inhibition of primary neurons. Precisely how a large-scale regulation of ensembles of synaptic proteins occurs through the ubiquitin proteasome system remains unknown. MAGE-D1 is a highly conserved protein enriched in brain and its deletion in mice leads to a range of behavioral phenotypes including defects in learning, memory and a complete resistance to cocaine addiction. Here, we found that MAGE-D1 acts as a scaffold bridging the ubiquitin ligase Praja-1 and the deubiquitinase Usp7. This MAGE-D1 signalling module directly interacts with and regulates the levels of Brain acid-soluble protein-1 (BASP1) which is a key component and stabilizer of neuronal membrane rafts. Disruption of MAGE-D1 complex function or chemical inhibition of Usp7 in mice results in resistance to cocaine-induced locomotor sensitization accompanied by specific degradation of oligomeric BASP1 and other key synaptic proteins in the postsynaptic density of mice thalamus. As a result, loss of MAGE-D1 in differentiated neurons leads to a dramatic disorganization of neuronal membrane rafts and anomalies in the synaptic membrane protein landscape. Finally, we mapped the structural architecture of the human MAGE-D1/Praja-1/Usp7 complex revealing the basis for the scaffolding nature of MAGE-D1. In summary, we discovered a conserved synaptic ubiquitin signalling network mediated by a protein complex that localizes to the synapse and regulates structures of membrane rafts and actin cytoskeleton.
items.abstract_zh: 突触蛋白的活动依赖性泛素化是突触可塑性的关键贡献者之一，与局部蛋白质合成和泛素依赖性蛋白质周转一起发挥作用。原代神经元长期激活或抑制后，突触后致密区的蛋白质组成发生显著变化。泛素蛋白酶体系统究竟如何对突触蛋白集合进行大规模调控仍不清楚。MAGE-D1是一种在脑中富集的高度保守蛋白，其在小鼠中的缺失导致一系列行为表型，包括学习、记忆缺陷以及对可卡因成瘾的完全抵抗。在这里，我们发现MAGE-D1作为支架，桥接泛素连接酶Praja-1和去泛素化酶Usp7。该MAGE-D1信号模块直接相互作用并调控脑酸溶性蛋白1（BASP1）的水平，BASP1是神经元膜筏的关键组分和稳定因子。破坏MAGE-D1复合物功能或用化学方法抑制小鼠Usp7，会导致对可卡因诱导的运动敏化的抵抗，并伴随小鼠丘脑突触后致密区中寡聚BASP1及其他关键突触蛋白的特异性降解。因此，分化神经元中MAGE-D1的缺失导致神经元膜筏的显著解体以及突触膜蛋白格局的异常。最后，我们绘制了人MAGE-D1/Praja-1/Usp7复合物的结构架构，揭示了MAGE-D1支架性质的基础。总之，我们发现了一个保守的突触泛素信号网络，由定位于突触并调控膜筏和肌动蛋白细胞骨架结构的蛋白复合物介导。

items.title_en: A machine learning architecture for scaling of holographic quantum circuits
items.title_zh: 用于扩展全息量子电路的机器学习架构
items.abstract_en: We describe an architecture and workflow for learning and generalizing the syntax and parameters of holographic quantum circuits (HQCs), which are natural quantum circuit analogs of classical tensor networks. An HQC uses mid-circuit measurements and resets on a small subset of "physical" qubits whose measurement outcomes become correlated through coupling with a register of persistent "ancilla" qubits, analogous to the physical and bond indices of a tensor network. Hence, an HQC with fixed qubit resources can efficiently generate samples from a large quantum state, and adding qubits to the HQC ansatz has the effect of exponentially increasing the effective bond dimension. Our machine learning approach provides mechanisms for harnessing both features of HQCs by extrapolating the syntax (e.g., a sequence of gates, measurements, and resets) and parameters (e.g., the angles appearing in single-qubit rotations) from a dataset of HQCs to longer or more expressive HQCs. We demonstrate the methodology and its performance on an analytically solvable dataset formed by a vector-valued generalization of the W-state. Finally, we provide an outlook for usage of the methodology for scaling the effective bond dimensions of HQCs in quantum simulation.
items.abstract_zh: 我们描述一种用于学习和泛化全息量子电路（HQC）语法与参数的架构和工作流；HQC是经典张量网络的天然量子电路对应物。HQC在一小部分“物理”量子比特上使用线路中测量和重置，这些量子比特的测量结果通过与持续存在的“辅助”量子比特寄存器耦合而变得相关，类似于张量网络的物理指标和键指标。因此，具有固定量子比特资源的HQC能够高效地从大量子态生成样本，而向HQC拟设添加量子比特会产生指数增加有效键维度的效果。我们的机器学习方法提供机制，通过从HQC数据集外推语法（例如门、测量和重置序列）和参数（例如单量子比特旋转中出现的角度）到更长或更具表达力的HQC，来利用HQC的这两个特征。我们在一个由W态的向量值推广形成的可解析求解数据集上演示了该方法及其性能。最后，我们展望了该方法在量子模拟中用于扩展HQC有效键维度的用途。

items.title_en: Contrastive Proxy Forests: Completeness-Preserving Proxy Learning from Multimodal Records
items.title_zh: 对比代理森林：从多模态记录中进行完整性保持的代理学习
items.abstract_en: Proximal causal inference removes unmeasured confounding using two proxies of the confounder, an outcome-side W and a treatment-side Z. The proxies must satisfy exclusion restrictions and be complete, meaning that they reflect every aspect of the confounder. In practice, they are a few variables hand-picked from a structured table, even though clinical notes and physiological waveforms carry rich information about the confounder. Such records are too high-dimensional for a proximal estimator, and generic compression such as PCA may keep modality-specific variation (style) instead of the confounder, destroying completeness. Our key observation is that, under the proximal condition, the confounder is the only link between a treatment-side and an outcome-side modality beyond the covariates. Learning what they share therefore captures the confounder and filters out modality-specific style. Contrastive Proxy Forests (CPF) learns both proxies by contrasting the two modalities, given the covariates, on a separate unlabeled sample, and passes them to a proximal causal forest. This contrastive objective has an exact closed-form solution, ridge canonical correlation analysis. We prove that CPF preserves the exclusion restrictions exactly and that its proxies inherit the completeness of the raw records under conditions we characterize. Where style is strong, CPF lowers the error of conditional effects by 10-22% relative to PCA proxies, and on MIMIC-IV it is the only method whose point estimate of warfarin's effect on stroke falls inside the range of randomized trials.
items.abstract_zh: 近端因果推断使用混杂因素的两个代理变量（结果侧W和治疗侧Z）来消除未测量混杂。代理变量必须满足排除限制并且是完整的，这意味着它们反映混杂因素的每个方面。在实践中，它们是从结构化表格中手工挑选的少数变量，尽管临床笔记和生理波形携带关于混杂因素的丰富信息。此类记录对于近端估计器来说维度过高，而PCA等通用压缩可能保留模态特异性变异（风格）而不是混杂因素，从而破坏完整性。我们的关键观察是，在近端条件下，混杂因素是治疗侧模态和结果侧模态之间除协变量之外的唯一联系。因此，学习它们共享的内容可以捕获混杂因素并过滤掉模态特异性风格。对比代理森林（CPF）在给定协变量的情况下，在一个单独的无标签样本上通过对比两个模态来学习两个代理变量，并将它们传递给近端因果森林。该对比目标具有精确的闭式解，即岭典型相关分析。我们证明CPF精确保持排除限制，并且在我们刻画的条件之下，其代理变量继承原始记录的完整性。在风格较强的情况下，CPF相对于PCA代理将条件效应误差降低10-22%，并且在MIMIC-IV上，它是唯一一种华法林对卒中效应的点估计落在随机试验范围内的方法。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Bathys: Advancing Deep Search Agents
items.title_zh: Bathys：推进深度搜索智能体
items.abstract_en: Deep search is a critical capability for agents tackling complex, open-ended tasks, where solving a problem requires iterative information gathering, query reformulation, and evidence-based verification rather than a single retrieval step. To address these requirements, we present Bathys 9B and 27B deep search agents built around a training framework that spans verifiable question synthesis, post-training, and online reinforcement learning (RL) under context compression. Our high-quality data construction ensures both search depth and reliability: each clue is reformulated as an indirect reference requiring independent retrieval, and retained evidence chains enable verification that the clues jointly determine a unique answer. Curated trajectories underpin a pipeline of supervised fine-tuning (SFT), Kahneman-Tversky Optimization (KTO), and Compaction-Managed Group Sequence Policy Optimization (CM-GSPO): SFT provides a stable foundation for tool use over long horizons and query reformulation; KTO uses binary feedback on trajectories to improve the selection of answers grounded in evidence; CM-GSPO optimizes execution sub-trajectories with length-normalized likelihood ratios on the recorded rollout contexts and reweights sub-trajectory advantages to correct the extra weighting introduced by independently averaging sub-trajectory losses. Bathys 9B and 27B attain 66.51% and 80.49% on BrowseComp, respectively, under an evaluation protocol with trajectory self-verification and conditional retries.
items.abstract_zh: 深度搜索是智能体处理复杂、开放式任务的关键能力，在这些任务中，解决问题需要迭代的信息收集、查询重述和基于证据的验证，而不是单次检索步骤。为满足这些需求，我们提出Bathys 9B和27B深度搜索智能体，其围绕一个训练框架构建，涵盖可验证问题合成、后训练以及上下文压缩下的在线强化学习（RL）。我们的高质量数据构建确保了搜索深度和可靠性：每条线索被重述为需要独立检索的间接引用，保留的证据链能够验证这些线索共同确定唯一答案。精选轨迹支撑了监督微调（SFT）、Kahneman-Tversky优化（KTO）和压缩管理组序列策略优化（CM-GSPO）的流程：SFT为长时程工具使用和查询重述提供稳定基础；KTO利用轨迹上的二元反馈来改进基于证据的答案选择；CM-GSPO在记录的rollout上下文上使用长度归一化似然比优化执行子轨迹，并重新加权子轨迹优势，以纠正独立平均子轨迹损失所引入的额外加权。在带有轨迹自验证和条件重试的评估协议下，Bathys 9B和27B在BrowseComp上分别达到66.51%和80.49%。

items.title_en: Collision Rendering: GPU-Accelerated Trajectory Planning on Sparse Voxel Radiance Fields with Risk-Bounded Collision Checking
items.title_zh: 碰撞渲染：在稀疏体素辐射场上进行GPU加速轨迹规划，带风险有界碰撞检查
items.abstract_en: Although radiance fields provide detailed scene representations for robotics, they remain underexplored for trajectory planning, without a widely agreed-upon way to translate learned spatial primitives into reliable collision criteria. To bridge this gap, we introduce Collision Rendering, the first trajectory planning framework on sparse voxel radiance fields (SVR), which supports GPU-accelerated, risk-bounded collision checking and a differentiable collision cost. Our key insight is that the structured volumetric density of SVR allows its rendering pipeline to serve as a fast numerical approximator of collision probability. We approximate the robot with collision spheres and place a coinciding spherical camera at each sphere. Under a probabilistic collision model, we derive an upper bound on each sphere's maximum directional collision probability from the camera's rendering pipeline. Evaluating this bound on the GPU yields a modular collision checker that integrates with established sampling-based planners without an auxiliary geometric map or changes to the learned representation. We further compute a collision cost and its gradients from rendered opacities through the same pipeline, extending the framework to trajectory optimization. Experiments demonstrate millisecond collision checking time on a consumer-grade GPU and collision-free trajectories in all queries, outperforming other radiance field-based planners.
items.abstract_zh: 尽管辐射场为机器人学提供了详细的场景表示，但它们在轨迹规划中仍未得到充分探索，也没有一种广泛认可的方法将学习到的空间基元转化为可靠的碰撞准则。为弥合这一差距，我们引入Collision Rendering（碰撞渲染），这是首个在稀疏体素辐射场（SVR）上的轨迹规划框架，支持GPU加速、风险有界的碰撞检查以及可微碰撞代价。我们的关键洞见是，SVR的结构化体积密度使其渲染管线能够作为碰撞概率的快速数值近似器。我们用碰撞球近似机器人，并在每个球处放置一个重合的球形相机。在概率碰撞模型下，我们从相机的渲染管线推导出每个球最大方向碰撞概率的上界。在GPU上评估该上界可得到一个模块化碰撞检查器，它能够与已有的基于采样的规划器集成，而无需辅助几何地图或改变学习到的表示。我们进一步通过同一管线从渲染的不透明度计算碰撞代价及其梯度，将框架扩展到轨迹优化。实验表明，在消费级GPU上碰撞检查时间为毫秒级，并且在所有查询中均得到无碰撞轨迹，优于其他基于辐射场的规划器。

items.title_en: OmniHarness-RSI: Modality-Aware Harness Evolution for Omnimodal Understanding
items.title_zh: OmniHarness-RSI：面向全模态理解的模态感知 Harness 演化
items.abstract_en: Recent advances in harness-based recursive self-improvement (RSI) have improved video understanding by evolving executable agent workflows without updating foundation model parameters. However, extending this paradigm to omnimodal understanding remains challenging, as the heterogeneous and interdependent nature of multimodal perception and reasoning creates a complex evolution space, making targeted harness optimization difficult. To address these challenges, we propose OmniHarness-RSI, a modality-aware framework for evolving agent harnesses. Specifically, we factorize the evolution space into three capability dimensions: modality routing and collaboration, modality-aware evidence localization, and modality-specific perception. Based on this factorization, we construct a Factorized-Harness Agent integrating specialized perception experts and audio-video retrieval tools. We further introduce modality-guided harness evolution, which identifies deficiencies through structured modality-capability attribution and refines corresponding harness strategies through interactive code revisions and execution feedback. Validation-guided selection and held-out evaluation assess generalization within and across datasets. Experiments on WorldSense, Daily-Omni, and OmniVideoBench demonstrate test accuracy improvements of 8.86, 8.13, and 6.23 percentage points, respectively, consistently outperforming modality-agnostic RSI. The evolved harnesses also demonstrate cross-dataset transfer without adaptation, while reducing planner calls and viewed frames.
items.abstract_zh: 基于 harness 的递归自我改进（RSI）的最新进展通过演化可执行的智能体工作流，在不更新基础模型参数的情况下提升了视频理解。然而，将这一范式扩展到全模态理解仍然具有挑战性，因为多模态感知与推理的异质性和相互依赖性造成了复杂的演化空间，使得有针对性的 harness 优化变得困难。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 OmniHarness-RSI，一个用于演化智能体 harness 的模态感知框架。具体而言，我们将演化空间分解为三个能力维度：模态路由与协作、模态感知的证据定位以及模态特定感知。基于这一分解，我们构建了一个 Factorized-Harness Agent，集成专门的感知专家和音视频检索工具。我们进一步引入模态引导的 harness 演化，它通过结构化的模态-能力归因识别缺陷，并通过交互式代码修订和执行反馈来改进相应的 harness 策略。验证引导的选择和留出评估评估数据集内和跨数据集的泛化能力。在 WorldSense、Daily-Omni 和 OmniVideoBench 上的实验分别展示了 8.86、8.13 和 6.23 个百分点的测试准确率提升，持续优于模态无关的 RSI。演化后的 harness 还展示了无需适应的跨数据集迁移，同时减少了规划器调用次数和查看帧数。

items.title_en: Single-cell Morphological Mechanisms-of-Action Profiling using Nanowell Imaging Plates
items.title_zh: 利用纳米孔成像板进行单细胞形态学作用机制（MoA）分析
items.abstract_en: Mechanism-of-action (MoA) analysis is used in drug discovery to prioritize compounds that act through desired pathways while eliminating compounds associated with nonspecific or undesirable activity. Image cytometry provides a promising route for MoA inference by capturing high-dimensional cellular phenotypes at single-cell resolution, but conventional workflows remain limited by unreliable cell segmentation and dependence on human-engineered feature extraction. Here, we present a deep learning-based image cytometry workflow that confines single cells in nanowells to obtain uniformly framed, regularized single-cell images, enabling MoA inference directly from raw images without segmentation or human-engineered features. Using a nanowell-in-microwell platform, we treated cells with 21 chemotherapeutic compounds spanning 11 MoA classes across multiple doses and time points, generating more than 500,000 single-cell images for model training and validation. A ResNet-18 convolutional neural network trained on images annotated by known compound mechanism achieved 85% accuracy in MoA classification. When a second model was trained on compound identity rather than MoA, misclassification patterns frequently linked compounds with shared mechanisms, indicating that the model learned mechanism-level relationships directly from single-cell morphology, without those relationships being specified in advance. Together, these results establish regularized single-cell imaging in nanowells as a scalable and interpretable approach to image-based MoA classification that overcomes key limitations of segmentation-dependent feature analysis.
items.abstract_zh: 作用机制（MoA）分析在药物发现中用于优先选择通过目标通路起效的化合物，并剔除活性非特异或不良的化合物。图像细胞术通过捕获单细胞分辨率的高维细胞表型为 MoA 推断提供了有前景的途径，但传统流程受限于不可靠的细胞分割和对人工设计特征的依赖。本文提出一种基于深度学习的图像细胞术流程：将单细胞限制在纳米孔中，获得统一取景、规则化的单细胞图像，从而无需分割、也无需人工特征即可直接从原始图像推断 MoA。我们使用纳米孔置于微孔中的平台，用 21 种化疗化合物（涵盖 11 个 MoA 类别）在多个剂量和时间点处理细胞，产生超过 50 万张单细胞图像用于训练与验证。在按已知化合物机制标注的图像上训练的 ResNet-18 卷积神经网络，MoA 分类准确率达 85%。当第二个模型改为按化合物身份而非 MoA 训练时，其误分类模式常把机制相同的化合物归到一起，说明模型直接从单细胞形态中学到了机制层面的关系，而这些关系并未被事先指定。这些结果确立了纳米孔规则化单细胞成像作为一种可扩展、可解释的基于图像的 MoA 分类方法，克服了依赖分割的特征分析的关键局限。
items.highlight_zh: 纳米孔规则化单细胞成像，免分割直接预测药物机制
items.digest_zh:
1. 研究问题：药物研发早期需要判断一个化合物“怎么起作用”（Mechanism-of-Action, MoA），以便挑出走目标通路的分子、淘汰乱打一通的分子。拍照看细胞形态（图像细胞术）是可行思路，但传统流程要先做细胞分割、再人工设计特征，分割不准就全盘皆输。
2. 方法：作者把细胞关进纳米孔（nanowell），这样每个细胞都在统一位置、统一取景下被拍成规则化的单细胞图像，省掉了分割这一步；然后直接把原始单细胞图像喂给卷积网络，无需人工特征。实验用纳米孔嵌在微孔中的平台，处理 21 种化疗化合物、覆盖 11 个 MoA 类别、多剂量多时间点，共产生 50 多万张单细胞图像。
3. 结果：用已知机制标注训练的 ResNet-18 在 MoA 分类上达到 85% 准确率。更关键的是对照实验：当模型改为按“具体是哪个化合物”训练时，它的错误往往把机制相同的化合物混在一起——说明模型自己从形态里学到了机制层面的相似性，而不是被直接告知。
4. 为何重要：该方法把“可扩展”（孔阵列高通量成像）与“可解释”（模型自发按机制聚类）结合起来，去掉了分割这个脆弱环节，为药物筛选中的表型分析提供了一条更稳健的路线。

items.title_en: Temporal Soliton Waves in Modern Fiber Laser Systems
items.title_zh: 现代光纤激光系统中的时间孤子波
items.abstract_en: This chapter provides a comprehensive survey of temporal soliton-wave in modern fiber systems. Temporal soliton waves constitute a broad class of nonlinear localized structures in modern fiber laser systems, arising from different balances among dispersion, nonlinearity, gain, loss, spectral filtering, and various forms of cavity coupling. We review the underlying theory, basic experimental findings, and practical methods for the generation, real-time characterization, and active control of soliton families, with a particular focus on recent progress reported for mode-locked fiber-laser platforms. The families covered in the chapter include dissipative solitons, soliton molecules (bound states), and dispersion-managed solitons. For each species, we focus on the pulse energy, duration, stationary and breathing states, and emerging intelligent (machine-learning-assisted) control strategies.
items.abstract_zh: 本章对现代光纤系统中的时间孤子波进行了全面综述。时间孤子波构成了现代光纤激光系统中的一大类非线性局域结构，源于色散、非线性、增益、损耗、光谱滤波以及各种形式的腔耦合之间的不同平衡。我们回顾了孤子族的产生、实时表征和主动控制的基础理论、基本实验发现和实用方法，并特别关注锁模光纤激光器平台近期报道的进展。本章涵盖的孤子族包括耗散孤子、孤子分子（束缚态）和色散管理孤子。对于每种类型，我们重点关注脉冲能量、持续时间、稳态和呼吸态，以及新兴的智能（机器学习辅助）控制策略。

items.title_en: Not All Pairs Align: Caption-Guided Audio-Visual Contrastive Learning
items.title_zh: 并非所有配对都对齐：字幕引导的视听对比学习
items.abstract_en: We address the problem of learning audio-visual representations from co-occurring modalities. Multimodal contrastive learning typically assumes that paired observations provide shared views of the same underlying information. While this may be true for datasets collected in constrained environments, it does not always hold. For instance, co-occurring audio and visual signals can differ substantially in their content due to off-screen sounds. Nevertheless, standard contrastive objectives treat all paired samples as equally aligned. In this work, we propose Caption Guided Alignment Aware Loss (CGAAL), a model-agnostic objective that leverages modality-specific captions to estimate semantic agreement between audio and video. CGAAL uses these agreement scores to weight the contribution of each positive pair. A warm-up period and gradual thresholding strategy progressively introduce this alignment-aware training signal. We demonstrate the generality of CGAAL by applying it to three contrastive baselines, consistently improving their performance on audio-visual retrieval.
items.abstract_zh: 我们解决从共现模态中学习视听表示的问题。多模态对比学习通常假设配对观测提供了相同底层信息的共享视图。虽然对于在受限环境中收集的数据集来说这可能成立，但并非总是如此。例如，由于画外声音，共现的音频和视觉信号在内容上可能差异很大。尽管如此，标准对比目标将所有配对样本视为同等对齐。在这项工作中，我们提出字幕引导的对齐感知损失（Caption Guided Alignment Aware Loss, CGAAL），这是一种与模型无关的目标函数，利用模态特定的字幕来估计音频和视频之间的语义一致性。CGAAL 使用这些一致性分数对每个正对的贡献进行加权。预热期和渐进阈值策略逐步引入这种对齐感知的训练信号。我们通过将 CGAAL 应用于三个对比基线来证明其通用性，并持续提升了它们在视听检索上的性能。

items.title_en: When Ink Meets Pixel: Intent-Aware OCR with VLMs for Human-Corrected Financial Documents When Ink Meets Pixel: Intent-Aware OCR with VLMs for Human-Corrected Financial Documents
items.title_zh: 当墨迹遇见像素：面向人工校正金融文档的、基于 VLM 的意图感知 OCR
items.abstract_en: Human annotations on documents (such as arrows, carets, strikethroughs, and insertions) express corrective intent yet existing OCR and document understanding systems treat these marks as visual noise rather than semantic edit operations. We introduce intent-aware OCR, the task of generating corrected transcriptions by jointly reasoning over original document content and visual intent cues (handwritten or digital) that convey edit intent. To support this setting, we present DocIntent, a multimodal dataset of 1,600 financial documents with over 5,700 annotated visual intent cues, each paired with layout-aware, intent-resolved OCR targets. We further introduce IntentBench, a 216-document benchmark designed to evaluate model robustness under diverse real-world annotation conditions. Leveraging DocIntent, we fine-tune DocIntentOCR, a suite of 3B and 7B parameter vision-language models, under direct intent supervision on corrected transcriptions. On IntentBench, the fine-tuned 3B and 7B models achieve F1-scores of 0.81 and 0.83, respectively, substantially outperforming commercial closed-source (e.g., GPT-4.1 (0.626)), and open-source models (e.g., LLaMA-3.2-Vision-90B (0.50)) demonstrating that intent-aware supervision enables compact domain-specific models to outperform substantially larger general-purpose systems on this task. This work establishes intent-aware OCR as a novel human-in-the-loop document understanding task and provides foundational resources (dataset, benchmark, models) to advance research in interactive document processing.
items.abstract_zh: 文档上的人工标注（如箭头、插入符、删除线和插入内容）表达了校正意图，然而现有的 OCR 和文档理解系统将这些标记视为视觉噪声，而非语义编辑操作。我们引入意图感知 OCR，即通过联合推理原始文档内容和传达编辑意图的视觉意图线索（手写或数字）来生成校正后转录的任务。为支持这一设定，我们提出 DocIntent，一个包含 1,600 份金融文档、超过 5,700 个已标注视觉意图线索的多模态数据集，每个线索都配有布局感知、意图解析后的 OCR 目标。我们进一步引入 IntentBench，一个包含 216 份文档的基准，旨在评估模型在不同真实世界标注条件下的鲁棒性。利用 DocIntent，我们在校正后转录的直接意图监督下微调 DocIntentOCR，这是一套 3B 和 7B 参数的视觉语言模型。在 IntentBench 上，微调后的 3B 和 7B 模型分别达到 0.81 和 0.83 的 F1 分数，大幅优于商业闭源模型（例如 GPT-4.1 (0.626)）和开源模型（例如 LLaMA-3.2-Vision-90B (0.50)），表明意图感知监督使紧凑的领域特定模型在该任务上能够超越大得多的通用系统。这项工作将意图感知 OCR 确立为一种新颖的人在回路文档理解任务，并提供基础资源（数据集、基准、模型）以推进交互式文档处理研究。

items.title_en: AgentMoT: An Agentic Mixture-of-Transformers for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
items.title_zh: AgentMoT：用于端到端自动驾驶的智能体化 Transformer 混合模型
items.abstract_en: Driving models need to choose which capabilities to use and when to reconsider their decisions. We introduce AgentMoT, a Mixture-of-Transformers with built-in agent reasoning and system scheduling. Combinations of agent, world, and action experts form three jointly trained pathways for direct-action, vision-language-action, and world-action computation. The Router selects a native pathway, while the agent expert supplies reasoning and selects skills. Execution feedback raises wake-up requests, and the agent self-scheduler learns whether to reconsider the task decision or keep it. Mandatory requests invoke the agent directly. The relative-capability principle guides these choices by relating the benefit of additional computation or intervention to its cost. After open-loop initialization, dual-loop evolution trains the Router, agent, and self-scheduler from closed-loop experience while failure-driven updates refine skills and execution feedback. AgentMoT achieves state-of-the-art results on Bench2Drive v0.0.3 and v0.0.4, with 94.48/92.33 driving score and 85.45/82.73% success rate, respectively. With skills disabled, learned routing improves over the strongest fixed pathway by 1.79 driving-score points and 4.09 percentage points of success rate on v0.0.3. Ablation studies further show gains from closed-loop agent learning, two-view queries, and event-triggered wake-up.
items.abstract_zh: 驾驶模型需要选择使用哪些能力以及何时重新考虑其决策。我们引入 AgentMoT，一种内置智能体推理和系统调度的 Transformer 混合模型。智能体、世界和动作专家的组合形成了三条联合训练路径，分别用于直接动作、视觉-语言-动作和世界-动作计算。路由器选择一条原生路径，而智能体专家提供推理并选择技能。执行反馈会发出唤醒请求，智能体自调度器学习是重新考虑任务决策还是保持原决策。强制请求直接调用智能体。相对能力原则通过将额外计算或干预的收益与其成本相关联来指导这些选择。在开环初始化之后，双环演化从闭环经验中训练路由器、智能体和自调度器，同时失败驱动的更新会改进技能和执行反馈。AgentMoT 在 Bench2Drive v0.0.3 和 v0.0.4 上取得了最先进的结果，驾驶分数分别为 94.48/92.33，成功率为 85.45/82.73%。在禁用技能的情况下，学习到的路由在 v0.0.3 上比最强的固定路径提高了 1.79 个驾驶分数点和 4.09 个百分点的成功率。消融研究进一步显示了闭环智能体学习、双视图查询和事件触发唤醒带来的增益。

items.title_en: AnyPrune: Optimization-Free Pruning for Any Feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting Pipeline
items.title_zh: AnyPrune：面向任意前馈3D高斯泼溅流水线的免优化剪枝
items.abstract_en: Feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) pipelines reconstruct a scene from images in a single forward pass, representing it as real-time-renderable 3D Gaussians. However, the resulting representations contain far more Gaussians than are needed to render the scene faithfully, especially when there are many input views. This drastically increases memory and storage requirements. Existing pruning methods either require costly re-optimization, which defeats the purpose of a single forward pass, or rely on simple strategies that do not exploit all the available information. We present AnyPrune, a transformer-based, optimization-free pruning module designed to work on top of any feedforward 3DGS pipeline. To remove unnecessary Gaussians, AnyPrune learns and exploits pipeline-specific redundancy patterns through a short single-GPU training on the frozen target feedforward pipeline. AnyPrune achieves better rendering quality than existing optimization-free pruning methods in most settings and generalizes to unseen datasets, as shown through extensive experiments across multiple feedforward pipelines, datasets, and input view counts. It prunes a 1.6M-Gaussian field in about $5\,\mathrm{s}$ on a consumer GPU, faster than every method that merges Gaussians or re-optimizes the field. It can also be combined with the pruning built into feedforward pipelines, pruning further at moderate ratios while preserving or improving rendering quality. Finally, it can even suggest a scene-specific pruning ratio that retains most of the quality.
items.abstract_zh: 前馈3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）流水线通过一次前向传递从图像重建场景，将其表示为可实时渲染的3D高斯。然而，所得表示包含的高斯数量远多于忠实渲染场景所需，尤其当输入视图很多时。这大幅增加了内存和存储需求。现有剪枝方法要么需要昂贵的重新优化，违背了单次前向传递的目的，要么依赖未利用全部可用信息的简单策略。我们提出AnyPrune，一种基于Transformer的免优化剪枝模块，设计用于在任何前馈3DGS流水线之上工作。为移除不必要的高斯，AnyPrune通过在冻结的目标前馈流水线上进行短暂的单GPU训练，学习并利用流水线特定的冗余模式。AnyPrune在大多数设置下取得比现有免优化剪枝方法更好的渲染质量，并可泛化到未见数据集；这通过跨多个前馈流水线、数据集和输入视图数量的广泛实验得到展示。它在消费级GPU上约5秒内剪枝一个160万高斯场，比所有合并高斯或重新优化该场的方法都快。它还可以与前馈流水线内置的剪枝结合，以中等比例进一步剪枝，同时保持或改善渲染质量。最后，它甚至能建议一个场景特定的剪枝比例，保留大部分质量。

items.title_en: Continuous ex utero development of mouse zygotes to early organogenesis
items.title_zh: 小鼠受精卵体外连续发育至早期器官发生
items.abstract_en: In mammals, embryogenesis normally unfolds within the uterus, limiting direct access to the developmental processes that transform a zygote into an embryo with forming organs. Although mouse embryos can be cultured ex utero from early post-implantation stages to mid-gestation, continuous culture from the zygote into organogenesis has not been achieved. Through comparative single-cell transcriptomic and metabolomic analyses, here we discover aberrant BMP signaling and suboptimal metabolic support as barriers to continuous ex utero development. BMP inhibition, together with stage-specific optimization of the culture environment, enables mouse zygotes to progress through peri-implantation development, gastrulation, and into early organogenesis ex utero. Cultured embryos form major embryonic and extraembryonic lineages, establish body axes, and generate multiple organ primordia, while retaining developmental delays and molecular differences from in vivo embryos. By connecting developmental stages that have previously been cultured separately, this study provides an accessible platform for dissecting how early mammalian development progresses into organ formation and a reference for evaluating stem-cell-based embryo models.
items.abstract_zh: 在哺乳动物中，胚胎发生通常在子宫内展开，限制了对将受精卵转变为器官正在形成的胚胎的发育过程的直接观察。尽管小鼠胚胎可以在着床后早期阶段至妊娠中期进行体外培养，但从受精卵到器官发生的连续培养尚未实现。通过比较单细胞转录组和代谢组分析，我们发现异常BMP信号和次优代谢支持是体外连续发育的障碍。抑制BMP，连同对培养环境的阶段特异性优化，使小鼠受精卵能够在体外经过着床周围发育、原肠胚形成并进入早期器官发生。培养的胚胎形成主要胚胎和胚外谱系，建立体轴，并产生多个器官原基，同时保留与体内胚胎相比的发育延迟和分子差异。通过连接此前分别培养的发育阶段，本研究提供了一个可访问的平台，用于剖析早期哺乳动物发育如何进展到器官形成，并为评估基于干细胞的胚胎模型提供参考。

items.title_en: The other side of the saturation coin: an experiment to perform saturation of fluorescence spectroscopy in undergraduate laboratories
items.title_zh: 饱和的另一面：在本科实验室中开展荧光光谱饱和实验
items.abstract_en: This article presents an experimental study of saturation and hyperfine pumping effects observed in fluorescence spectra when two counter-propagating beams of light interact with an atomic vapor sample. The experiment focuses on the D2 transition of atomic 87Rb by measuring changes in fluorescence emission as a room-temperature cell is exposed to two counter propagating laser beams of nearly equal intensity. The setup is comparable in complexity to saturated absorption spectroscopy experiments commonly conducted in many undergraduate laboratories but offers the advantage of a complementary view of the atom-light interaction not often found in educational laboratories. The basic theory that is needed to interpret the spectra is also presented. First, an analysis of the timescales involved in these experiments is used to identify and discriminate between different physical processes that take place during the spectroscopic measurements, thus establishing the validity of a simple model based on Einstein's population equations. The solution of these equations is then used to calculate population surfaces that illustrate velocity-selection effects, providing an intuitive explanation of the origin of crossover and atomic resonances and the distinction between them. Both the experimental and theoretical components of this work are aimed at providing students with a thorough understanding of the interaction between electromagnetic radiation and an atomic vapor. Students with prior knowledge of laser optics, basic analog electronics, systems of coupled algebraic equations, introductory quantum mechanics, and basic atomic and statistical physics will be particularly well positioned to benefit from this presentation.
items.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一项实验研究，观察当两束反向传播的光与原子蒸气样品相互作用时，在荧光光谱中观察到的饱和与超精细泵浦效应。实验聚焦于原子87Rb的D2跃迁，通过测量室温样品池暴露于两束强度接近相等的反向传播激光束时荧光发射的变化。该装置的复杂度与许多本科实验室常进行的饱和吸收光谱实验相当，但具有提供教学实验室中不常见的原子-光相互作用互补视角的优势。文中还介绍了解释光谱所需的基本理论。首先，通过分析这些实验中涉及的时间尺度，识别并区分光谱测量期间发生的不同物理过程，从而确立基于爱因斯坦粒子数方程的简单模型的有效性。然后，利用这些方程的解计算展示速度选择效应的粒子数曲面，为交叉共振和原子共振的起源及二者区别提供直观解释。本工作的实验和理论部分均旨在使学生全面理解电磁辐射与原子蒸气之间的相互作用。具备激光光学、基础模拟电子学、耦合代数方程组、入门量子力学以及基础原子与统计物理知识的学生将尤其适合从本介绍中获益。

items.title_en: CriticJEPA: World Models Are Better Critics Than Optimizers
items.title_zh: CriticJEPA：世界模型是比优化器更好的评论器
items.abstract_en: Visual world models enable goal-directed planning by predicting action outcomes. Gradient-based planners optimize actions to lower predicted goal cost, but continued optimization can exploit prediction errors after execution stops improving. Comparing plans requires informative relative scores; improving them also requires reliable update directions. Exact-state execution reveals that a frozen hierarchical world model ranks goal-conditioned proposals even when its rankings among outputs of prolonged gradient search are uninformative. Effective planning pairs goal-directed candidates with predictions that distinguish their outcomes. We introduce CriticJEPA, which learns goal-conditioned flow proposals from reward-free trajectories and uses frozen rollouts to select among them at every hierarchy level. Forward selection forms a complete planner; short anchored updates refine candidates before selection. Across visual navigation and manipulation, CriticJEPA increases success at a fraction of the planning compute, transferring shared settings across independently trained models, hierarchy depths, and unseen tasks while keeping every world-model weight fixed.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉世界模型通过预测动作结果来实现目标导向规划。基于梯度的规划器优化动作以降低预测目标代价，但持续优化可能在执行不再改善后利用预测误差。比较计划需要信息丰富的相对分数；改进这些分数还需要可靠的更新方向。精确状态执行揭示，冻结的分层世界模型能够对目标条件提案进行排序，即使其对长时间梯度搜索输出的排序不具有信息性。有效规划将目标导向候选与能区分其结果的预测配对。我们提出CriticJEPA，它从无奖励轨迹中学习目标条件流提案，并使用冻结的展开在每个层级中对它们进行选择。前向选择构成完整规划器；短锚定更新在选择前细化候选。在视觉导航和操作中，CriticJEPA以一小部分规划计算提高成功率，在保持每个世界模型权重固定的同时，将共享设置迁移到独立训练的模型、层级深度和未见任务。

items.title_en: Scoring What Matters: Exact Feedback Reduction for Language Model Comparison
items.title_zh: 为重要内容评分：语言模型比较中的精确反馈缩减
items.abstract_en: Comparing language-model checkpoints requires estimating performance differences, yet evaluation pipelines can pay to score responses whose contributions cancel from those differences. We introduce Contrast-Aware Feedback Acquisition (CAFA), a sampler-agnostic method that identifies which scores a requested linear report needs before acquiring feedback. CAFA groups identical scoring inputs and aggregates their report coefficients, removing queries beyond ordinary caching while preserving the fully scored result. For a fixed response bank and an otherwise unrestricted scalar scorer, we characterize necessary and sufficient query sets for exact recovery of sample means, either alone or jointly with ordinary sample covariances. On controlled updates, CAFA removes 55.8% and 90.1% of the scoring inputs remaining after caching for Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct, respectively, averaged over four generation repetitions. Across three online group relative policy optimization (GRPO) trajectories, Independent Star sampling with CAFA achieves 46.1-51.3% lower recorded generation-plus-feedback cost than independent autoregressive sampling with caching at a common empirical precision threshold (RMS MCSE $\leq 0.04$). This is a post hoc comparison of completed runs on a fixed budget grid. All 504 evaluated report cells reproduce the fully scored means and covariances to numerical precision. We provide a modular implementation supporting existing response banks, versioned caches and external scorers.
items.abstract_zh: 比较语言模型检查点需要估计性能差异，但评估流水线可能花费代价去评分那些其贡献会从这些差异中抵消的响应。我们提出对比感知反馈获取（CAFA），一种与采样器无关的方法，在获取反馈之前识别所请求的线性报告需要哪些评分。CAFA对相同评分输入进行分组并聚合其报告系数，在保留完整评分结果的同时移除超出普通缓存的查询。对于固定响应库和除此之外不受限制的标量评分器，我们刻画了精确恢复样本均值所需的必要且充分查询集，无论是单独恢复还是与普通样本协方差联合恢复。在受控更新中，CAFA在四次生成重复上平均分别移除了Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct和SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct在缓存后剩余的55.8%和90.1%的评分输入。在三条在线组相对策略优化（GRPO）轨迹中，在共同的经验精度阈值（RMS MCSE ≤ 0.04）下，采用CAFA的Independent Star采样比带缓存的独立自回归采样实现了记录到的生成加反馈成本降低46.1-51.3%。这是对固定预算网格上已完成运行的事后比较。所有504个被评估的报告单元都以数值精度复现完整评分的均值和协方差。我们提供支持现有响应库、版本化缓存和外部评分器的模块化实现。

items.title_en: Confidently Lost: Silent Failure and Edge Deployment of Dense Visual SLAM under Photon Starvation
items.title_zh: 自信地迷失：光子饥饿下密集视觉SLAM的静默失败与边缘部署
items.abstract_en: Dense visual SLAM built on learned two-view geometry is evaluated in good light; in low light it fails silently. Two frames of 9-level quantized noise, no scene at all, give MASt3R-SLAM's network a cross-view geometric self-consistency of 0.936; a real dark frame pair gives 0.935. Starved of structure, the network invents the same geometry for both views and the system trusts the agreement: on a dark sequence it consumes 1,605 frames, emits 7 keyframes, rejects no factor-graph edges and reports full frame rate, while over 95% of the correspondences it accepts violate the ground-truth epipolar geometry. One inflated statistic is read by two subsystems against thresholds in opposite directions, so keyframing starves while relocalization accepts almost every candidate. The same statistic, read at keyframe-pair baselines, separates the confident collapse from working runs on the ETH3D dark sequences without ground truth or extra computation (in-sample). Low-light-adapted weights take tracked trajectories from 1/6 to 5/6, as does retuning two thresholds; neither yields accurate ones, because the adaptation withdraws confidence from wrong geometry rather than finding right geometry. Replayed on a Jetson AGX Orin carried by a legged robot, the mechanism's signature reproduces on the two darkest of four routes, and which of its faces appears varies with route geometry and sensor encoding. The network does not lose confidence in the dark; it manufactures it.
items.abstract_zh: 基于学习到的双视图几何构建的密集视觉SLAM是在良好光照下评估的；在低光照下，它会静默失败。两帧9级量化噪声、完全没有场景，使MASt3R-SLAM的网络得到0.936的跨视图几何自一致性；一对真实暗帧给出0.935。由于缺乏结构，网络为两个视图虚构出相同的几何，而系统信任这种一致性：在一段暗序列上，它消耗1605帧，输出7个关键帧，不拒绝任何因子图边，并报告满帧率，而其所接受对应关系中超过95%违反真值对极几何。一个被夸大的统计量被两个子系统以相反方向对照阈值读取，因此关键帧化挨饿，而重定位几乎接受每个候选。同一统计量在关键帧对基线上读取时，可在无真值或额外计算的情况下（样本内）将自信崩溃与ETH3D暗序列上的正常运行区分开。低光自适应权重将跟踪轨迹从1/6提升到5/6，重新调整两个阈值也能做到；两者都未产生准确轨迹，因为自适应是从错误几何中撤回置信度，而不是找到正确几何。在由腿式机器人携带的Jetson AGX Orin上重放时，该机制的签名在四条路线中最暗的两条上重现，而其哪一面出现随路线几何和传感器编码变化。网络在黑暗中并未失去置信度；它制造了置信度。

items.title_en: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
items.abstract_en: We present a method that achieves state-of-the-art results for synthesizing novel views of complex scenes by optimizing an underlying continuous volumetric scene function using a sparse set of input views. Our algorithm represents a scene using a fully-connected (non-convolutional) deep network, whose input is a single continuous 5D coordinate (spatial location $(x,y,z)$ and viewing direction $(θ, φ)$) and whose output is the volume density and view-dependent emitted radiance at that spatial location. We synthesize views by querying 5D coordinates along camera rays and use classic volume rendering techniques to project the output colors and densities into an image. Because volume rendering is naturally differentiable, the only input required to optimize our representation is a set of images with known camera poses. We describe how to effectively optimize neural radiance fields to render photorealistic novel views of scenes with complicated geometry and appearance, and demonstrate results that outperform prior work on neural rendering and view synthesis. View synthesis results are best viewed as videos, so we urge readers to view our supplementary video for convincing comparisons.

items.title_zh: NeRF：将场景表示为神经辐射场以进行视图合成
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种方法，通过使用稀疏的输入视图集合优化一个底层连续体积场景函数，在复杂场景的新视角合成上取得最先进的结果。我们的算法使用一个全连接（非卷积）深度网络表示场景，该网络的输入是单个连续 5D 坐标（空间位置 $(x,y,z)$ 和观察方向 $(θ, φ)$），输出是该空间位置处的体积密度和与视角相关的发射辐射。我们通过沿相机光线查询 5D 坐标来合成视图，并使用经典体渲染技术将输出的颜色和密度投影为图像。由于体渲染天然可微，优化我们的表示所需的唯一输入是一组具有已知相机位姿的图像。我们描述如何有效优化神经辐射场，以渲染具有复杂几何和外观的场景的照片级真实感新视角，并展示优于先前神经渲染和视图合成工作的结果。视图合成结果最好以视频形式观看，因此我们敦促读者观看我们的补充视频以进行有说服力的比较。

items.title_en: Benchmarking Protein Structure Tokenizers as Generation Targets for Language Models
items.title_zh: 将蛋白质结构分词器作为语言模型生成目标进行基准测试
items.abstract_en: Discrete structure tokenizers are the standard way to give a language model access to protein three-dimensional structure, yet they are selected on how accurately they can be read, their reconstruction fidelity, while the property that governs generation is how well a model can write them. We measure this property, writability, directly: holding the base model, data, recipe and compute fixed, we swap only the tokenizer and train the same 9B model to emit structure tokens residue by residue, over eight tokenizers, four compute budgets and three evaluation sets (96 cells). At 2B tokens final writability runs from TM 0.662 down to 0.378 under identical conditions, with five of the eight arms clearing the TM 0.5 mark at which a fold is usually called correct and three falling short of it. Neither codebook size nor reconstruction ceiling explains where an arm lands; the best and worst both use 8192 codewords. What does explain the spread is local structure preservation of the code space. In DPLM-2 a one-bit codeword error costs 0.019 TM where a random codeword costs 0.347, and the trained model's own errors are correspondingly local, at 0.51 of the random Hamming expectation; FoldToken4 fails both tests at the same codebook size and is 0.13 TM less writable. Three controls discipline how such a benchmark may be read. A same-recipe rerun puts the noise floor at $σ=0.0067$ TM, which collapses an apparent six-way ranking into four tiers. A reference-free geometry panel turns out to be nearly orthogonal to TM (Pearson $-0.58$), with the worst arm by TM producing the most physically valid backbones. And two pre-registered interventions are null for a reason the mechanism measurements reveal: the quantity they target saturates at 1.5B tokens while TM is still rising. All 131 evaluation cells, including raw generated token streams, are released.
items.abstract_zh: 离散结构分词器是让语言模型获取蛋白质三维结构的标准方式，然而它们的选择依据是其可被读取的准确程度，即重建保真度，而支配生成的属性是模型能多好地写出它们。我们直接测量这一属性——可写性：保持基础模型、数据、配方和计算固定，只替换分词器，并在八种分词器、四种计算预算和三个评测集（96 个单元）上，训练同一个 9B 模型逐残基输出结构 token。在 2B token 时，相同条件下最终可写性从 TM 0.662 降至 0.378，八个实验组中有五个超过通常判定折叠正确的 TM 0.5 阈值，三个未达到。码本大小和重建上限都不能解释某个实验组落在何处；最好和最差的两组都使用 8192 个码字。能够解释这种差异的是码空间的局部结构保持。在 DPLM-2 中，一个比特的码字错误代价为 0.019 TM，而随机码字代价为 0.347，训练模型自身的错误相应地也是局部的，为随机汉明期望的 0.51；FoldToken4 在相同码本大小下两项测试均失败，可写性低 0.13 TM。三项对照规范了应如何解读这样的基准。同配方重跑将噪声底设为 $σ=0.0067$ TM，这使一个看似六路的排名坍缩为四个层级。一个无参考几何评测面板结果与 TM 几乎正交（Pearson $-0.58$），其中按 TM 最差的实验组产生最物理有效的骨架。两项预注册干预为零结果，其原因由机制测量揭示：它们所针对的量在 1.5B token 时饱和，而 TM 仍在上升。全部 131 个评测单元，包括原始生成 token 流，均已发布。

items.title_en: Non-integer high harmonic generation from many-body nonadiabatic gating
items.title_zh: 来自多体非绝热门控的非整数高次谐波产生
items.abstract_en: High harmonic generation (HHG) in solids typically produces a rigid frequency comb locked to exact integer multiples of the drive photon energy. In strongly correlated materials, however, the light field can dynamically transform the electronic state on the timescale of harmonic generation itself, potentially violating this rule. Here, we report giant blueshifted, non-integer HHG in a cuprate Mott insulator Sr$_2$CuO$_3$ produced by mid-infrared excitations. Concurrent transient reflectivity measurements and time-dependent exact-diagonalization simulations of a driven Hubbard model support a many-body temporal gating mechanism that suppresses light emission on the trailing edge of the pulse, thereby blueshifting radiated harmonics in the frequency domain. Our findings establish HHG emission energy as a sensitive probe of quantum many-body dynamics and pave the way for exploration and manipulation of correlated electronic phases of matter with strong-field spectroscopy.
items.abstract_zh: 固体中的高次谐波产生（HHG）通常产生锁定在驱动光子能量精确整数倍的刚性频率梳。然而，在强关联材料中，光场可以在谐波产生本身的时间尺度上动态改变电子态，可能违反这一规则。这里，我们报道在中红外激发下于铜氧化物莫特绝缘体 Sr$_2$CuO$_3$ 中产生的巨大蓝移非整数 HHG。并行的瞬态反射率测量和对受驱 Hubbard 模型的含时精确对角化模拟支持一种多体时间门控机制，该机制抑制脉冲后沿的光发射，从而在频域中使辐射谐波蓝移。我们的发现将 HHG 发射能量确立为量子多体动力学的灵敏探针，并为利用强场光谱探索和操控物质的关联电子相铺平道路。

items.title_en: HDMark: Holographic Multi-Bit Model Watermarking for Intellectual Property Protection in Hyperdimensional Computing
items.title_zh: HDMark：用于超维计算中知识产权保护的全息多比特模型水印
items.abstract_en: Hyperdimensional computing (HDC) models deployed on edge hardware are valuable intellectual property that is easy to steal, since a trained classifier consolidates its learned knowledge into a compact set of class prototype hypervectors; yet protecting their ownership through watermarking remains largely unexplored. We present HDMark, the first model watermarking framework native to HDC, which encodes ownership in the same hyperdimensional algebra the model computes with. HDMark maps a multi-bit owner identity to secret quasi-orthogonal carriers, superimposes them holographically onto the trained class prototypes, and verifies ownership with a statistical test. Across four datasets and three HDC learning rules, HDMark leaves accuracy essentially unchanged and verifies a 64-bit identity in 99.8% of trials at p < 0.001. We derive closed-form expressions for prediction fidelity and bit recovery that match measurements within 0.4 pp mean absolute error. The watermark survives fine-tuning and low-bit quantization, while attempting to erase it through noise injection, pruning, or overwriting severely degrades model accuracy. We further identify a dimension-permutation attack specific to HDC, which reorders hypervector coordinates to evade verification without altering predictions, and counter it through encoder realignment. Finally, an AMD ZCU104 FPGA implementation confirms that HDMark adds no hardware overhead, remains bit-exact under aggressive undervolting, and stays verifiable under timing faults until the classifier itself fails.
items.abstract_zh: 部署在边缘硬件上的超维计算（HDC）模型是易于窃取的有价值知识产权，因为训练好的分类器将其学习到的知识整合为一组紧凑的类原型超向量；然而，通过水印保护其所有权在很大程度上仍未被探索。我们提出 HDMark，这是首个原生面向 HDC 的模型水印框架，它在模型计算所用的同一超维代数中编码所有权。HDMark 将多比特所有者身份映射为秘密准正交载波，将它们全息地叠加到训练好的类原型上，并用统计检验验证所有权。在四个数据集和三种 HDC 学习规则上，HDMark 使准确率基本不变，并在 p < 0.001 下于 99.8% 的试验中验证 64 比特身份。我们推导出预测保真度和比特恢复的闭式表达式，其与测量值的平均绝对误差在 0.4 个百分点以内。水印在微调和低位量化后仍存活，而试图通过噪声注入、剪枝或覆写来擦除它会严重降低模型准确率。我们进一步识别出一种 HDC 特有的维度置换攻击，该攻击重排超向量坐标以在不改变预测的情况下规避验证，并通过编码器重对齐加以对抗。最后，AMD ZCU104 FPGA 实现证实 HDMark 不增加硬件开销，在激进欠压下仍保持比特精确，并在时序故障下保持可验证，直到分类器本身失效。

items.title_en: ToolSmith: An Automatic Tool-Generation Framework for Multimodal Search Agents
items.title_zh: ToolSmith：面向多模态搜索代理的自动工具生成框架
items.abstract_en: Recent multimodal search agents use reasoning, vision, and live web search across many turns to answer questions beyond parametric knowledge by orchestrating a small library of hand-crafted search and visual tools. However, the library is laborious to create and maintain, and frozen when new query types, evidence formats, and failure modes are encountered in the wild. Human practitioners, by contrast, cope with insufficient tools by fashioning new ones from familiar parts and reusing them across tasks. Inspired by this, we propose ToolSmith, an automatic tool-generation framework that grows and reuses modules on top of a lean base tool library. We evaluate ToolSmith on three in-domain multimodal search benchmarks and ten out-of-domain benchmarks under a VLM-as-a-Judge protocol. ToolSmith consistently improves over the base library across deployed agents of varying scales, with larger backbones reaping greater gains, demonstrating the scalability of the approach. Our code and data are available at https://threesr.github.io/toolsmith/.
items.abstract_zh: 近期的多模态搜索代理通过编排一个小型手工构建的搜索与视觉工具库，利用推理、视觉和实时网络搜索在多个轮次中回答超出参数化知识的问题。然而，该工具库的创建和维护很费力，并且当在真实环境中遇到新的查询类型、证据格式和失败模式时会被冻结。相比之下，人类从业者通过用熟悉的部件制作新工具并在任务间复用来应对工具不足。受此启发，我们提出 ToolSmith，一种自动工具生成框架，在精简的基础工具库之上生长和复用模块。我们在三个域内多模态搜索基准和十个域外基准上，在 VLM 作为评判者的协议下评估 ToolSmith。ToolSmith 在不同规模的已部署代理上均持续优于基础工具库，更大的骨干网络获得更大增益，展示了该方法的可扩展性。我们的代码和数据可在 https://threesr.github.io/toolsmith/ 获取。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Seeing to Drive on a Single Board: Attention-Free Depth for Onboard Robot Navigation
items.title_zh: 在单板上看见以驾驶：面向机载机器人导航的无注意力深度
items.abstract_en: A small ground robot can carry one camera and a few watts of compute, but the depth foundation models that could turn that camera into a range sensor are vision transformers sized for GPUs. We bring one to a Raspberry Pi 5 with the Hailo-8L, an accelerator that runs every layer in integer arithmetic, attention included. Quantised for it, Depth Anything V2 loses large parts of the scene, and we measure why: at 449 tokens, 91% of softmax weights fall below one int8 step while carrying 17-33% of the attention mass. Our answer is to distil, not quantise. An attention-free ResNet-34 U-Net student of Depth Anything V2-Large (24.5M parameters) runs at 27.1 FPS on the chip, its int8 output matches its float twin (Pearson 0.99993), and on held-out scenes of its simulated yard it is the most accurate depth network on the chip (AbsRel 0.269 against 0.354-0.530). On 1,000 stereo-verified points of a real outdoor drive it is not resolvably different from the vendor's Depth Anything V2-Small build, while running faster (27.1 vs 21.6 FPS). Ranging obstacles by where they meet the floor needs only the camera height, so mapping, hybrid-A* planning and SLAM run on the Pi's own CPU. In real-time hardware-in-the-loop tests in a Gaussian-splat reconstruction of a real yard, the stack reaches the goal without contact in 7.9$\pm$1.1 of 10 scenes, against 9.2$\pm$0.4 with exact obstacles, and in 7.7$\pm$0.7 on its own pose with simulated wheel odometry (ten seeds each; 8.2$\pm$0.4 with the real Pi and Hailo-8L in the loop, five seeds). The source code, pre-trained models and data are available at https://github.com/itaim18/DANIEL.
items.abstract_zh: 小型地面机器人可以携带一个相机和几瓦计算能力，但能够把该相机变成距离传感器的深度基础模型，是按 GPU 规模设计的视觉 Transformer。我们将其中一个带到配备 Hailo-8L 的 Raspberry Pi 5 上，该加速器以整数运算运行每一层，包括注意力。针对它量化后，Depth Anything V2 丢失场景的很大部分，我们测量了原因：在 449 个 token 时，91% 的 softmax 权重低于一个 int8 步长，却承载了 17-33% 的注意力质量。我们的答案是蒸馏，而非量化。Depth Anything V2-Large 的一个无注意力 ResNet-34 U-Net 学生模型（2450 万参数）在该芯片上以 27.1 FPS 运行，其 int8 输出与其浮点孪生模型匹配（Pearson 0.99993），并且在其模拟场地的留出场景上，它是该芯片上最准确的深度网络（AbsRel 0.269，对比 0.354-0.530）。在真实户外驾驶的 1,000 个经立体验证的点上，它与厂商的 Depth Anything V2-Small 构建版本没有可分辨差异，同时运行更快（27.1 对 21.6 FPS）。通过障碍物与地面的相交位置测距只需要相机高度，因此建图、混合 A* 规划和 SLAM 在 Pi 自身 CPU 上运行。在真实场地的高斯泼溅重建中进行的实时硬件在环测试中，整套系统在 10 个场景中无碰撞到达目标 7.9$\pm$1.1 次，而使用精确障碍物时为 9.2$\pm$0.4，并在使用模拟轮式里程计的自身位姿下为 7.7$\pm$0.7（每个十次随机种子；在真实 Pi 和 Hailo-8L 在环时为 8.2$\pm$0.4，五次种子）。源代码、预训练模型和数据可在 https://github.com/itaim18/DANIEL 获取。

items.title_en: PartAgent: Agentic 3D Part Segmentation via Expert Integration and Closed-Loop Refinement
items.title_zh: PartAgent：通过专家集成与闭环细化实现的智能体式三维部件分割
items.abstract_en: Segmenting a 3D object into semantically meaningful parts requires joint reasoning about geometric structure and semantic context. Pretrained 3D experts provide spatially grounded region proposals, while 2D experts provide semantic cues for identifying object parts. The challenge is to integrate these complementary capabilities into a framework that can both produce meaningful part segmentations and progressively refine them. We present PartAgent, a training-free agentic framework for 3D part segmentation built upon two complementary modules: (i) Structural-Semantic Expert Integration combines regions predicted by the 3D expert with multiview semantic evidence from the 2D expert through image-to-surface correspondences, constructing compositional part partitions at multiple granularities. (ii) Observation-Driven Closed-Loop Partition Refinement observes the current partition and its supporting evidence to select targeted inspection, evidence repair, composition, or reselection actions. It verifies proposed changes and uses the updated state and action outcomes to guide subsequent decisions. On PartObjaverse-Tiny-WT, PartAgent achieves 68.41 mIoU, outperforming the strongest competing method by 8.53 points. Across 3DCoMPaT200, PartNeXt, PartNetE, and PartObjaverse-Tiny, PartAgent achieves the highest mIoU on each dataset, averaging 69.36 across the four datasets, 7.28 points above the highest mean among competing methods.
items.abstract_zh: 将三维物体分割为语义上有意义的部件，需要联合推理几何结构与语义上下文。预训练的三维专家提供具有空间定位的区域提议，而二维专家提供用于识别物体部件的语义线索。挑战在于将这些互补能力整合到一个既能产生有意义的部件分割、又能逐步对其进行细化的框架中。我们提出 PartAgent，一个无需训练的智能体式三维部件分割框架，建立在两个互补模块之上：(i) 结构-语义专家集成，通过图像到表面的对应关系，将三维专家预测的区域与来自二维专家的多视图语义证据相结合，在多个粒度上构建组合式部件划分。(ii) 观测驱动的闭环划分细化，观测当前划分及其支撑证据，以选择有针对性的检查、证据修复、组合或重新选择动作。它验证所提出的更改，并利用更新后的状态与动作结果来指导后续决策。在 PartObjaverse-Tiny-WT 上，PartAgent 达到 68.41 mIoU，比最强的对比方法高出 8.53 个点。在 3DCoMPaT200、PartNeXt、PartNetE 和 PartObjaverse-Tiny 上，PartAgent 在每个数据集上均取得最高 mIoU，四个数据集的平均值为 69.36，比对比方法中的最高平均值高 7.28 个点。

items.title_en: Active sensing as control over sensory acquisition
items.title_zh: 主动感知作为对感觉获取的控制
items.abstract_en: The term "active sensing" is used across neuroscience and engineering to describe a wide range of sensing behaviors, but there is no consensus on what makes sensing "active." We propose that the behaviors grouped under this label are better understood as forms of control over sensory acquisition and develop a framework that distinguishes three interacting forms of control. Mechanistic control physically structures sensory input, strategic control modulates sensing in closed loop through adaptive and attentional processes, and agentic control concerns the sensing policies available to an agent and its authority to choose among them. These forms of control can occur separately or in combination, and have distinct consequences for sensory input, perception, behavior, and performance. The framework clarifies active-passive comparisons and provides a common basis for analyzing biological, engineered, and hybrid sensing systems by asking what is controlled, how, and by whom.
items.abstract_zh: “主动感知”一词在神经科学与工程领域被用来描述范围广泛的感知行为，但对于什么使感知成为“主动的”，尚无共识。我们提出，归于此标签下的各种行为最好被理解为对感觉获取的控制形式，并构建了一个区分三种相互作用控制形式的框架。机制性控制以物理方式构造感觉输入；策略性控制通过自适应与注意过程在闭环中调节感知；智能体性控制则涉及智能体可用的感知策略及其在其中进行选择的权限。这些控制形式可以单独出现，也可以组合出现，并对感觉输入、知觉、行为与性能产生不同的影响。该框架澄清了主动-被动比较，并通过追问“控制什么、如何控制、由谁控制”，为分析生物、工程与混合感知系统提供了共同基础。

items.title_en: A Highly Tunable (Ti,Zr)N$_x$-Based MIM Plasmonic Sensor for Multidomain Biological, Chemical, and Physical Sensing
items.title_zh: 一种基于 (Ti,Zr)N$_x$ 的高可调谐 MIM 等离激元传感器，用于多域生物、化学与物理传感
items.abstract_en: Metal-Insulator-Metal (MIM) plasmonic refractive index (RI) sensors have attracted considerable attention for label-free, real-time analyte detection; however, their reliance on noble metals such as gold and silver imposes fundamental constraints on tunability, thermal stability, and CMOS process compatibility. In this work, we propose a novel MIM plasmonic RI sensor based on a square ring resonator with embedded circular nanorods, employing the ternary nitride (Ti,Zr)N$_x$ as the plasmonic material, marking its first application in a MIM sensing platform. Compared to binary nitrides and other alternative plasmonic materials reported in the literature, (Ti,Zr)N$_x$ offers broader compositional tunability and greater flexibility in tailoring the optical response while remaining fully CMOS-compatible. The sensor is validated across a comprehensive range of biosensing and physicochemical analyte scenarios, including glucose monitoring for diabetes assessment, hemoglobin-based anemia classification across four severity levels, simultaneous discrimination of five major blood constituents, and cancer cell identification across six tissue types. For physical and chemical sensing, the structure achieves an air pressure sensitivity of 6.158 nm/MPa with negligible thermal cross-sensitivity, and a CO$_2$ detection sensitivity of 330.12 pm/ppm via polyhexamethylene biguanide (PHMB) functionalization, which is the highest reported among comparable structures in the literature. The proposed sensor achieves a maximum RI sensitivity of 2146.496 nm/RIU with a detection limit of $4.669 \times 10^{-7}$ RIU, outperforming previously reported CMOS-compatible plasmonic RI sensors.
items.abstract_zh: 金属-绝缘体-金属（MIM）等离激元折射率（RI）传感器因可用于无标记、实时的分析物检测而备受关注；然而，它们对金、银等贵金属的依赖，在可调谐性、热稳定性和 CMOS 工艺兼容性方面造成了根本性限制。在本工作中，我们提出一种新型 MIM 等离激元 RI 传感器，基于嵌入圆形纳米棒的方环谐振器，采用三元氮化物 (Ti,Zr)N$_x$ 作为等离激元材料，这标志着其首次应用于 MIM 传感平台。与文献中报道的二元氮化物及其他替代等离激元材料相比，(Ti,Zr)N$_x$ 具有更宽的组分可调谐性，在裁剪光学响应方面具有更大灵活性，同时保持完全 CMOS 兼容。该传感器在广泛的生物传感与物理化学分析物场景中得到了验证，包括用于糖尿病评估的葡萄糖监测、跨四个严重程度等级的基于血红蛋白的贫血分类、五种主要血液成分的同时判别，以及跨六种组织类型的癌细胞识别。在物理与化学传感方面，该结构实现了 6.158 nm/MPa 的空气压强灵敏度，且热交叉灵敏度可忽略不计；并通过聚六亚甲基双胍（PHMB）功能化实现了 330.12 pm/ppm 的 CO$_2$ 检测灵敏度，这是文献中可比结构中报道的最高值。所提出的传感器实现了 2146.496 nm/RIU 的最大 RI 灵敏度，检测限为 $4.669 \times 10^{-7}$ RIU，优于此前报道的 CMOS 兼容等离激元 RI 传感器。

items.title_en: One Phase Is Enough: Sim-to-Real Transfer with Direct Visual Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 一阶段足矣：基于直接视觉强化学习的仿真到真实迁移
items.abstract_en: Sim-to-real reinforcement learning (RL) has enabled impressive robotic behaviors, yet deploying policies directly from vision remains challenging. A common approach first trains a teacher policy with RL using privileged state observations, then distills its behavior into a vision-based student via imitation. However, the resulting student can substantially underperform its teacher. Directly training visual policies with RL offers a promising alternative, but learning task-relevant visual representations from scratch can be sample-inefficient, making one-phase visual RL intractable. We propose DRIFT, a simple recipe for efficient one-phase visual RL using image observations available at test time. Our key insight is to use frozen, pretrained foundation vision encoders, allowing RL to focus on learning control from existing visual representations. Freezing the encoder avoids costly backpropagation through the vision backbone, while its pretrained representations enable real-world transfer from fast, rasterized simulation rendering. Under matched architectures, observations, and compute budgets, DRIFT outperforms two-phase distillation and achieves a 58.8% relative improvement in average real-world success rate across three manipulation tasks. Controlled simulation evaluations demonstrate that DRIFT's relative advantage grows from roughly 9% in-distribution to over 61% under out-of-distribution shifts, suggesting that stronger generalization contributes to superior real-world transfer. Project website: https://jmarangola.github.io/one-phase-visual-rl/
items.abstract_zh: 仿真到真实的强化学习（RL）已使令人印象深刻的机器人行为成为可能，然而直接基于视觉部署策略仍然具有挑战性。一种常见做法是先用特权状态观测通过 RL 训练教师策略，再通过模仿将其行为蒸馏到基于视觉的学生策略中。然而，所得学生策略的表现可能大幅低于其教师。直接用 RL 训练视觉策略提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但从零开始学习与任务相关的视觉表征可能样本效率低下，使一阶段视觉 RL 难以实现。我们提出 DRIFT，一种使用测试时可获得的图像观测进行高效一阶段视觉 RL 的简单方案。我们的关键洞见是使用冻结的预训练基础视觉编码器，使 RL 能够专注于从已有视觉表征中学习控制。冻结编码器避免了通过视觉主干进行昂贵的反向传播，而其预训练表征使得能够从快速的光栅化仿真渲染迁移到真实世界。在匹配的架构、观测与计算预算下，DRIFT 优于两阶段蒸馏，并在三个操作任务上使真实世界平均成功率达到 58.8% 的相对提升。受控仿真评估表明，DRIFT 的相对优势从分布内约 9% 增长到分布外偏移下超过 61%，这表明更强的泛化能力有助于实现更优的真实世界迁移。项目网站：https://jmarangola.github.io/one-phase-visual-rl/

items.title_en: SALSA: Sampling Adversarial Suffixes from Learned Distributions for LLM Safety Assessment
items.title_zh: SALSA：从学习到的分布中采样对抗性后缀以进行大语言模型安全评估
items.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks, where adversaries append optimized suffixes to otherwise benign looking prompts to bypass safety alignment. Existing optimization-based GCG-style attacks can be effective, but they are expensive at inference time, and suffer from poor transfer. We present, SALSA, a generative framework that learns a distribution over jailbreak suffixes from optimization-derived attack corpora. Once trained, the model supports efficient sampling-based attacks. On open-source targets, it achieves attack success rates comparable to state-of-the-art optimization baselines, while reducing generation time from 3.46s to 0.04s per prompt. In black-box transfer, it remains highly effective against proprietary systems, including 99% ASR on GPT-3.5-Turbo, and reaches 45% ASR on the substantially harder GPT-4o, more than doubling the strongest baseline at an equal sampling budget. We further offer an intuition for why generative sampling can preserve high attack success, when the learned suffix distribution is close to the distribution of optimization outputs. Overall, our results show that learning adversarial suffix distributions yields a scalable, and practically efficient foundation for continuous LLM vulnerability discovery.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）仍然易受越狱攻击影响，即攻击者在看似良性的提示后附加优化得到的后缀以绕过安全对齐。现有的基于优化的 GCG 类攻击虽可能有效，但在推理时开销大，且迁移性较差。我们提出 SALSA，一个生成式框架，从优化导出的攻击语料中学习越狱后缀上的分布。训练完成后，该模型支持高效的基于采样的攻击。在开源目标上，它取得了与最先进优化基线相当的攻击成功率，同时将每个提示的生成时间从 3.46 秒降低到 0.04 秒。在黑盒迁移中，它对专有系统仍然高度有效，包括在 GPT-3.5-Turbo 上达到 99% ASR，并在难度显著更高的 GPT-4o 上达到 45% ASR，在相同采样预算下超过最强基线的两倍以上。我们进一步给出一种直观解释，说明当学习到的后缀分布接近优化输出的分布时，生成式采样为何能够保持高攻击成功率。总体而言，我们的结果表明，学习对抗性后缀分布为持续发现 LLM 漏洞提供了可扩展且实际高效的基础。

items.title_en: MRCT: An Object-Centric Two-Layer Control Architecture for Heavy-Payload Multi-Robot Transportation
items.title_zh: MRCT：一种面向重载多机器人运输的以物体为中心的两层控制架构
items.abstract_en: Cooperative transportation of heavy payloads by heterogeneous mobile manipulators requires coordinated payload motion, force distribution, and compliant physical interaction. This paper presents MRCT, an object-centric two-layer control architecture for multi-robot transportation. At the object level, a model predictive controller (MPC) generates a coordinated contact-force reference for the payload. At the robot level, whole- body impedance control (WBIC) modules on individual robots realise the reference through a confidence-based blending of velocity-tracking and impedance torques. The blending mechanism emphasises tracking when the joint-velocity error is small and increases compliance when tracking degrades because of abrupt reference changes or physical disturbances. Simulation and hardware experiments with a heterogeneous team comprising a single-arm and a dual-arm mobile manipulator transporting a near-rated table payload demonstrate accurate object tracking, regulated contact forces, and stable payload orientation. Parameter sensitivity studies, obstacle-avoidance transportation, and step-load disturbance experiments further demonstrate the effectiveness of MRCT for reliable cooperative transportation under the evaluated conditions
items.abstract_zh: 由异构移动操作机器人协同运输重载有效载荷，需要协调的有效载荷运动、力分配和柔顺的物理交互。本文提出 MRCT，一种以物体为中心的多机器人运输两层控制架构。在物体层，模型预测控制器（MPC）为有效载荷生成协调的接触力参考。在机器人层，各机器人上的全身阻抗控制（WBIC）模块通过基于置信度的速度跟踪力矩与阻抗力矩混合来实现该参考。该混合机制在关节速度误差较小时强调跟踪，而在因参考突变或物理扰动导致跟踪退化时增加柔顺性。使用由单臂和双臂移动操作机器人组成的异构团队运输接近额定负载的桌子有效载荷的仿真与硬件实验，展示了准确的对象跟踪、受调控的接触力以及稳定的有效载荷姿态。参数敏感性研究、避障运输和阶跃负载扰动实验进一步证明了 MRCT 在所评估条件下用于可靠协同运输的有效性。
