items.title_en: LoopDVR: Looped Transformer for Efficient Dense Visual Recognition
items.title_zh: LoopDVR：用于高效密集视觉识别的循环 Transformer
items.abstract_en: We propose LoopDVR, a framework for converting pretrained Transformer-based dense visual recognition models into parameter-efficient looped networks. Rather than reducing the network width or depth directly, LoopDVR reuses Transformer blocks across layers in both the ViT backbone and Transformer decoder, reducing the number of parameters while retaining the original computational structure. However, naively sharing parameters can disrupt the distinct transformations learned at different depths. To address this challenge, we identify suitable sharing groups based on inter-layer representation dissimilarity and keep the final backbone block independent for multi-scale feature construction. We then initialize each shared backbone block with the pretrained weights of its group's terminal layer to better preserve the learned representations. An independent Loop Adapter at each layer further helps retain depth-specific transformations within shared blocks. Subsequently, we distill visual representations into the looped backbone and integrate it with a looped decoder for task-specific training. Experiments demonstrate that LoopDVR achieves the best accuracy--parameter trade-offs across dense recognition tasks. Compared with the reference models, it reduces parameters by approximately 28% while maintaining competitive accuracy. Notably, LoopDet-S achieves 50.9 box AP with only 7.0M parameters, highlighting its effectiveness in compact models.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 LoopDVR，一个将预训练的基于 Transformer 的密集视觉识别模型转换为参数高效循环网络的框架。LoopDVR 不直接减小网络宽度或深度，而是在 ViT 主干和 Transformer 解码器中跨层复用 Transformer 块，在保留原始计算结构的同时减少参数数量。然而，朴素地共享参数可能破坏不同深度学到的不同变换。为应对这一挑战，我们基于层间表示差异度识别合适的共享组，并保持最后一个主干块独立以进行多尺度特征构建。然后，我们用每个共享主干块所属组终端层的预训练权重初始化该共享主干块，以更好地保留已学习的表示。每层独立的 Loop Adapter 进一步有助于在共享块内保留深度特定的变换。随后，我们将视觉表示蒸馏到循环主干中，并将其与循环解码器集成以进行任务特定训练。实验表明，LoopDVR 在密集识别任务上实现了最佳的精度—参数权衡。与参考模型相比，它在保持有竞争力精度的同时将参数减少约 28%。值得注意的是，LoopDet-S 仅用 7.0M 参数就达到 50.9 box AP，突显了其在紧凑模型中的有效性。

items.title_en: Targeting ATR-CHK1-WEE1 signaling enhances IMPDH inhibitor efficacy in mTORC1-driven tumor cells
items.title_zh: 靶向 ATR-CHK1-WEE1 信号增强 IMPDH 抑制剂在 mTORC1 驱动肿瘤细胞中的疗效
items.abstract_en: Uncontrolled activation of the master metabolic regulator Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin Complex 1 (mTORC1) in tumors confers strong dependence on the guanylate nucleotide synthesis enzyme inosine-5'-monophosphate dehydrogenase (IMPDH) for tumor cell growth and viability. Clinically approved IMPDH inhibitors reduce the guanylate nucleotide pool available for DNA synthesis in mTORC1-driven tumor cells, resulting in prolonged DNA replication stress and accumulation of DNA damage that culminates in apoptosis. These early molecular events are accompanied by activation of adaptive DNA replication stress response (RSR) and DNA damage response (DDR) pathways. We hypothesized that targeting these adaptive responses could enhance IMPDH inhibitor efficacy. We find that combining IMPDH inhibition with inhibition of the ATR-CHK1-WEE1 signaling axis increases the efficacy and durability of response in cell models, and in a syngeneic xenograft tumor model of the mTORC1-driven genetic tumor syndrome Tuberous Sclerosis Complex. Mechanistically, abrogating ATR-CHK1-WEE1 signaling during prolonged IMPDH inhibition causes aberrant cell cycle progression, increased DNA double-strand breaks, and formation of micronuclei. Together these findings uncover adaptive mechanisms that restrict IMPDH inhibitor efficacy, informing a combination strategy to improve treatment efficacy, while maintaining selectivity for targeting tumor cells that are driven by uncontrolled mTORC1 activation.
items.abstract_zh: 肿瘤中主代谢调节因子雷帕霉素机制靶点复合物1（mTORC1）的失控激活，使肿瘤细胞生长和存活强烈依赖鸟苷酸核苷酸合成酶次黄嘌呤-5'-单磷酸脱氢酶（IMPDH）。临床批准的 IMPDH 抑制剂减少 mTORC1 驱动肿瘤细胞中可用于 DNA 合成的鸟苷酸核苷酸池，导致持续的 DNA 复制应激和 DNA 损伤积累，最终引起细胞凋亡。这些早期分子事件伴随适应性 DNA 复制应激反应（RSR）和 DNA 损伤反应（DDR）通路的激活。我们假设靶向这些适应性反应可增强 IMPDH 抑制剂的疗效。我们发现，将 IMPDH 抑制与 ATR-CHK1-WEE1 信号轴抑制联合，可在细胞模型以及 mTORC1 驱动的遗传性肿瘤综合征结节性硬化症的同基因异种移植肿瘤模型中提高应答的疗效和持久性。机制上，在持续 IMPDH 抑制期间消除 ATR-CHK1-WEE1 信号会导致异常的细胞周期进程、DNA 双链断裂增加和微核形成。总之，这些发现揭示了限制 IMPDH 抑制剂疗效的适应性机制，为一种在保持对由 mTORC1 失控激活驱动的肿瘤细胞靶向选择性的同时提高治疗疗效的联合策略提供了依据。

items.title_en: Anatomy of orbital and spin responses in GaAs and Si: Hall, inverse Faraday, and magneto-optical Kerr effects
items.title_zh: GaAs 和 Si 中轨道与自旋响应的剖析：霍尔、逆法拉第和磁光克尔效应
items.abstract_en: Magneto-optical signals in nonmagnetic semiconductors entangle spin and orbital contributions, both in angular-momentum generation and magneto-optical detection. We calculate these contributions for electron-doped GaAs and Si using density-functional theory, linear-response theory, and a second-order density-matrix treatment of the inverse Faraday effect. At small electron doping, the intrinsic orbital Hall conductivity exceeds its spin counterpart in magnitude, while the orbital contribution to light-induced magnetization dominates over broad photon-energy ranges. We show that orbital- and spin-resolved optical Hall and polar Kerr coefficients exhibit stronger sensitivity to orbital moments than to equal spin moments. This contrast reflects direct electric-dipole coupling to orbital motion versus spin-orbit-mediated coupling to spin polarization. Consequently, Si maintains a substantial orbital magneto-optical response despite its weak spin-orbit interaction. At probe energies of 1.5 eV in GaAs and 3.0 eV in Si, the magnitude of the Kerr rotation per unit orbital moment is approximately 5 and 13 times larger than that per unit spin moment, respectively. Combining the calculated Hall conductivities and Kerr coefficients with a phenomenological drift-diffusion model yields predominantly orbital edge signals for the assumed diffusion constants and relaxation lengths. These results indicate that optical detection of induced magnetization in doped semiconductors such as GaAs and Si can be dominated by orbital signals, and therefore cannot be interpreted solely in terms of spin polarization.
items.abstract_zh: 非磁性半导体中的磁光信号在角动量产生和磁光检测中都会使自旋和轨道贡献相互纠缠。我们使用密度泛函理论、线性响应理论以及逆法拉第效应的二阶密度矩阵处理，计算了电子掺杂 GaAs 和 Si 中的这些贡献。在小电子掺杂下，本征轨道霍尔电导率在幅度上超过其自旋对应量，而光致磁化中的轨道贡献在较宽光子能量范围内占主导。我们表明，轨道分辨和自旋分辨的光学霍尔系数与极向克尔系数对轨道矩的敏感性比对等量自旋矩更强。这种对比反映了电偶极直接耦合到轨道运动，而自旋极化则通过自旋-轨道介导的耦合。因此，尽管 Si 的自旋-轨道相互作用较弱，它仍保持可观的轨道磁光响应。在 GaAs 的 1.5 eV 和 Si 的 3.0 eV 探测能量下，单位轨道矩的克尔旋转幅度分别约为单位自旋矩的 5 倍和 13 倍。将计算得到的霍尔电导率和克尔系数与唯象漂移-扩散模型结合，在假设的扩散常数和弛豫长度下主要得到轨道边缘信号。这些结果表明，在 GaAs 和 Si 等掺杂半导体中，对诱导磁化的光学检测可能由轨道信号主导，因此不能仅用自旋极化来解释。

items.title_en: Measuring Counterfactual Credit in a Replayable Wildfire-Suppression Benchmark
items.title_zh: 在可重放的野火抑制基准中测量反事实信用
items.abstract_en: In cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning, learned critics are usually evaluated by how well they predict the team's return. Yet predicting a team's return and assigning credit to individual actions are distinct tasks. To test credit directly, we introduce FLARE (Fireline Learning Agents in a Replayable Environment), a stochastic wildfire suppression benchmark in which any moment of a fire can be replayed with different actions under the same random events. Replaying one step measures the immediate effect of each agent's suppression, which we call simulator credit and use for training. Replaying to the end of the episode measures the effect of each action, which we use for grading critics. In a comparison over eight seeds with multi-agent proximal policy optimization (MAPPO), simulator credit reduces the interquartile mean burn score (each cell's burning time, capped and averaged over the map; lower is better) from 26.6% with shared reward to 20.9%. Learned credit from a centralized COMA-style critic does no better than the shared reward. Four trained critics predict the team's return well, yet the credit they assign is 9 to 42 times larger than the credit measured by replay. The critics also give heterogeneous agents nearly identical action rankings. These results show that a good fit to the team's return is a weak test of a critic's credit.
items.abstract_zh: 在合作多智能体强化学习中，学习得到的评论家通常通过其预测团队回报的好坏来评估。然而，预测团队回报与将信用分配给个体动作是不同的任务。为了直接检验信用，我们引入 FLARE（Fireline Learning Agents in a Replayable Environment），一个随机野火抑制基准，其中火灾的任意时刻都可以在相同随机事件下用不同动作重放。重放一步测量每个智能体抑制动作的即时效果，我们称之为模拟器信用并将其用于训练。重放到回合结束测量每个动作的效果，我们用它来给评论家评分。在与多智能体近端策略优化（MAPPO）比较的八个随机种子中，模拟器信用将四分位均值燃烧分数（每个单元的燃烧时间，设有上限并在地图上取平均；越低越好）从共享奖励的 26.6% 降至 20.9%。来自集中式 COMA 风格评论家的学习信用并不比共享奖励更好。四个训练过的评论家能很好地预测团队回报，但它们分配的信用比重放测得的信用大 9 到 42 倍。这些评论家还给予异质智能体几乎相同的动作排名。这些结果表明，对团队回报的良好拟合是对评论家信用的一项弱检验。

items.title_en: Avalon-M1: Reinforcement Learning from Collective Rewards
items.title_zh: Avalon-M1：基于集体奖励的强化学习
items.abstract_en: We introduce reinforcement learning from collective rewards (RLCR), a recipe for jointly training language models to act as agent organisations under latency constraints. A CEO and up to eight specialists share one policy, co-ordinate through a message board and workspace, and are trained with a common outcome-derived advantage. The deadline makes parallel work valuable when it increases the return earned before the cap. We train Avalon-M1-Mini (120B) across 147 environments. For the trained model, eight-hire organisational execution raises IMO-ProofBench-Advanced scores from 23.8% to 39.0% relative to single-agent execution. Across 12 benchmarks, organisations achieve similar average scores at approximately one-third the derived latency of token-matched single-agent execution and just over half that of eight independent attempts followed by selection. The trained model also outperforms Nemotron 3 Super, post-trained from the same base model, across all evaluations when comparing each model's best tested configuration. On EdgeBench, organisations overtake the single agent after approximately 0.4 derived hours. Over the course of training, organisations develop hierarchies to manage communication costs, invest more in peer review, and alter how work is divided. Safety evaluations find near-universal refusal of harmful actions but sustained declines in external reporting in two of three oversight scenarios. These results establish a shared-advantage baseline for studying organisational learning, performance-latency trade-offs, and collective oversight.
items.abstract_zh: 我们引入基于集体奖励的强化学习（RLCR），一种在延迟约束下联合训练语言模型使其作为智能体组织运作的方法。一个 CEO 和最多八名专家共享一个策略，通过消息板和工作区进行协调，并使用共同的结果派生优势进行训练。截止时间使得并行工作在能够增加上限之前所获得回报时具有价值。我们在 147 个环境中训练 Avalon-M1-Mini（120B）。对于训练后的模型，八人雇佣的组织执行相对于单智能体执行将 IMO-ProofBench-Advanced 分数从 23.8% 提高到 39.0%。在 12 个基准上，组织在约为令牌匹配单智能体执行派生延迟三分之一、以及八个独立尝试后选择的一半略多时，取得相似的平均分数。当比较每个模型的最佳测试配置时，训练后的模型在所有评估中还优于从同一基础模型后训练的 Nemotron 3 Super。在 EdgeBench 上，组织在约 0.4 个派生小时后超过单智能体。在训练过程中，组织发展出层级结构以管理通信成本，增加对同行评审的投入，并改变工作划分方式。安全评估发现对有害行为几乎普遍拒绝，但在三个监督场景中的两个里，外部报告持续下降。这些结果为研究组织学习、性能—延迟权衡和集体监督建立了共享优势基线。

items.title_en: ReWeave: Emergent Physical Task Topologies for Embodied Harness Optimization and Cross-Task Meta-Distillation
items.title_zh: ReWeave：用于具身执行框架优化与跨任务元蒸馏的涌现物理任务拓扑
items.abstract_en: Long-horizon embodied tasks involve physical dependencies that may only become clear through interaction. As task understanding deepens, past trials can reveal new information for adaptation and transfer. However, coarse progress feedback cannot identify which physical preconditions held, leaving search unguided, while task-specific optimization easily overfits to individual scenes, making cross-task transfer brittle. We introduce ReWeave, a framework that jointly optimizes an embodied agent harness and an emergent physical task topology from interaction without updating policy weights. Keeping execution policies and perception frozen, ReWeave co-optimizes coupled context, workflows, and control loops. As new evidence revises the topology, ReWeave reprojects past trials onto the updated task understanding, exposing retained progress, regressions, and bottlenecks that guide parent selection and search width. Across tasks, matching verified local mechanisms to unmet preconditions consolidates 72 specialist units into 44 reusable groups ($0.34\times$ full concatenation) within a compact shared harness capable of continual learning. ReWeave improves held-out success from 89.00% to 98.75% on LIBERO-PRO and from 25.50% to 58.25% on RoboDojo, while uncovering retained progress in 89% of 159 failed RoboDojo development trials and translating stronger offline reasoning into higher online performance. On eight unseen LIBERO-PRO tasks, the shared harness reaches 51.3% success versus 41.3% for direct distillation, rising to 75.0% after continual learning.
items.abstract_zh: 长时程具身任务涉及物理依赖关系，这些依赖可能只有通过交互才变得清晰。随着任务理解加深，过去的尝试可以揭示用于适应和迁移的新信息。然而，粗粒度进度反馈无法识别哪些物理前置条件成立，使搜索缺乏引导；而任务特定优化容易过拟合到单个场景，使跨任务迁移变得脆弱。我们引入 ReWeave，一个在不更新策略权重的情况下，从交互中联合优化具身智能体执行框架和涌现物理任务拓扑的框架。ReWeave 保持执行策略和感知冻结，协同优化耦合的上下文、工作流和控制回路。当新证据修正拓扑时，ReWeave 将过去的尝试重新投影到更新后的任务理解上，揭示保留的进展、回退和瓶颈，以指导父代选择和搜索宽度。跨任务地，将已验证的局部机制与未满足的前置条件匹配，可在能够持续学习的紧凑共享执行框架内，将 72 个专家单元整合为 44 个可复用组（为完整拼接的 $0.34\times$）。ReWeave 在 LIBERO-PRO 上将留出成功率从 89.00% 提高到 98.75%，在 RoboDojo 上从 25.50% 提高到 58.25%，同时在 159 个失败的 RoboDojo 开发试验中的 89% 里发现保留的进展，并将更强的离线推理转化为更高的在线性能。在八个未见过的 LIBERO-PRO 任务上，共享执行框架达到 51.3% 成功率，而直接蒸馏为 41.3%，在持续学习后升至 75.0%。

items.title_en: E-MAPS: Event-Based Promptable Video Segmentation with Memory-as-Prompt
items.title_zh: E-MAPS：基于事件的、以记忆为提示（Memory-as-Prompt）的可提示视频分割
items.abstract_en: RGB-based video object segmentation (VOS) remains brittle under fast motion and adverse illumination. Event cameras preserve signal under blur and challenging exposure, but provide little evidence when motion slows. Interaction can restore object state for subsequent propagation, yet promptable event methods merely address single windows. We formalize event-based Promptable Video Segmentation (ePVS), where prompts at arbitrary windows initialize, correct, or introduce objects and predictions. We present Event Memory-As-Prompt Segmentation (E-MAPS), which transfers a pretrained promptable segmenter to event streams and learns propagation and correction. Event-to-Token (E2T) aligns recurrent event features with pretrained representations while preserving prompt-conditioning priors. Memory-Aware Prompting (MAP) converts object-conditioned history into sparse prompts, allowing memory and user inputs to share one decoder pathway efficiently. We construct Event-View Masklets (EViM) from 206K aligned RGB-event pairs and 620K masks for two-stage representation transfer and native event-video learning, and establish three training-disjoint benchmarks. E-MAPS leads prompt-once and interactive ePVS across all three benchmarks while being more efficient. It further demonstrates strong performance on zero-shot object tracking benchmarks. Project page: https://github.com/adonaydem/emaps-wacv
items.abstract_zh: 基于 RGB 的视频对象分割（VOS）在快速运动和不利光照下仍然脆弱。事件相机在模糊和具有挑战性的曝光下保留信号，但当运动变慢时提供的证据很少。交互可以为后续传播恢复对象状态，但可提示的事件方法仅处理单个窗口。我们形式化了基于事件的可提示视频分割（ePVS），其中任意窗口的提示可以初始化、纠正或引入对象与预测。我们提出 Event Memory-As-Prompt Segmentation（E-MAPS），其将预训练的可提示分割器迁移到事件流，并学习传播与纠正。Event-to-Token（E2T）将循环事件特征与预训练表示对齐，同时保留提示条件先验。Memory-Aware Prompting（MAP）将对象条件历史转换为稀疏提示，使记忆和用户输入高效共享一个解码器通路。我们利用 206K 对齐的 RGB-事件对和 620K 掩码构建 Event-View Masklets（EViM），用于两阶段表示迁移和原生事件-视频学习，并建立三个训练互斥的基准。E-MAPS 在所有三个基准上的单次提示（prompt-once）和交互式 ePVS 中领先，同时更高效。它在零样本对象跟踪基准上进一步表现出强劲性能。项目页面：https://github.com/adonaydem/emaps-wacv

items.title_en: mRNA-1273.262 and mRNA-1283.262 Vaccines Expressing XFG Antigens Neutralize Relevant Circulating Variants
items.title_zh: 表达 XFG 抗原的 mRNA-1273.262 和 mRNA-1283.262 疫苗可中和相关流行变异株
items.abstract_en: SARS-CoV-2 continues to circulate and causes substantial disease burden as an endemic respiratory pathogen. Vaccination is a key public health measure to ameliorate the effects of COVID-19 disease but requires annual update to match strains that are circulating. Monitoring of circulating virus and characterization of matched candidate vaccines helps to inform which antigens will provide the greatest benefit to public well-being. The 2026-2027 season will leverage XFG as the variant of interest for vaccine production and in vitro and in vivo data was generated preclinically to support this selection. XFG variant vaccines express well in mRNA format as both full-length spike and linked subdomain antigen formats. Animals immunized with these vaccines elicit robust neutralizing responses to relevant JN.1-family virus variants in both primary series and booster models. In future seasons, robust epidemiologically monitoring including viral genome sequencing will improve early detection of relevant variants and subsequent preparation of vaccine antigens.
items.abstract_zh: SARS-CoV-2 持续传播，并作为地方性呼吸道病原体造成重大疾病负担。疫苗接种是减轻 COVID-19 疾病影响的关键公共卫生措施，但需要每年更新以匹配正在流行的毒株。监测流行病毒并表征匹配的候选疫苗，有助于说明哪些抗原将为公众健康带来最大益处。2026-2027 季节将利用 XFG 作为疫苗生产的关注变异株，并已在临床前产生体外和体内数据以支持这一选择。XFG 变异株疫苗以 mRNA 形式在全长刺突和连接亚结构域抗原两种形式中均表达良好。用这些疫苗接种的动物在初免系列和加强针模型中均对相关 JN.1 家族病毒变异株产生强劲的中和反应。在未来季节，包括病毒基因组测序在内的稳健流行病学监测将改善对相关变异株的早期发现以及随后疫苗抗原的制备。

items.title_en: Polarization switching of double azimuthal backflow in two transverse orbital angular momentum superpositions
items.title_zh: 两个横向轨道角动量叠加中的双方位回流的偏振切换
items.abstract_en: Optical backflow in the azimuthal direction can be generated by the interference of two rotating-wave structured light beams with distinct transverse topological charges and equal intensity. Here we show that the interference reverses both azimuthal components of the Poynting and the canonical momenta. Although these two momenta are not generally tied, they reverse jointly here: both acquire azimuthal backflow in a common angular sector, while their radial intervals can differ. The double backflow is switched solely by the polarizations of the two beams, without amplitude tuning. A single polarization overlap enters the interference terms of both momenta but not the single-beam terms of either, so that matched polarizations switch the double backflow on whereas mismatched ones switch it off. The double backflow is periodic in the azimuthal direction, with its angular period locked to the topological charge difference and independent of the individual charges. Our results establish a vectorial mechanism for polarization-gated azimuthal backflow, with potential applications in polarization-switchable optical manipulation.
items.abstract_zh: 方位角方向的光学回流可由两束具有不同横向拓扑电荷和相等强度的旋转波结构光束干涉产生。在此我们表明，该干涉会同时反转坡印廷动量和正则动量的方位角分量。尽管这两种动量通常并不绑定，但在此它们共同反转：两者在共同的角度扇区内获得方位角回流，而它们的径向区间可以不同。双回流仅由两束光的偏振切换，无需幅度调节。单一偏振重叠进入两种动量的干涉项，但不进入任一者的单光束项，因此匹配的偏振开启双回流，而不匹配的偏振将其关闭。双回流在方位角方向上具有周期性，其角周期锁定于拓扑电荷差，而与各个电荷无关。我们的结果建立了一种用于偏振门控方位角回流的矢量机制，并可能在偏振可切换光操纵中具有应用。

items.title_en: How Far Can Linear Go? BiPert, a Unified Framework for Single-Cell Perturbation Modelling
items.title_zh: 线性方法能走多远？BiPert：单细胞扰动建模的统一框架
items.abstract_en: Understanding how genetic perturbations affect cellular behaviour is essential for studying gene function and regulatory mechanisms. Large-scale CRISPR screens measure these effects across thousands of genes, but cover relatively few cellular contexts. Predicting perturbation responses in unseen cell types and identifying perturbed genes from their transcriptional effects therefore remain challenging. Here, we show that both tasks can be addressed through a common linear decomposition of transcriptional responses into shared and perturbation-specific components. Building on this principle, we introduce BiPert, a simple linear framework for both forward perturbation prediction and inverse identification. For forward prediction, BiPert outperforms existing methods that use no external biological knowledge when predicting gene expression changes in unseen cell lines. Its few-shot extension, BiPert-FS, adapts to new cell lines using as few as ten measured perturbations. For inverse identification, BiPert-ID identifies perturbed genes from single-cell expression profiles, outperforming deep-learning methods in unseen cell lines and donors. We further show that perturbations whose effects transfer more consistently across cellular contexts are also easier to identify, even after controlling for perturbation effect size. Together, these results establish a connection between perturbation transfer and identification, and demonstrate that simple linear models provide strong, interpretable baselines for both tasks.
items.abstract_zh: 理解遗传扰动如何影响细胞行为对于研究基因功能和调控机制至关重要。大规模 CRISPR 筛选在数千个基因上测量这些效应，但覆盖的细胞情境相对较少。因此，在未见细胞类型中预测扰动反应以及从转录效应中识别被扰动基因仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们表明这两个任务都可以通过将转录反应共同线性分解为共享组分和扰动特异性组分来处理。基于这一原则，我们提出 BiPert，一个用于正向扰动预测和逆向识别的简单线性框架。对于正向预测，在预测未见细胞系中的基因表达变化时，BiPert 优于不使用外部生物学知识的现有方法。其少样本扩展 BiPert-FS 仅使用少至十个实测扰动即可适应新细胞系。对于逆向识别，BiPert-ID 从单细胞表达谱中识别被扰动基因，在未见细胞系和供体中优于深度学习方法。我们进一步表明，即使在控制扰动效应大小后，效应跨细胞情境迁移更一致的扰动也更容易识别。总之，这些结果建立了扰动迁移与识别之间的联系，并证明简单线性模型为这两个任务提供了强大且可解释的基线。

items.title_en: Evaluating Latent Knowledge Stability in Multimodal Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 评估多模态大语言模型中的潜在知识稳定性
items.abstract_en: Changes in image viewpoint and question formulation can alter latent knowledge representations in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, output correctness and overall representational drift provide limited insight into how these changes affect model decisions. We therefore evaluate latent knowledge stability across visual and linguistic elicitation conditions from two complementary perspectives: answer preference and internal support. Specifically, we devise the margin retention score (MRS), which measures the first-order projected degradation of the initial answer's logit margin over competing options across conditions and assesses how changes in latent knowledge representations affect this margin. We also present latent knowledge support-structure stability (KSS), which evaluates reference-correct items by comparing internal support profiles constructed using the margin gradient under the reference condition, which jointly reflects changes in how internal support is distributed and changes in total support magnitude. We further construct MMStableBench, comprising 19,452 knowledge items (facts), each probing the same latent knowledge across varied image viewpoints, semantically equivalent question formulations, and answer-option permutations. Experiments across 15 MLLMs show that MRS and KSS reveal latent knowledge instability not captured by accuracy, while an MRS-inspired regularizer further improves the generalization of edited latent knowledge.
items.abstract_zh: 图像视角和问题表述的变化可以改变多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中的潜在知识表示。然而，输出正确性和整体表示漂移对理解这些变化如何影响模型决策提供的洞见有限。因此，我们从两个互补视角评估潜在知识在视觉和语言引出条件下的稳定性：答案偏好和内部支持。具体而言，我们设计了边际保持分数（MRS），它衡量初始答案相对于竞争选项的 logit 边际在不同条件下的一阶投影退化，并评估潜在知识表示的变化如何影响该边际。我们还提出潜在知识支持结构稳定性（KSS），它通过比较在参考条件下使用边际梯度构建的内部支持剖面来评估参考正确项，这共同反映了内部支持分布方式的变化和总支持幅度的变化。我们进一步构建 MMStableBench，包含 19,452 个知识项（事实），每个知识项在不同图像视角、语义等价的问题表述和答案选项排列中探测相同的潜在知识。在 15 个 MLLM 上的实验表明，MRS 和 KSS 揭示了准确率未捕捉到的潜在知识不稳定性，而受 MRS 启发的正则化器进一步提高了编辑后潜在知识的泛化能力。

items.title_en: AXE: AlpaSim E2E Closed Loop Challenge Technical Report
items.title_zh: AXE：AlpaSim 端到端闭环挑战技术报告
items.abstract_en: This report presents a comprehensive pipeline for developing an end-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving model for the Physical AI AV Track. The framework consists of data curation, HD map auto-labelling, data-driven imitation learning, and simulator-based reinforcement learning. To ensure safety in the closed-loop setting, we introduce a selection-based E2E planning approach that leverages object detection and BEV segmentation to filter out trajectory candidates likely to cause collisions or off-road driving. Trained on NVIDIA NuRec and the NVIDIA PAI-AV dataset, our method scores a fixed vocabulary of trajectory candidates for collision, drivable-area compliance, and progress learned from simulated rollouts, and selects the best candidate that passes the filter. This design highlights the effectiveness of combining E2E planning with perception-based trajectory filtering for safe and reliable closed-loop autonomous driving.
items.abstract_zh: 本报告提出了一个用于 Physical AI AV Track 的端到端（E2E）自动驾驶模型开发的综合流程。该框架包括数据整理、高清地图自动标注、数据驱动的模仿学习和基于模拟器的强化学习。为确保闭环设置中的安全性，我们引入一种基于选择的 E2E 规划方法，利用目标检测和 BEV 分割来过滤可能造成碰撞或越野行驶的轨迹候选。在 NVIDIA NuRec 和 NVIDIA PAI-AV 数据集上训练后，我们的方法对固定词汇的轨迹候选在碰撞、可行驶区域符合性和从模拟推演中学习到的进度方面进行评分，并选择通过过滤器的最佳候选。这一设计突出了将 E2E 规划与基于感知的轨迹过滤相结合，对于安全可靠的闭环自动驾驶的有效性。

items.title_en: DOPER: Deep Object Pose Estimation Revisited
items.title_zh: DOPER：重新审视深度物体位姿估计
items.abstract_en: We present DOPER, an RGB pose estimation framework that shares a visual backbone across object detection, segmentation, and keypoint prediction to recover the 6D pose of known objects through Perspective-n-Point. Starting from synthetic training, DOPER adapts to real observations using partial supervision while retaining synthetic keypoint labels. Calibrated multi-view observations provide geometric constraints for keypoint supervision. During inference, optional heatmap refinement fits a rigid pose directly to the predicted keypoint distributions, resolving ambiguous correspondences without depth input or a learned pose refiner. Starting from underspecified CAD models, DOPER progressively refines the object representation and pose estimator. Results on SPEED+ and SHIRT further demonstrate effective adaptation to illumination changes and accurate temporal pose estimation. Across the evaluated single-view and multi-view configurations, DOPER achieves state-of-the-art detection AP results on HANDAL, HOPEv2, HOT3D, and T-LESS while using only RGB and running in real time (35 Hz per object model on one GB300). These results demonstrate the effectiveness of jointly learning detection and pose keypoints, with real observations and geometric constraints.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 DOPER，一种 RGB 位姿估计框架，在目标检测、分割和关键点预测之间共享视觉骨干，通过 Perspective-n-Point 恢复已知物体的 6D 位姿。DOPER 从合成训练出发，在保留合成关键点标签的同时，利用部分监督适应真实观测。经标定的多视角观测为关键点监督提供几何约束。推理时，可选的热图细化直接将刚性位姿拟合到预测的关键点分布，无需深度输入或学习式位姿细化器即可解决模糊对应。从信息不充分的 CAD 模型出发，DOPER 逐步细化物体表示和位姿估计器。在 SPEED+ 和 SHIRT 上的结果进一步表明，其能有效适应光照变化并实现准确的时间位姿估计。在所评估的单视图和多视图配置中，DOPER 在 HANDAL、HOPEv2、HOT3D 和 T-LESS 上取得最先进的检测 AP 结果，同时仅使用 RGB，并实时运行（在一个 GB300 上每个物体模型 35 Hz）。这些结果证明了结合真实观测与几何约束联合学习检测和位姿关键点的有效性。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为检测与跟踪，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Extraction of Glaucoma Diagnosis, Type, and Severity from Clinical Notes using Secure Cloud-based Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 使用安全的云端大语言模型从临床笔记中提取青光眼诊断、类型和严重程度
items.abstract_en: Purpose: To evaluate the performance of large language models (LLMs) in extracting glaucoma diagnosis, type, and severity from clinical notes in the electronic health record (EHR). Methods: Clinical notes of glaucoma-related encounters between 2014 and 2024 from 1,242 subjects were extracted from the Bascom Palmer Ophthalmic Repository. Two fellowship-trained glaucoma specialists labeled notes for glaucoma presence, type, and severity. Dataset was split into development (10%), validation (10%), and test (80%) sets. Five LLMs (Claude Opus 4.6, DeepSeek-V3.2, GPT-5.2, Grok 4.1 fast non-reasoning, and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B) were accessed via Microsoft Foundry within HIPAA-compliant containers. Model performance was assessed using standard metrics. Clinician-entered ICD-10 codes were also compared with adjudicated labels. Main Outcome Measures: Gwet AC1, accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and F1-score. Results: Inter-grader agreement for glaucoma diagnosis, type, and severity was high (Gwet AC1 0.940, 0.917, 0.906, respectively). For glaucoma diagnosis, LLMs demonstrated high accuracy, with Claude achieving 97.5%, DeepSeek 96.0%, GPT 96.2%, Grok 94.4%, and Qwen 95.5%. F1 scores for glaucoma detection ranged from 97.0% to 98.9%. For type, accuracies were 97.1%, 94.2%, 94.2%, 94.0%, and 94.4%, respectively. F1 scores for the most prevalent type (POAG) ranged from 96.6% to 98.9%. For severity, accuracies were 95.0%, 94.8%, 94.5%, 94.0%, and 95.2%, respectively, with F1 scores ranging from 89.7% to 96.3%. ICD-10 codes demonstrated lower accuracies for type and severity (87.3% and 69.2%, respectively). Conclusions: LLMs accurately extracted glaucoma diagnosis, type, and severity from free-text clinical notes, outperforming ICD-based phenotyping. Translational Relevance: LLMs have the potential to transform unstructured documentation into scalable, research-ready phenotypes for EHR-based glaucoma cohort construction.
items.abstract_zh: 目的：评估大语言模型（LLM）从电子健康记录（EHR）的临床笔记中提取青光眼诊断、类型和严重程度的性能。方法：从 Bascom Palmer 眼科数据库提取 2014 年至 2024 年间 1,242 名受试者青光眼相关就诊的临床笔记。两名接受过专科进修培训的青光眼专家对笔记进行标注，标记青光眼是否存在、类型和严重程度。数据集划分为开发集（10%）、验证集（10%）和测试集（80%）。通过符合 HIPAA 的容器内的 Microsoft Foundry 访问五个 LLM（Claude Opus 4.6、DeepSeek-V3.2、GPT-5.2、Grok 4.1 fast non-reasoning 和 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B）。使用标准指标评估模型性能。还将临床医生录入的 ICD-10 编码与裁定标签进行比较。主要结局指标：Gwet AC1、准确率、灵敏度、特异度和 F1 分数。结果：青光眼诊断、类型和严重程度的评分者间一致性很高（Gwet AC1 分别为 0.940、0.917、0.906）。对于青光眼诊断，LLM 表现出高准确率，Claude 达到 97.5%，DeepSeek 96.0%，GPT 96.2%，Grok 94.4%，Qwen 95.5%。青光眼检测的 F1 分数范围为 97.0% 至 98.9%。对于类型，准确率分别为 97.1%、94.2%、94.2%、94.0% 和 94.4%。最常见类型（POAG）的 F1 分数范围为 96.6% 至 98.9%。对于严重程度，准确率分别为 95.0%、94.8%、94.5%、94.0% 和 95.2%，F1 分数范围为 89.7% 至 96.3%。ICD-10 编码在类型和严重程度上的准确率较低（分别为 87.3% 和 69.2%）。结论：LLM 能从自由文本临床笔记中准确提取青光眼诊断、类型和严重程度，优于基于 ICD 的表型提取。转化相关性：LLM 有潜力将非结构化文档转化为可扩展、可供研究的表型，用于基于 EHR 构建青光眼队列。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Domain advantage in two-dimensional quantum-device design with multi-modal agentic harness
items.title_zh: 多模态智能体框架在二维量子器件设计中的领域优势
items.abstract_en: High-quality two-dimensional quantum devices are commonly fabricated from mechanically exfoliated crystals, whose irregular shapes and placement require a lithographic layout tailored to each specimen. Drawing these layouts remains largely manual. We introduce qlaybench, a benchmark that tests whether language-model agents can turn microscope images and experimental requirements into device layouts that fit the specimen. Agents with conventional tools often construct devices when material outlines are supplied, but struggle to identify those outlines from images. Modelled on the human workflow, qlaybot, a multimodal agentic harness, connects image interpretation to the tools used to align images, draw device features and inspect the resulting layout. We evaluate each layout with checks drawn from practical design experience, asking whether it fits the specimen and connects its intended components. With greater computational effort, an agent using qlaybot passes 81.5% of the benchmark tasks, compared with 24.1% when it uses conventional tools. This domain advantage highlights the importance of connecting scientific interpretation of a specimen to geometric design and provides a route towards reducing manual effort in two-dimensional quantum-device fabrication.
items.abstract_zh: 高质量二维量子器件通常由机械剥离晶体制备，其不规则形状和放置位置要求为每个样品定制光刻版图。绘制这些版图在很大程度上仍依赖人工。我们提出 qlaybench，一个基准，用于测试语言模型智能体能否将显微镜图像和实验要求转化为适合样品的器件版图。使用传统工具的智能体在提供材料轮廓时通常能构建设计器件，但难以从图像中识别这些轮廓。qlaybot 是一个多模态智能体框架，仿照人类工作流程，将图像解读与用于对齐图像、绘制器件特征和检查所得版图的工具连接起来。我们使用源自实际设计经验的检查项评估每个版图，询问其是否适合样品并连接其预期组件。在更大的计算投入下，使用 qlaybot 的智能体通过了 81.5% 的基准任务，而使用传统工具时为 24.1%。这种领域优势凸显了将样品的科学解读与几何设计相连接的重要性，并提供了一条减少二维量子器件制造中人工工作量的途径。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Fractal Neural Synthesis: Constant-Storage Procedural Weight Derivation via Complex Quadratic Boundary Dynamics
items.title_zh: 分形神经合成：通过复二次边界动力学的恒定存储过程式权重推导
items.abstract_en: Conventional neural networks store synaptic parameters as explicit tensors whose persistent Flash footprint scales linearly (O(W)) with parameter count, constraining resource-limited edge microcontrollers. We formulate and systematically evaluate Fractal Neural Synthesis (FNS), a procedural weight derivation architecture that replaces hidden-layer matrices with a constant 24-byte coordinate seed Theta = (c_x, c_y, ell) in F_64^3 anchored near the complex quadratic bifurcation boundary dM of f_c(z) = z^2 + c. We introduce a large-bailout (R = 256) smooth escape kernel, four zero-overhead geometric sampling apertures--Cartesian Grid, coprime 3x3 Rule-of-Thirds (Z/9Z), phi-Vogel spiral, and multi-scale Harmonic Tripod--and prove conditional Kolmogorov (K_Kolm <= 192 + c_0 bits) and Shannon entropy bounds. Across magnifications zeta in [10^0, 10^8], C^1 Fourier and lattice-noise bases collapse to post-standardization rank ~2.25 and SHA-256 PRNG exhibits avalanche discontinuity (rho ~ 0.019, 50.6% micro-step retention), whereas dM uniquely sustains both rank (~10.0) and local continuity (rho in [0.81, 0.97], 89.2% retention). Under leak-free 10-fold CV across four zero-scaler-byte non-linear benchmarks, FNS with an INT8 readout surpasses 0-hidden Linear-INT8 by +3.6 to +10.8 pp while delivering 10.7x-129x total Flash reduction (725x-2,773x hidden reduction) relative to converged Float32 MLPs (90.30% Ionosphere in 285 B; 97.22% Optical Digits in 2,598 B; 97.90% PenDigits in 2,598 B; 87.00% Satimage in 1,570 B).
items.abstract_zh: 传统神经网络将突触参数存储为显式张量，其持久 Flash 占用随参数数量线性增长（O(W)），限制了资源受限的边缘微控制器。我们提出并系统评估分形神经合成（FNS），一种过程式权重推导架构，用位于 F_64^3 中、锚定在 f_c(z) = z^2 + c 的复二次分岔边界 dM 附近的恒定 24 字节坐标种子 Theta = (c_x, c_y, ell) 替代隐藏层矩阵。我们引入大逃逸半径（R = 256）的平滑逃逸核、四种零开销几何采样孔径——笛卡尔网格、互质 3x3 三分法（Z/9Z）、phi-Vogel 螺旋和多尺度 Harmonic Tripod——并证明条件 Kolmogorov 界（K_Kolm <= 192 + c_0 比特）和 Shannon 熵界。在放大倍数 zeta 属于 [10^0, 10^8] 范围内，C^1 Fourier 和晶格噪声基坍缩到标准化后秩约 2.25，SHA-256 PRNG 表现出雪崩不连续性（rho 约 0.019，微步保留率 50.6%），而 dM 独特地同时维持秩（约 10.0）和局部连续性（rho 在 [0.81, 0.97]，保留率 89.2%）。在四个 zero-scaler-byte 非线性基准上进行无泄漏 10 折交叉验证，带有 INT8 读出层的 FNS 比 0 隐藏层 Linear-INT8 高出 +3.6 至 +10.8 个百分点，同时相对于收敛的 Float32 MLP 实现 10.7 倍至 129 倍的总 Flash 减少（隐藏层减少 725 倍至 2,773 倍）（Ionosphere 90.30%，285 B；Optical Digits 97.22%，2,598 B；PenDigits 97.90%，2,598 B；Satimage 87.00%，1,570 B）。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为光学器件与计算，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: ArabFake: A multitask deep learning framework for Arabic fake news Detection, Categorization, and risk prediction
items.title_zh: ArabFake：用于阿拉伯语假新闻检测、分类和风险预测的多任务深度学习框架
items.abstract_en: The spread of fake news among Arabic media including social media represents a great challenge to the integrity of information and the trust of the public in it. In this paper, we introduce a comprehensive deep-learning framework, named ArabFake, that goes beyond the binary classification on Arabic fake news detection. ArabFake, built over MARBERTv2 (a state-of-the-art model for multi-dialectal Arabic tweets), proficiently address the complexity of the Arabic language while performing three unified tasks which are fake news detection, content categorization and its risk assessment. The framework promotes efficiency and performance both by enabling multi-task learning through shared knowledge representation across tasks. In order to facilitate development and evaluation, we present the ArabFake Dataset consisting of 2,495 manually labelled news items with labels that are verified by experts regarding fake news categories and risk levels. ArabFake demonstrates robust performance, achieving an F1 score of 94.12% for fake news detection, 84.92% for categorization, and 88.91% for risk zone assessment, highlighting its reliability and effectiveness across multiple tasks. We improve interpretability and extract insight into manipulative techniques by integrating valence scoring as part of the framework that emphasizes misleading linguistic cues used to disseminate fake news within the produced image. The results show that ArabFake is a holistic Arabic fake news detection framework that has practical implications on news organizations and fact checking projects.
items.abstract_zh: 假新闻在包括社交媒体在内的阿拉伯语媒体中传播，对信息完整性及公众对其信任构成重大挑战。本文提出一个综合性深度学习框架 ArabFake，其超越了阿拉伯语假新闻检测中的二分类。ArabFake 构建于 MARBERTv2（面向多方言阿拉伯语推文的先进模型）之上，在执行假新闻检测、内容分类及其风险评估这三项统一任务时，能够有效处理阿拉伯语的复杂性。该框架通过跨任务共享知识表示实现多任务学习，从而提升效率与性能。为便于开发与评估，我们提出 ArabFake 数据集，包含 2,495 条人工标注的新闻条目，其假新闻类别和风险等级标签经专家核验。ArabFake 表现出稳健性能，假新闻检测 F1 分数为 94.12%，分类为 84.92%，风险区域评估为 88.91%，凸显其在多项任务中的可靠性和有效性。我们将效价评分作为框架的一部分，以提升可解释性并深入洞察操纵手法，该评分强调用于在所生成图像中传播假新闻的误导性语言线索。结果表明，ArabFake 是一个整体性的阿拉伯语假新闻检测框架，对新闻机构和事实核查项目具有实际意义。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: ROSE-Drive: Runtime Orchestration and System Evolution for Autonomous Driving
items.title_zh: ROSE-Drive：自动驾驶的运行时编排与系统演化
items.abstract_en: End-to-end driving models have made substantial progress, yet reliable closed-loop driving in complex traffic remains challenging. Beyond improving individual models, system-level orchestration offers a complementary approach by coordinating driving capabilities and computation. We introduce ROSE-Drive (Runtime Orchestration and System Evolution), a model-agnostic framework that jointly orchestrates driving execution and computation. It coordinates frozen driving models with driving skills, perception tools, and feedback controllers. A distilled vision-language model (VLM) proposes driving tasks and scene relations. Shared physical state and persistent tasks support capability composition, task continuity, and adaptive scheduling. The orchestrator combines model and skill outputs across control channels, maintains task responsibility through handover, and uses execution feedback to select controllers, reuse valid motion references, and schedule model inference. Offline revisions use execution records to refine skills and their coordination through a stable task interface. Successive system stages inherit these revisions while model, perception, and VLM weights remain fixed. Evaluations with four driving models on Bench2Drive v0.0.3, Bench2Drive v0.0.4, and Fail2Drive show accumulated capability and transfer before target-benchmark revision. On held-out Longest6, driving score (DS) rises from 25 to 52 for AutoMoT and from 22 to 47 for SimLingo across system stages, while both systems skip new model inference on over 71% of control steps.
items.abstract_zh: 端到端驾驶模型已取得实质性进展，但在复杂交通中可靠的闭环驾驶仍具挑战性。除改进单个模型外，系统级编排通过协调驾驶能力与计算提供了一种补充方法。我们提出 ROSE-Drive（运行时编排与系统演化），一个与模型无关的框架，联合编排驾驶执行与计算。它协调冻结的驾驶模型与驾驶技能、感知工具和反馈控制器。一个蒸馏的视觉-语言模型（VLM）提出驾驶任务和场景关系。共享物理状态和持久任务支持能力组合、任务连续性和自适应调度。编排器跨控制通道组合模型与技能输出，通过交接维持任务责任，并利用执行反馈选择控制器、复用有效运动参考并调度模型推理。离线修订利用执行记录，通过稳定的任务接口细化技能及其协调。后续系统阶段继承这些修订，同时模型、感知和 VLM 权重保持固定。在 Bench2Drive v0.0.3、Bench2Drive v0.0.4 和 Fail2Drive 上使用四个驾驶模型进行的评估显示，在目标基准修订之前实现了能力积累和迁移。在留出的 Longest6 上，随着系统阶段推进，AutoMoT 的驾驶得分（DS）从 25 升至 52，SimLingo 从 22 升至 47，同时两个系统在超过 71% 的控制步骤中跳过新的模型推理。

items.title_en: FewRef-5: Fixed-Reference Test-Time Adaptation for Virtual Staining
items.title_zh: FewRef-5：用于虚拟染色的固定参考测试时自适应
items.abstract_en: Virtual staining synthesizes special-stain images from routine hematoxylin and eosin (H&E), extending the information available from an existing digital slide. However, a fixed inference rule can leave available real target-stain references unused, limiting query-specific correction of stain appearance at deployment. Test-time adaptation (TTA) provides a mechanism for this reference-guided, query-specific refinement without retraining the generator. We therefore propose FewRef-5, a reference-assisted TTA method for virtual staining built on StainPromptInversion. We extract tissue-masked optical-density means and standard deviations from five real Masson's trichrome (MAS) training patches and average them into a fixed stain target. A scheduled statistic-matching loss introduces this target into per-query visual-prompt optimization alongside our edge/Gram consistency penalties and the inherited reconstruction objectives. The target remains unchanged across queries, avoiding recursive dependence on earlier generated outputs while the pretrained generator stays fixed. On recorded H&E-to-MAS outputs for 1,989 queries, FewRef-5 reduces target-set FID from 183.201 to 166.904 and increases source-referenced SSIM from 0.92787 to 0.94996 relative to our Edge+Gram variant. Source PSNR and MS-SSIM decrease, showing an endpoint trade-off rather than uniformly better reconstruction.
items.abstract_zh: 虚拟染色从常规苏木精-伊红（H&E）合成特殊染色图像，扩展现有数字切片可获得的信息。然而，固定推理规则可能使可用的真实目标染色参考未被利用，限制部署时对染色外观进行查询特定校正。测试时自适应（TTA）为这种参考引导、查询特定的细化提供了无需重新训练生成器的机制。因此，我们提出 FewRef-5，一种基于 StainPromptInversion 的参考辅助虚拟染色 TTA 方法。我们从五个真实 Masson 三色（MAS）训练图像块中提取组织掩膜后的光密度均值和标准差，并将其平均为固定染色目标。一个按计划调度的统计匹配损失将该目标引入每个查询的视觉提示优化中，同时结合我们的边缘/Gram 一致性惩罚和继承的重建目标。该目标在各查询间保持不变，避免对先前生成输出的递归依赖，同时预训练生成器保持固定。在 1,989 个查询的已记录 H&E-to-MAS 输出上，相对于我们的 Edge+Gram 变体，FewRef-5 将目标集 FID 从 183.201 降至 166.904，并将源参考 SSIM 从 0.92787 提高到 0.94996。源 PSNR 和 MS-SSIM 下降，显示出端点权衡，而非一致更好的重建。

items.title_en: Nerve and vascular abnormalities precede loss of corneal transparency in Pax6-haploinsufficient mice
items.title_zh: Pax6 单倍体不足小鼠中神经和血管异常先于角膜透明性丧失
items.abstract_en: Aniridia-associated keratopathy (AAK), caused by PAX6 haploinsufficiency, progresses from a clinically clear cornea to opacity, neovascularization, and abnormal innervation, but when disease-associated changes first emerge remains unclear. We combined corneal nerve imaging, CD31 immunolabeling, transmission electron microscopy, and RNA sequencing of whole cornea from Pax6Sey-Neu/+mice at postnatal day 3-4, day 15, and adulthood. Corneal transcripts were analyzed using curated axon-guidance, myelination, and vascular/lymphatic gene panels. Mutant corneas showed reduced nerve density and persistent stromal fascicles beginning during the first postnatal week. Peripheral vascular structures were present in both genotypes at birth; these resolved during normal maturation but persisted and extended centrally in mutant corneas by two weeks, before loss of transparency. Transcriptomic analysis identified widespread differences between genotypes while both corneas remained transparent, with the strongest and most coherent changes involving vascular and lymphatic genes. Wild-type corneas silenced an endothelial and lymphatic expression program between postnatal day 15 and adulthood, whereas mutant corneas retained expression of this program. Individual axon-guidance genes differed between genotypes, but axon-guidance did not show program-level expansion in transparent corneas. Compact stromal myelin was restricted to opaque regions. These findings identify early vascular and neural abnormalities that precede corneal opacity and establish that a transparent Pax6-haploinsufficient cornea is already pathologically altered.
items.abstract_zh: 由 PAX6 单倍体不足引起的无虹膜相关角膜病变（AAK）从临床透明的角膜进展为混浊、新生血管形成和异常神经支配，但与疾病相关的改变最初何时出现仍不清楚。我们结合角膜神经成像、CD31 免疫标记、透射电子显微镜以及对出生后第 3–4 天、第 15 天和成年期 Pax6Sey-Neu/+ 小鼠全角膜的 RNA 测序。使用精选的轴突导向、髓鞘形成和血管/淋巴基因 panel 分析角膜转录本。突变角膜在出生后第一周内即显示神经密度降低和持续的基质束。两种基因型出生时均存在外周血管结构；这些结构在正常成熟过程中消退，但在突变角膜中持续存在并到两周时向中央延伸，早于透明性丧失。转录组分析在两种角膜仍透明时识别出基因型间广泛差异，其中最强且最一致的改变涉及血管和淋巴基因。野生型角膜在出生后第 15 天至成年期沉默内皮和淋巴表达程序，而突变角膜保留该程序的表达。单个轴突导向基因在基因型间存在差异，但轴突导向在透明角膜中未显示程序层面的扩张。致密的基质髓鞘仅限于混浊区域。这些发现识别出先于角膜混浊的早期血管和神经异常，并确立透明的 Pax6 单倍体不足角膜已经发生病理改变。

items.title_en: Designing Incoherent Multispectral Diffractive Optical Networks for Satellite Image Classification
items.title_zh: 设计用于卫星图像分类的非相干多光谱衍射光学网络
items.abstract_en: Optical neural networks and diffractive optical computing provide a promising route for performing task-specific inference with high parallelism and lightweight electronic post-processing. These advantages are especially attractive for multispectral satellite imaging, where conventional workflows rely on transmitting high-dimensional image cubes to the ground for downstream electronic analysis. Here, we introduce a computationally efficient surrogate model-guided framework for designing incoherent multispectral diffractive optical networks that directly output class probabilities onboard, eliminating the need to capture and transfer the full multispectral data cube for ground-side inference. We first train a physically compatible surrogate model, represented by a non-negative fully connected model that accommodates a generalized detector readout, yielding a task-specific non-negative multispectral intensity transformation that can be transferred to an optical processor. We then synthesize its diffractive counterpart through data-free point-spread-function-based optimization under spatially incoherent illumination. Using this approach, we numerically demonstrate a six-spectral-channel diffractive classifier for tri-class satellite-scene recognition, achieving a blind-testing accuracy of 79.8% for artificial surface, water body, and vegetated land images, closely approaching the 81.8% accuracy of its surrogate. We further demonstrate a more compact three-spectral-channel design that numerically achieves 72.7% blind-testing accuracy, compared with 75.1% for its corresponding surrogate model. This surrogate model-guided strategy provides a practical pathway for designing compact, task-specific incoherent multispectral optical processors for resource-constrained remote-sensing inference.
items.abstract_zh: 光学神经网络和衍射光学计算为以高并行度和轻量电子后处理执行任务特定推理提供了一条有前景的途径。这些优势对多光谱卫星成像尤其有吸引力，因为传统工作流依赖将高维图像立方体传输到地面以进行下游电子分析。在此，我们引入一种计算高效的代理模型引导框架，用于设计非相干多光谱衍射光学网络，该网络直接在星上输出类别概率，从而无需捕获和传输完整多光谱数据立方体以进行地面侧推理。我们首先训练一个物理兼容的代理模型，由非负全连接模型表示，该模型容纳广义探测器读出，产生可迁移到光学处理器的任务特定非负多光谱强度变换。然后，我们通过空间非相干照明下基于无数据点扩散函数的优化来合成其衍射对应物。使用该方法，我们在数值上演示了一个用于三类卫星场景识别的六光谱通道衍射分类器，在人工地表、水体和植被土地图像上达到 79.8% 的盲测准确率，接近其代理模型的 81.8% 准确率。我们进一步演示了一个更紧凑的三光谱通道设计，在数值上达到 72.7% 的盲测准确率，而其对应代理模型为 75.1%。这种代理模型引导策略为设计用于资源受限遥感推理的紧凑、任务特定非相干多光谱光学处理器提供了实用路径。

items.title_en: PHM-ensemble: Scalable and Stable Probabilistic Multiresolution Clustering via Ensemble Density Estimation
items.title_zh: PHM-ensemble：通过集成密度估计实现可扩展且稳定的概率多分辨率聚类
items.abstract_en: Clustering is a foundational tool for exploratory data analysis across the sciences. We argue that clustering methods should be evaluated along four dimensions: fidelity to the data's underlying structure, interpretability of the recovered groups, stability under data perturbations and algorithmic randomness, and scalability to modern scientific datasets. Yet existing methods rarely satisfy all four criteria. To address this gap, we introduce PHM-ensemble, a general probabilistic framework for multiresolution clustering that estimates the underlying data density by pooling mixture models from an ensemble of fits and subsequently constructs a clustering hierarchy through hierarchical merging of the mixture components. On simulated datasets and the MNIST benchmark, PHM-ensemble matches or outperforms widely used clustering algorithms in agreement with ground truth, produces more stable results across runs, and reveals complex underlying structures. Applied to 1.82 million peripheral blood cells from the Human Immune Health Atlas, PHM-ensemble achieves higher agreement with expert-curated major cell-type annotations than the Leiden clustering used in the original study (adjusted Rand index 0.965 versus 0.789), while requiring only half the computing time. Beyond identifying major immune lineages, it reveals biologically coherent relationships among cell types and resolves finer structure within individual lineages, uncovering subtypes and cellular states consistent with known biology.
items.abstract_zh: 聚类是跨科学领域探索性数据分析的基础工具。我们认为，聚类方法应沿四个维度评估：对数据底层结构的保真度、所恢复分组的可解释性、在数据扰动和算法随机性下的稳定性，以及可扩展到现代科学数据集的能力。然而，现有方法很少同时满足全部四项标准。为弥补这一空白，我们提出 PHM-ensemble，一种用于多分辨率聚类的通用概率框架，它通过汇集来自一组拟合的混合模型来估计底层数据密度，随后通过混合成分的层次合并构建聚类层次。在模拟数据集和 MNIST 基准上，PHM-ensemble 在与真实标签的一致性方面匹配或优于广泛使用的聚类算法，在多次运行中产生更稳定的结果，并揭示复杂的底层结构。应用于来自 Human Immune Health Atlas 的 182 万个外周血细胞时，PHM-ensemble 与专家整理的主要细胞类型注释的一致性高于原研究使用的 Leiden 聚类（调整兰德指数 0.965 对 0.789），同时仅需一半计算时间。除识别主要免疫谱系外，它揭示细胞类型之间生物学上一致的关系，并解析单个谱系内的更精细结构，发现与已知生物学一致的亚型和细胞状态。

items.title_en: RightDiff: Learning Generative Reward Models to Judge by the Right Differences
items.title_zh: RightDiff：学习按正确差异进行评判的生成式奖励模型
items.abstract_en: Generative reward models typically rely on generic query-level rubrics or unconstrained rationales, overlooking the fact that pairwise preference is driven by response-specific differences. Moreover, optimizing solely for outcome correctness encourages models to exploit superficial shortcuts such as verbosity and formatting, triggering rationale drift. To address this, we propose RightDiff, which structures pairwise evaluation into an evidence-grounded evaluation trajectory executed in a single autoregressive generation. RightDiff explicitly discovers contrastive differences between candidates, categorizes them into material or immaterial factors, and induces pair-specific rubrics before final adjudication. To train this process without post-hoc rationalization, we synthesize demonstration data via response-isolated prompts and optimize the reward model with a difference-alignment reward regularized by budget-constrained one-to-one matching and multiplicative gating. RightDiff achieves state-of-the-art preference modeling performance on RewardBench and RM-Bench, surpassing all open-source reward models and leading proprietary LLM judges. Downstream, it provides reliable supervision for direct preference optimization on Arena-Hard and AlpacaEval while effectively resisting length shortcuts.
items.abstract_zh: 生成式奖励模型通常依赖通用的查询级评分标准或不受约束的理由，忽视了成对偏好由响应特定差异驱动这一事实。此外，仅针对结果正确性进行优化会鼓励模型利用冗长和格式等表面捷径，引发理由漂移。为解决这一问题，我们提出 RightDiff，它将成对评估结构化为在单次自回归生成中执行的基于证据的评估轨迹。RightDiff 显式发现候选之间的对比差异，将其归类为实质性或非实质性因素，并在最终裁决前归纳出针对每对的评分标准。为在没有事后合理化的情况下训练该过程，我们通过响应隔离提示合成演示数据，并使用由预算约束的一对一匹配和乘性门控正则化的差异对齐奖励来优化奖励模型。RightDiff 在 RewardBench 和 RM-Bench 上取得最先进的偏好建模性能，超越所有开源奖励模型并领先专有 LLM 评判器。在下游，它为 Arena-Hard 和 AlpacaEval 上的直接偏好优化提供可靠监督，同时有效抵抗长度捷径。

items.title_en: SAGE-Drive: Benefit-Aware Adaptive Reasoning for Autonomous Driving Planning
items.title_zh: SAGE-Drive：面向自动驾驶规划的收益感知自适应推理
items.abstract_en: Explicit reasoning enables autonomous vehicles (AVs) to interpret complex traffic interactions and support trajectory planning, but introduces additional computational demands. Determining when explicit reasoning can improve planning accuracy remains a key challenge, as its benefits vary across driving scenarios. To address this challenge, this study proposes Scene-Adaptive Gating of Explicit Reasoning for Driving (SAGE-Drive), a benefit-aware adaptive reasoning framework for autonomous driving planning. First, paired planning outcomes with and without explicit reasoning are analyzed to measure the reasoning benefit, i.e., the reduction in planning error achieved by explicit reasoning, which serves as the supervision label. SAGE-Drive then learns to predict these benefits using geometric features of the initial trajectory planned without reasoning and multimodal scene information, and invokes explicit reasoning only for the scenarios with the highest predicted benefits under a predefined reasoning budget. Experiments on 1,497 paired driving scenarios reveal that explicit reasoning improves planning accuracy in 53.5% of cases while degrading it in 46.5%, yielding a near-zero average benefit. On the test set, with a 20% reasoning budget, SAGE-Drive achieves an average displacement error (ADE) of 1.5191 m, compared with 1.5252 m for random selection. At a 35% budget, it achieves an ADE of 1.5148 m, close to the 1.5141 m obtained when reasoning is applied to every scenario. These findings establish the predicted reasoning benefit as an effective criterion for reasoning selection, allowing explicit reasoning to be invoked where it improves planning accuracy at a fraction of its computational cost.
items.abstract_zh: 显式推理使自动驾驶车辆（AV）能够解释复杂交通交互并支持轨迹规划，但引入额外计算需求。确定显式推理何时能提高规划准确性仍是一个关键挑战，因为其收益因驾驶场景而异。为应对这一挑战，本研究提出用于驾驶的显式推理场景自适应门控（SAGE-Drive），一种面向自动驾驶规划的收益感知自适应推理框架。首先，分析有和无显式推理的成对规划结果以度量推理收益，即显式推理带来的规划误差降低，并将其作为监督标签。SAGE-Drive 随后学习使用无推理规划得到的初始轨迹的几何特征和多模态场景信息来预测这些收益，并在预定义推理预算下仅对预测收益最高的场景调用显式推理。在 1,497 个成对驾驶场景上的实验表明，显式推理在 53.5% 的情况下提高规划准确性，而在 46.5% 的情况下降低准确性，平均收益接近零。在测试集上，以 20% 推理预算，SAGE-Drive 达到 1.5191 m 的平均位移误差（ADE），而随机选择为 1.5252 m。以 35% 预算，它达到 1.5148 m 的 ADE，接近对每个场景都应用推理时的 1.5141 m。这些发现确立预测推理收益作为推理选择的有效标准，使显式推理能够在提高规划准确性之处以一小部分计算成本被调用。

items.title_en: Adaptive and Detection-Aware Super-Resolution for Small Object Detection
items.title_zh: 面向小目标检测的自适应与检测感知超分辨率
items.abstract_en: Image super-resolution aims to reconstruct a high-resolution image from a low-resolution input and is relevant for surveillance, satellite imagery, medical imaging, and object detection. This paper investigates SRCNN-based single-image super-resolution for a scale factor of x4, starting from a classical baseline and progressively introducing residual learning, Charbonnier loss, and adaptive loss functions. The proposed approach includes a three-region adaptive loss, where image areas are divided into smooth, texture, and edge regions using gradient information. The models are evaluated using PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, and EdgeMAE in order to measure both reconstruction quality and structural detail preservation. In addition to reconstruction evaluation, the paper analyzes the impact of super-resolution on object detection. A YOLOv8 detector is applied to images processed through bicubic interpolation and SRCNN-based variants, using images from the COCO validation dataset. The results show that improved reconstruction quality does not always lead to better detection performance. However, for small objects, a detection-aware variant combined with residual scaling improves the F1 score compared to the bicubic baseline. These results highlight the importance of task-aware evaluation when super-resolution is used in computer vision pipelines.
items.abstract_zh: 图像超分辨率旨在从低分辨率输入重建高分辨率图像，适用于监控、卫星影像、医学成像和目标检测。本文研究基于SRCNN的单图像超分辨率，比例因子为x4，从经典基线开始，逐步引入残差学习、Charbonnier损失和自适应损失函数。所提方法包含三区域自适应损失，其中利用梯度信息将图像区域划分为平滑、纹理和边缘区域。模型使用PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS和EdgeMAE进行评估，以衡量重建质量和结构细节保持情况。除重建评估外，本文还分析超分辨率对目标检测的影响。使用COCO验证数据集中的图像，将YOLOv8检测器应用于经双三次插值和基于SRCNN的变体处理后的图像。结果表明，重建质量提高并不总能带来更好的检测性能。然而，对于小目标，结合残差缩放的检测感知变体相比双三次基线提高了F1分数。这些结果凸显了在计算机视觉流程中使用超分辨率时任务感知评估的重要性。

items.title_en: Distinguishing Social Isolation, Social Support, and Contextual False Positives in Clinical Notes Using Fine-Tuned Language Models: Multisite Validation Study
items.title_zh: 使用微调语言模型区分临床记录中的社会隔离、社会支持与上下文假阳性：多站点验证研究
items.abstract_en: Background: Social isolation and social support are clinically important but inconsistently represented in structured electronic health record data. Their identification from clinical narratives is complicated by nuanced, context-dependent language and by variation in how social connectedness is documented across clinical settings, patient populations, and geographic locations. Models intended for health care use must therefore distinguish social isolation from documented support, negation, ambiguous social circumstances, and non-social clinical uses of similar terminology while remaining robust to differences in documentation practices. Objective: This study aimed to develop and evaluate locally deployable, fine-tuned language models for context-aware classification of social isolation, social support, and contextually similar non-relevant clinical text across multiple health systems. Materials and Methods: We conducted a retrospective study using electronic health record data from 326,847 adults aged 50 years or older who received care at 3 Tennessee health systems from 2020 to 2023. Candidate clinical text was identified using social-environment ICD-10-CM Z codes and an established social isolation lexicon. Human annotators classified 9,748 spans from 9,578 clinical notes contributed by 6,881 patients as social isolation, social support, or no social isolation. The annotated corpus included social isolation and support concepts including negations, infection-control and microbiology terminology, institutional living arrangements, and other contextually ambiguous examples. FLAN-T5-Large, BERT, RoBERTa, and Gemma-2-2B were fine-tuned for 3-class span classification. Full fine-tuning and parameter-efficient fine-tuning using low-rank adaptation approaches were evaluated for the best performing model, FLAN-T5-Large. Performance was assessed using site-based internal-external cross-validation, with macro-F1 as the primary metric. Results: The annotated corpus included 2,318 social isolation spans, 638 social support spans, and 6,792 spans classified as no social isolation. Fully fine-tuned FLAN-T5-Large achieved the best performance, with a mean macro-F1 of 0.90 (SD 0.01). Class-specific F1 scores were 0.85 (SD 0.03) for social isolation, 0.87 (SD 0.04) for social support, and 0.96 (SD 0.02) for no social isolation. Gemma-2-2B achieved a macro-F1 of 0.85 (SD 0.01), compared with 0.84 (SD 0.06) for RoBERTa and 0.86 (SD 0.06) for BERT. Full fine-tuning also outperformed parameter-efficient fine-tuning in secondary pooled analyses (macro-F1 0.93 vs 0.90) in the corresponding held-out evaluation for the FLAN-T5-Large model. Remaining errors primarily involved patients who lived alone but received assistance, family presence without meaningful support, grief-related language, and non-social clinical uses of isolation terminology. Conclusions: Fine-tuned language models can distinguish social isolation, social support, and contextually similar but unrelated language across heterogeneous clinical settings. FLAN-T5-Large provided the strongest and most stable performance, including for the less frequent social support class. The 3-class annotation framework, inclusion of difficult negative examples, and multisite evaluation offer a practical approach for converting nuanced social-connectedness documentation into structured data. Further work should evaluate end-to-end identification in unselected clinical notes and prospective integration into clinical and population health workflows.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：社会隔离和社会支持具有临床重要性，但在结构化电子健康记录数据中的表示并不一致。从临床叙述中识别这些概念较为复杂，原因在于语言细微且依赖上下文，以及不同临床环境、患者群体和地理位置对社会连接性的记录方式存在差异。因此，拟用于医疗保健的模型必须区分社会隔离与已记录的支持、否定、模糊的社会境况以及类似术语的非社会性临床用法，同时要对记录实践的差异保持稳健。目的：本研究旨在开发并评估可本地部署的微调语言模型，用于在多个卫生系统中对社会隔离、社会支持以及上下文相似但无关的临床文本进行上下文感知分类。材料与方法：我们开展了一项回顾性研究，使用电子健康记录数据，纳入2020年至2023年在田纳西州3个卫生系统接受医疗服务的326,847名50岁及以上成年人。候选临床文本通过社会环境ICD-10-CM Z代码和既有的社会隔离词表识别。人工标注者将来自6,881名患者贡献的9,578份临床记录中的9,748个文本片段分类为社会隔离、社会支持或无社会隔离。标注语料包含社会隔离和支持概念，包括否定、感染控制和微生物学术语、机构居住安排以及其他上下文模糊示例。对FLAN-T5-Large、BERT、RoBERTa和Gemma-2-2B进行微调，用于三分类文本片段分类。对表现最佳的模型FLAN-T5-Large评估了全量微调以及使用低秩适配方法的参数高效微调。性能采用基于站点的内部-外部交叉验证评估，以macro-F1为主要指标。结果：标注语料包括2,318个社会隔离文本片段、638个社会支持文本片段和6,792个被分类为无社会隔离的文本片段。全量微调的FLAN-T5-Large表现最佳，平均macro-F1为0.90（SD 0.01）。各类别F1分数分别为：社会隔离0.85（SD 0.03）、社会支持0.87（SD 0.04）、无社会隔离0.96（SD 0.02）。Gemma-2-2B的macro-F1为0.85（SD 0.01），RoBERTa为0.84（SD 0.06），BERT为0.86（SD 0.06）。在FLAN-T5-Large模型相应的留出评估中，二次汇总分析显示全量微调也优于参数高效微调（macro-F1 0.93对0.90）。剩余错误主要涉及独居但获得帮助的患者、家人陪伴但无实质性支持、与悲伤相关的语言，以及隔离术语的非社会性临床用法。结论：微调语言模型能够在异质临床环境中区分社会隔离、社会支持以及上下文相似但无关的语言。FLAN-T5-Large提供了最强且最稳定的性能，包括对较少见的社会支持类别。三分类标注框架、纳入困难负例以及多站点评估，为将细微的社会连接性记录转化为结构化数据提供了一种实用方法。进一步工作应评估在未筛选临床记录中的端到端识别，并评估其前瞻性整合到临床和人群健康工作流程中。

items.title_en: Robust growth of $α$-tantalum on sapphire at room temperature using atomically thin titanium seed layer
items.title_zh: 使用原子级薄钛种子层在室温下蓝宝石上稳健生长α-钽
items.abstract_en: Tantalum (Ta) based superconducting circuits have attracted attention for their low microwave loss. However, reproducible growth of high-quality $α$-phase Ta films remains challenging because film properties are highly sensitive to growth conditions. We present a robust, room-temperature route for $α$-Ta growth on sapphire substrates using an ultrathin Ti seed layer, which significantly widens the accessible deposition parameter space. We compare this approach to Ta films grown at high temperature without a seed layer and at room temperature with a Nb seed. We assess films using structural and surface characterization and quantify microwave loss with coplanar-waveguide (CPW) resonators measured in the quantum regime. We obtain two-level-system (TLS)-limited quality factors comparable to the state of the art for Ta-on-sapphire CPW resonators with similar geometries. In addition, temperature-dependent measurements reveal that high-temperature-grown films and films subjected to extended buffered-oxide etch treatment exhibit additional temperature activated loss, highlighting the role of growth route and post-processing in microwave performance. Our results establish ultrathin seed-layer engineering as a reliable alternative route to reproducible, low-loss $α$-Ta films and motivate closer study of the interfacial mechanisms that govern Ta phase formation.
items.abstract_zh: 基于钽（Ta）的超导电路因其低微波损耗而受到关注。然而，高质量α相Ta薄膜的可重复生长仍然具有挑战性，因为薄膜性质对生长条件高度敏感。我们提出一种稳健的室温路线，使用超薄Ti种子层在蓝宝石衬底上生长α-Ta，这显著拓宽了可用的沉积参数空间。我们将该方法与无种子层高温生长的Ta薄膜以及使用Nb种子室温生长的Ta薄膜进行比较。我们通过结构和表面表征评估薄膜，并使用在量子区域测量的共面波导（CPW）谐振器量化微波损耗。我们获得了与相似几何结构的Ta-on-sapphire CPW谐振器当前最先进水平相当的、受二能级系统（TLS）限制的品质因数。此外，变温测量揭示，高温生长的薄膜和经过延长缓冲氧化物刻蚀处理的薄膜表现出额外的温度激活损耗，凸显了生长路线和后处理在微波性能中的作用。我们的结果确立了超薄种子层工程作为一种可靠替代路线，可用于可重复的低损耗α-Ta薄膜，并推动对控制Ta相形成的界面机制进行更深入研究。

items.title_en: File Size as a Potential Dataset Bias in Audio-Visual Deepfake Data
items.title_zh: 文件大小作为视听深度伪造数据中的潜在数据集偏差
items.abstract_en: Deepfake detection benchmarks are commonly designed to evaluate whether models can distinguish authentic from manipulated audiovisual content. However, benchmark construction pipelines may introduce unintended associations between class labels and simple file-level properties. In this work, we identify a potential file-size bias in two widely used audio-visual deepfake datasets. In the 1M-Deepfakes Detection Challenge dataset, a score derived from file size alone achieves 70.13% AUC on the validation set. When file size is considered together with video duration, simple file-level methods exceed 90% AUC on 1M and 85% AUC on FakeAVCeleb. Although the same pattern is not observed in DFDC, the results suggest that the observed association is dataset-dependent rather than an inherent property of deepfake videos. We discuss several possible explanations, including differences in encoding, compression, source data, manipulation procedures, and post-processing, although the present analysis does not establish the underlying cause. We further discuss whether the factors associated with file size may also leave traces in decoded video or audio, and consequently whether they could influence content-based deepfake detection, as an important direction for future work. Our findings highlight the importance of examining simple file-level properties when constructing and evaluating deepfake datasets and benchmarks.
items.abstract_zh: 深度伪造检测基准通常旨在评估模型能否区分真实与操纵的视听内容。然而，基准构建流程可能引入类别标签与简单文件级属性之间的非预期关联。在本工作中，我们在两个广泛使用的视听深度伪造数据集中识别出一种潜在的文件大小偏差。在1M-Deepfakes Detection Challenge数据集中，仅由文件大小得出的分数在验证集上达到70.13% AUC。当将文件大小与视频时长一起考虑时，简单文件级方法在1M上超过90% AUC，在FakeAVCeleb上超过85% AUC。尽管在DFDC中未观察到相同模式，结果表明所观察到的关联依赖于数据集，而非深度伪造视频的固有属性。我们讨论了几种可能解释，包括编码、压缩、源数据、操纵程序和后处理的差异，尽管当前分析并未确定 underlying cause。我们进一步讨论了与文件大小相关的因素是否也可能在解码视频或音频中留下痕迹，并因此是否可能影响基于内容的深度伪造检测，作为未来工作的重要方向。我们的发现凸显了在构建和评估深度伪造数据集与基准时检查简单文件级属性的重要性。

items.title_en: Making Evaluation Explicit Is Not Enough: Supervising the Evaluation Process in Generative Reward Models
items.title_zh: 使评估显式化还不够：在生成式奖励模型中监督评估过程
items.abstract_en: Generative reward models (GRMs) make language-model evaluation more explicit by generating critiques, rubrics, or intermediate analyses before predicting a final preference. However, explicit evaluation does not necessarily imply a reliable evaluation process: under outcome-only supervision, a model may reach the correct final preference while producing weak or unsupported intermediate judgments, turning the evaluation into a post-hoc rationalization. We introduce STEP-GRM, a framework that directly supervises the intermediate evaluation process of rubric-based GRMs. In addition to conventional preference supervision, STEP-GRM provides structural guidance for rubric construction and local supervision for criterion-level judgments, encouraging the model to learn not only the correct final preference but also a more reliable process for reaching it. Extensive experiments show that STEP-GRM achieves strong performance on standard reward-modeling benchmarks while improving the consistency and correctness of intermediate evaluations. Moreover, reward signals produced by STEP-GRM lead to better downstream policy optimization, demonstrating that more reliable evaluation processes can translate into practical gains beyond reward-model accuracy.
items.abstract_zh: 生成式奖励模型（GRM）通过在预测最终偏好之前生成批评、评分标准或中间分析，使语言模型评估更加显式。然而，显式评估并不必然意味着可靠的评估过程：在仅结果监督下，模型可能达到正确的最终偏好，同时产生薄弱或无支持的中间判断，使评估变成事后合理化。我们提出STEP-GRM，一个直接监督基于评分标准的GRM中间评估过程的框架。除传统偏好监督外，STEP-GRM为评分标准构建提供结构指导，并为准则级判断提供局部监督，鼓励模型不仅学习正确的最终偏好，还学习更可靠的达到该偏好的过程。大量实验表明，STEP-GRM在标准奖励建模基准上取得强劲性能，同时提高中间评估的一致性和正确性。此外，STEP-GRM产生的奖励信号带来更好的下游策略优化，表明更可靠的评估过程可以转化为超越奖励模型准确率的实际收益。

items.title_en: At the Limit: Autonomous Vehicle Drifting under Generative Policies
items.title_zh: 极限工况下：生成式策略下的自动驾驶车辆漂移
items.abstract_en: Autonomous drifting requires agile control despite tire-force saturation and highly nonlinear vehicle dynamics. We propose an online reinforcement learning method for flow policies that combines stochastic differential equation (SDE) sampling for exploration with value-based policy optimization. This method supports both training from scratch and fine-tuning a policy pretrained on expert demonstrations. After training, control actions can be generated using either SDEs or ordinary differential equations (ODEs). Experiments on circular and eight-shaped drifting in an F1TENTH digital twin platform show that both training strategies can achieve effective real-time drift control, with tighter tracking, higher success rates, and better robustness under noisy conditions.
items.abstract_zh: 自动驾驶漂移需要在轮胎力饱和和高度非线性车辆动力学下实现敏捷控制。我们提出一种用于流策略的在线强化学习方法，将随机微分方程（SDE）采样用于探索与基于价值的策略优化相结合。该方法支持从头训练以及对在专家示范上预训练的策略进行微调。训练后，控制动作可以使用SDE或常微分方程（ODE）生成。在F1TENTH数字孪生平台上的圆形和八字形漂移实验表明，两种训练策略都能实现有效的实时漂移控制，并在噪声条件下具有更紧的跟踪、更高的成功率和更好的鲁棒性。

items.title_en: DiaCap: Jointly Learning Who Speaks When for Audiovisual Dialogue Captioning
items.title_zh: DiaCap：为音视频对话字幕联合学习“谁在何时说话”
items.abstract_en: We present DiaCap, an audiovisual LLM for comprehensive dialogue captioning, which produces the transcript, timestamps, and a visual description of the speaker for every utterance in a video. Considering that utterance timing and audiovisual diarization are tightly coupled, DiaCap unifies the tasks in a single model, trained in two complementary stages. First, we train DiaCap on 225K curated clips, using synthetic captions that densely label every utterance in detail. Second, we further refine the model via reinforcement learning on 2.9K human-corrected clips, using fine-grained feedback that directly evaluates utterance timing, speaker grouping, and speaker binding. On DiaDemBench, which we extend with utterance-level timestamps and subtitle redaction, both DiaCap with off-the-shelf transcripts and its end-to-end variant DiaCap-E2E achieve strong results. Specifically, DiaCap performs on par with Gemini 4 Argon in audiovisual diarization while clearly outperforming it in timestamp accuracy (76.59 vs. 42.76 TIME). It also maintains strong diarization on multilingual and minute-long videos, and transfers to audiovisual question answering.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 DiaCap，一种用于全面对话字幕的音视频 LLM，它为视频中的每句话生成转录文本、时间戳以及说话人的视觉描述。考虑到话语时序与音视频说话人日志紧密耦合，DiaCap 在单一模型中统一了这些任务，并分两个互补阶段训练。首先，我们在 225K 个整理过的片段上训练 DiaCap，使用对每句话进行详细密集标注的合成字幕。其次，我们通过强化学习在 2.9K 个人工校正片段上进一步优化模型，使用直接评估话语时序、说话人分组和说话人绑定的细粒度反馈。在 DiaDemBench 上（我们为其扩展了话语级时间戳和字幕脱敏），使用现成转录文本的 DiaCap 及其端到端变体 DiaCap-E2E 均取得强结果。具体而言，DiaCap 在音视频说话人日志方面与 Gemini 4 Argon 表现相当，同时在时间戳准确率上明显优于后者（76.59 对 42.76 TIME）。它还在多语言和分钟级长视频上保持较强的说话人日志能力，并可迁移到音视频问答。

items.title_en: DDB2 localizes to the nucleolus to mediate oxaliplatin resistance in colorectal cancer
items.title_zh: DDB2 定位于核仁以介导结直肠癌中的奥沙利铂耐药
items.abstract_en: Despite the widespread use of platinum drugs in cancer therapy, defining their mechanisms of action and predicting clinical outcomes remain challenging. Unlike cisplatin, which kills cells mainly through the DNA damage response, oxaliplatin toxicity is driven largely by nucleolar stress, yet how cells cope with this stress remains poorly understood. A nucleotide excision repair protein, damage-specific DNA binding protein 2 (DDB2), protects cells from oxaliplatin but not cisplatin, suggesting that it may preferentially engage oxaliplatin adducts. Using single-molecule analysis of DNA-binding proteins from nuclear extracts, we show that DDB2 binds both oxaliplatin and cisplatin intrastrand adducts. Oxaliplatin, but not cisplatin, drives progressive accumulation of DDB2 in nucleoli, pointing to a role at sites of oxaliplatin-induced nucleolar stress. The repair-deficient xeroderma pigmentosum group E K244E variant localizes to nucleoli but fails to rescue oxaliplatin sensitivity of DDB2-knockout cells, indicating that repair activity, not nucleolar localization alone, is required for protection. In colorectal cancer (CRC), elevated DDB2 levels correlate with higher oxaliplatin IC50, are higher in tumors than adjacent normal tissue by immunohistochemistry, and DDB2 transcript associates with non-response and shorter progression-free survival in FOLFOX-treated patients. Pharmacological inactivation or degradation of DDB2 synergizes with oxaliplatin, offering a biomarker-driven strategy to overcome chemoresistance.
items.abstract_zh: 尽管铂类药物广泛用于癌症治疗，但确定其作用机制并预测临床结局仍然具有挑战性。与主要通过 DNA 损伤应答杀伤细胞的顺铂不同，奥沙利铂的毒性在很大程度上由核仁应激驱动，然而细胞如何应对这种应激仍知之甚少。核苷酸切除修复蛋白——损伤特异性 DNA 结合蛋白 2（DDB2）保护细胞免受奥沙利铂而非顺铂的杀伤，提示它可能优先结合奥沙利铂加合物。利用核提取物中 DNA 结合蛋白的单分子分析，我们表明 DDB2 可结合奥沙利铂和顺铂的链内加合物。奥沙利铂（而非顺铂）驱动 DDB2 在核仁中逐步积累，指向其在奥沙利铂诱导的核仁应激部位发挥作用。修复缺陷的着色性干皮病 E 组 K244E 变异体定位于核仁，但无法恢复 DDB2 敲除细胞对奥沙利铂的敏感性，表明保护作用需要修复活性，而不仅是核仁定位。在结直肠癌（CRC）中，DDB2 水平升高与更高的奥沙利铂 IC50 相关，免疫组化显示肿瘤中的 DDB2 水平高于邻近正常组织，并且 DDB2 转录本与 FOLFOX 治疗患者的无应答和较短无进展生存期相关。对 DDB2 的药理学失活或降解与奥沙利铂协同，提供了一种生物标志物驱动的克服化疗耐药策略。

items.title_en: Signatures of Kitaev quantum spin liquid states in $α$-RuCl$_3$ revealed by nitrogen-vacancy spin-noise spectroscopy
items.title_zh: 氮空位自旋噪声谱揭示 α-RuCl3 中 Kitaev 量子自旋液体态的签名
items.abstract_en: Bond-dependent magnetic interactions, strong spin-orbit coupling, and quantum fluctuations in $α$-RuCl$_3$ make it an archetypical candidate for exotic Kitaev quantum spin liquid (QSL) states. While electronic transport, neutron scattering, optical and tunneling spectroscopies were used to probe global QSL signatures in large scale $α$-RuCl$_3$ samples, nanoscale evidence of local QSL behavior via a non-invasive experimental probe is still missing. Here, we use diamond nitrogen-vacancy (NV) spin-noise spectroscopy to probe QSL states in α-RuCl3 nanoflakes with thicknesses ranging from 8 to 150 nm over a temperature range of 4.3-250 K. Our measurements reveal a pronounced decrease in the NV spin-lattice relaxation time ($T_{1}$) below ~100 K in proximity to the $α$-RuCl$_3$ flakes, indicating enhanced GHz-frequency magnetic fluctuations. This temperature scale is consistent with the energy scale associated with Kitaev interactions (~8 meV) and the emergence of low-energy fractionalized excitations. Below 50 K, thicker (> 90 nm) flakes exhibit a distinct bi-exponential $T_{1}$ decay, unlike the single-exponential behavior observed for off-flake and thinner (8 nm) flake measurements, suggesting an increasingly heterogeneous magnetic noise environment. These results establish NV spin-noise spectroscopy as a local, non-invasive probe of low-energy spin dynamics in $α$-RuCl$_3$ nanoflakes and open a route to testing predicted noise signatures of fractionalized excitations in atomically thin QSL candidates.
items.abstract_zh: α-RuCl3 中键依赖的磁相互作用、强自旋轨道耦合和量子涨落使其成为奇异 Kitaev 量子自旋液体（QSL）态的典型候选。电子输运、中子散射、光学和隧穿谱已被用于探测大规模 α-RuCl3 样品中的全局 QSL 签名，但通过非侵入式实验探针获得局部 QSL 行为的纳米尺度证据仍然缺失。在这里，我们使用金刚石氮空位（NV）自旋噪声谱，在 4.3–250 K 温度范围内探测厚度为 8 至 150 nm 的 α-RuCl3 纳米片中的 QSL 态。我们的测量显示，在约 100 K 以下，靠近 α-RuCl3 纳米片的 NV 自旋-晶格弛豫时间（T1）显著降低，表明 GHz 频率磁涨落增强。该温标与 Kitaev 相互作用相关的能量尺度（约 8 meV）以及低能分数化激发的出现相一致。在 50 K 以下，较厚（>90 nm）的纳米片表现出明显的双指数 T1 衰减，不同于片外和较薄（8 nm）纳米片测量中观察到的单指数行为，提示磁噪声环境日益不均匀。这些结果确立了 NV 自旋噪声谱作为 α-RuCl3 纳米片中低能自旋动力学的局部、非侵入式探针，并为在原子级薄 QSL 候选材料中检验分数化激发的预测噪声签名开辟了途径。

items.title_en: PtychoFM: A Foundation Model for Ptychographic Imaging
items.title_zh: PtychoFM：叠层成像的基础模型
items.abstract_en: Ptychography provides high-resolution lensless imaging across X-ray, electron, and optical microscopy, but reconstructing images from diffraction measurements generally requires computationally intensity iterative phase retrieval. These methods often require experiment-specific analysis, limiting real-time feedback as data acquisition rates increase. Here, we demonstrate PtychoFM, a physics-aware foundation model for ptychographic imaging that combines large-scale pre-training with experiment-specific fine-tuning to reconstruct complex object images directly from individual diffraction patterns. Trained using a differentiable forward model without object-space labels, PtychoFM transfers from step-scan training data on one sample to fly-scan measurements of other samples with different feature sizes, morphologies, and refraction indices. At a synchrotron beamline, diffraction frames were streamed from the detector to a single GPU for inference at up to 200 frames per second and returned for real-time visualization. PtychoFM provides a practical route to rapid, transferable ptychographic reconstruction and live experimental feedback under nonideal conditions.
items.abstract_zh: 叠层成像可在 X 射线、电子和光学显微术中提供高分辨率无透镜成像，但从衍射测量重建图像通常需要计算密集的迭代相位恢复。这些方法往往需要针对具体实验的分析，随着数据采集速率提高，限制了实时反馈。在此，我们展示 PtychoFM，一种用于叠层成像的物理感知基础模型，它结合大规模预训练与实验特定微调，可直接从单个衍射图重建复杂物体图像。PtychoFM 使用可微前向模型训练，无需物体空间标签，可从一种样品的步进扫描训练数据迁移到具有不同特征尺寸、形貌和折射率的其他样品的飞行扫描测量。在同步辐射光束线上，衍射帧从探测器流式传输到单个 GPU 进行推理，速度最高达每秒 200 帧，并返回用于实时可视化。PtychoFM 为在非理想条件下实现快速、可迁移的叠层重建和实时实验反馈提供了实用途径。

items.title_en: TACT-Bench: Testing Adaptive Conversational Threats against Tool-Use Agents
items.title_zh: TACT-Bench：测试针对工具使用智能体的自适应对话威胁
items.abstract_en: The growing autonomy of AI agents in using external tools and making decisions has created an urgent need for comprehensive safety benchmarks. Existing benchmarks test compromised tool channels or adaptive multi-turn attacks, though they may not capture the unique capabilities of policy-governed tool-use agents, which must resist unauthorized requests without abandoning the legitimate work embedded in the same interaction. To fill this gap, we introduce TACT-Bench, a stateful benchmark built around scenario-specific stories, personas, manipulation tactics, and response-adaptive escalation. Each adversarial task targets an action explicitly prohibited by the policy provided to the assistant, while the policy remains hidden from the attacking user. TACT pairs each adversarial task with at least one benign counterpart, and its adversarial tasks retain authorized ground-truth actions when a compliant resolution remains available. We define these base tasks as TACT-Base. We additionally introduce TACT-TrustPrime, which places an independent benign task before an unrelated attack in the same conversation. We also propose Paired Selective Trustworthiness (PST), which combines explicit safe refusal with demonstrated capability on matched benign tasks, to analyze an agent's overcautiousness and practicality. Averaged across 6 different models as assistants, TACT-Base raises Attack-Induced Failure Rate (AFR) by 17.53% over four compatible attack baselines, and TACT-TrustPrime raises it by a further 17.01%. The two evaluated defense methods reduce AFR by only 8.35%--9.41% on average and do not consistently improve PST, underscoring the need for stronger policy-enforcement methods.
items.abstract_zh: AI 智能体在使用外部工具和做出决策方面自主性不断增强，迫切需要全面的安全基准。现有基准测试被攻陷的工具通道或自适应多轮攻击，但可能无法捕捉受策略约束的工具使用智能体的独特能力，这类智能体必须在不放弃同一交互中嵌入的合法工作的情况下抵御未授权请求。为填补这一空白，我们引入 TACT-Bench，一个围绕场景特定故事、人物设定、操纵策略和响应自适应升级构建的有状态基准。每个对抗任务都针对提供给助手的策略明确禁止的动作，而该策略对攻击用户保持隐藏。TACT 为每个对抗任务配对至少一个良性对应任务，并且当仍存在合规解决方案时，其对抗任务保留授权的真实动作。我们将这些基础任务定义为 TACT-Base。我们还引入 TACT-TrustPrime，它在同一对话中把独立的良性任务置于无关攻击之前。我们还提出配对选择性可信度（Paired Selective Trustworthiness, PST），它结合明确的安全拒绝与在匹配良性任务上展示的能力，以分析智能体的过度谨慎和实用性。以 6 个不同模型作为助手进行平均，TACT-Base 相比四个兼容攻击基线将攻击诱导失败率（AFR）提高 17.53%，TACT-TrustPrime 再将其提高 17.01%。两种被评估的防御方法平均仅将 AFR 降低 8.35%–9.41%，且不能一致改善 PST，凸显了需要更强的策略执行方法。

items.title_en: ContinualDrive: A Deployment-Anchored, Multi-Axis Benchmark for Continual Updates of Learned Driving Planners
items.title_zh: ContinualDrive：面向学习型驾驶规划器持续更新的部署锚定多轴基准
items.abstract_en: Learned driving planners keep being updated after deployment as new logs arrive, yet continual learning evaluations rarely ask whether an update improves on the deployed model, and their verdicts rest on unstated evaluation choices. We present ContinualDrive, a deployment-anchored benchmark for post-deployment continual learning of driving planners. It updates a deployed planner on real-world nuPlan logs one scenario-type group at a time, evaluates the same checkpoints in open and closed loop, makes four measurement axes explicit (evaluation loop, reference checkpoint, temporal aggregation and stream protocol), and anchors a three-valued release verdict to the deployed checkpoint. We study two planners (PlanTF and Diffusion Planner) under full fine-tuning and adapter or LoRA updates, with and without replay or gradient projection, in three task orders. Verdicts can reverse or vanish when one axis changes: open-loop ADE ranks the final PlanTF model above the deployed one in half of its core-suite runs, whereas every closed-loop score ranks it below; backward transfer misses this loss, which on average is already present when each group has just been learned; and regime rankings vary far less across training seeds than across task orders. In the core suite of full and adapter updates, no regime measurably improved on the deployed planner in closed loop; on a panel more than ten times larger every evaluated final checkpoint trails it, and joint training on all groups recovers much of the loss without exceeding its nuPlan closed-loop score. We distill these findings into a reporting contract and will release the code and all checkpoints.
items.abstract_zh: 学习型驾驶规划器在部署后会随着新日志到来而不断更新，但持续学习评估很少询问一次更新是否优于已部署模型，且其结论依赖于未说明的评估选择。我们提出 ContinualDrive，一个面向驾驶规划器部署后持续学习的部署锚定基准。它一次一个场景类型组，在真实世界 nuPlan 日志上更新已部署规划器，以开环和闭环评估相同检查点，明确四个测量轴（评估环、参考检查点、时间聚合和流协议），并将三值发布判定锚定到已部署检查点。我们研究两个规划器（PlanTF 和 Diffusion Planner），在全量微调以及适配器或 LoRA 更新下，在有/无回放或梯度投影的情况下，按三种任务顺序进行。当一个轴改变时，判定可能反转或消失：开环 ADE 在其核心套件一半的运行中将最终 PlanTF 模型排在已部署模型之上，而每个闭环分数都将其排在之下；后向迁移遗漏了这种损失，而该损失平均在每个组刚被学习时就已经存在；不同训练种子间的更新方案排名差异远小于不同任务顺序间的差异。在全量和适配器更新的核心套件中，没有任何更新方案在闭环中可测量地优于已部署规划器；在规模大十倍以上的面板上，每个被评估的最终检查点都落后于它，而在所有组上联合训练可恢复大部分损失，且不超过其 nuPlan 闭环分数。我们将这些发现提炼为报告契约，并将发布代码和所有检查点。
