items.title_en: DualSpec: Spectral Reconstruction with Optimized Stereo Cameras
items.title_zh: DualSpec：使用优化立体相机的光谱重建
items.abstract_en: Spectral imaging captures information that ordinary RGB sensors cannot, but dedicated spectral cameras can be expensive and bulky. Recovering dense spectra from RGB images offers an accessible alternative, but distinct spectra can produce the same camera response, generating an ambiguity that even more advanced recovery algorithms cannot always resolve. Therefore, increasing the spectral information captured at acquisition is essential. We propose DualSpec, a stereo acquisition framework that jointly optimizes two external optical filters and a reconstruction network. Each filter is placed in front of a standard RGB camera, and the two are designed to produce six responses that provide complementary information for the network. Experiments across reconstruction architectures and spectral ranges show that DualSpec reduces mean spectral angle error by 36-72% relative to a single RGB camera and by 11-29% relative to stereo pairs selected from commercial filters. Cross-dataset evaluations, including a new benchmark of spectral images captured from displaced viewpoints, show that the method generalizes and remains robust to viewpoint misalignment, while analyses of thin-film approximations support optical feasibility.
items.abstract_zh: 光谱成像可捕获普通RGB传感器无法捕获的信息，但专用光谱相机可能昂贵且笨重。从RGB图像恢复密集光谱提供了一种易获取的替代方案，但不同光谱可产生相同的相机响应，从而产生歧义，即使更先进的恢复算法也未必总能解决。因此，在采集时增加所捕获的光谱信息至关重要。我们提出DualSpec，一种立体采集框架，联合优化两个外部光学滤光片和重建网络。每个滤光片置于标准RGB相机前，二者被设计为产生六个响应，为网络提供互补信息。跨重建架构和光谱范围的实验表明，相对于单个RGB相机，DualSpec将平均光谱角误差降低36–72%；相对于从商用滤光片中选出的立体对，降低11–29%。跨数据集评估（包括从位移视点拍摄的光谱图像的新基准）表明该方法可泛化且对视角失配保持稳健，而薄膜近似分析支持光学可行性。

items.title_en: Navigating Gestational Health in the Reddit Pregnancy Community: A Mixed-Methods Study of Online Peer Discourse and Embodied Experience
items.title_zh: 在Reddit怀孕社区中探索妊娠健康：对在线同伴话语与具身经验的混合方法研究
items.abstract_en: Background: While health behaviours and clinical markers such as gestational weight gain GWG), physical activity, and nutrition are critical for optimizing maternal and fetal outcomes, pregnant individuals often face a fragmented informational landscape characterized by a heavy burden of clinical restrictions. Consequently, many turn to online, pseudo-anonymous communities like Reddit to crowdsource support, share experiences, and navigate complex health decisions outside the formal clinical encounter. This study aimed to examine how pregnant individuals utilize the Reddit community r/Pregnant to seek health-related information, navigate clinical recommendations surrounding GWG and health-related behaviours, and share lived experiences. Methods: An explanatory sequential mixed-methods study design was employed, combining computational topic modeling and qualitative analysis. In aim 1, all public posts published on the r/Pregnant subreddit between 2009 and 2024 were analyzed using BERTopic, a transformer-based modeling framework, to map the landscape of discourse and identify health-related topics. In aim 2, nine health-related topics were purposively selected, and 700 high-engagement posts (ranked by comment volume) across topics were analyzed using reflexive thematic analysis, following Braun and Clarke's six-phase framework. Results: BERTopic identified 90 distinct pregnancy-related topics across 15 years of discourse. Nine were health-related and selected for analysis, with gestational weight gain having the highest volume (Rank 14; 2,241 posts). Reflexive thematic analysis generated five overarching themes: (1) Reddit as a Site of Collective Sense-Making; (2) Decision-Making Under Uncertainty; (3) The Emotional Burden of Maternal Responsibility; (4) Embodied Knowledge in Practice; and (5) Social Pressure and Autonomy. Conclusions: A substantial gap exists between standardized prenatal clinical guidelines and the lived, physical reality of pregnancy. Pregnant individuals actively use digital peer support to adapt clinical advice, cope with weight-related stigma, and exercise autonomy. These findings highlight the importance of strengthening prenatal healthcare communication through more empathetic, non-judgmental, and individualized approaches that better reflect pregnant individuals concerns and lived experiences.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：虽然健康行为和临床标志物（如妊娠期体重增加（GWG）、身体活动和营养）对优化母婴结局至关重要，但孕妇常面临碎片化的信息环境，其特征是沉重的临床限制负担。因此，许多人转向Reddit等在线、伪匿名社区，以众包支持、分享经历，并在正式临床诊疗之外处理复杂的健康决策。本研究旨在考察孕妇如何利用Reddit社区r/Pregnant寻求健康相关信息、处理围绕GWG和健康相关行为的临床建议，并分享生活经验。方法：采用解释性序列混合方法研究设计，结合计算主题建模和定性分析。在目标1中，使用基于Transformer的建模框架BERTopic分析2009年至2024年间发布在r/Pregnant子版块的所有公开帖子，以绘制话语图景并识别健康相关主题。在目标2中，有目的性地选择九个健康相关主题，并使用反思性主题分析分析跨主题的700条高参与度帖子（按评论量排名），遵循Braun和Clarke的六阶段框架。结果：BERTopic在15年的话语中识别出90个不同的妊娠相关主题。其中九个与健康相关并选作分析，妊娠期体重增加的帖子量最高（排名第14；2,241条帖子）。反思性主题分析生成五个总体主题：（1）Reddit作为集体意义建构的场所；（2）不确定性下的决策；（3）母性责任的情感负担；（4）实践中的具身知识；（5）社会压力与自主性。结论：标准化产前临床指南与妊娠的真实、身体现实之间存在巨大差距。孕妇积极使用数字同伴支持来调整临床建议、应对与体重相关的污名并行使自主权。这些发现强调通过更具同理心、非评判性和个体化的方法加强产前医疗沟通的重要性，这些方法能更好地反映孕妇的关切和生活经验。

items.title_en: Class-resolved sifting for quantum key distribution with photon pairs hyperentangled in polarization and transverse spatial variables
items.title_zh: 用于偏振与横向空间变量超纠缠光子对量子密钥分发的类别分辨筛选
items.abstract_en: Photon pairs hyperentangled in polarization and transverse spatial variables can carry two key bits per pair in entanglement-based quantum key distribution. We develop class-resolved sifting for such sources: every detected pair is assigned to a class according to which degrees of freedom were measured in compatible bases, and error and key rates are estimated separately in each class. Applied to previously reported data from a two-crystal spontaneous parametric down-conversion source read out in intermediate fractional-Fourier planes, the method recovers the key yield of independent sifting and turns the comparison between classes into a quantitative consistency test for cross-dependencies between the two degrees of freedom. The measured dependence lies below the spatial-polarization coupling predicted for the source, at the edge of the present statistical sensitivity. Resolving the data by polarization-analyzer setting, we find an approximately twofold dependence of the spatial error on the polarization setting in one readout arm, attributable to the measurement apparatus rather than to the source and relevant to basis-dependent side channels. We compare the hyperentangled protocol with a single 4-dimensional system measured in two mutually unbiased bases. Fundamentally, both yield the same key per detected pair and obey the same entropic bound, but they differ in their tensor-product structure: hyperentanglement factors the bases into separate two-outcome measurements, which are simpler to implement and allow errors to be attributed to each degree of freedom, whereas a single variable gives access to non-product bases that can increase the noise tolerance. For the present source, whose polarization coherence is limited by partial which-crystal erasure, a single-variable spatial encoding would yield more key only if its four-outcome readout kept the symbol error within a few percent.
items.abstract_zh: 在偏振和横向空间变量上超纠缠的光子对，在基于纠缠的量子密钥分发中每对可携带两个密钥比特。我们针对此类源开发了类别分辨筛选（class-resolved sifting）：每个被探测到的光子对根据在兼容基中测量了哪些自由度而被分配到一个类别，并在每个类别中分别估计错误率和密钥率。将该方法应用于此前报道的、在中间分数傅里叶平面读出的双晶体自发参量下转换源数据，该方法恢复了独立筛选的密钥产额，并将类别之间的比较转化为对两个自由度之间交叉依赖的定量一致性检验。测得的依赖低于针对该源预测的空间-偏振耦合，处于当前统计灵敏度的边缘。按偏振分析器设置解析数据，我们发现在一个读出臂中，空间误差对偏振设置具有约两倍的依赖，这可归因于测量装置而非源，并与依赖基的侧信道相关。我们将该超纠缠协议与一个在两个相互无偏基中测量的单4维系统进行比较。从根本上说，两者每对探测光子对产生相同的密钥并遵守相同的熵界，但它们张量积结构不同：超纠缠将基分解为单独的二结果测量，这更易于实现，并允许将误差归因于每个自由度；而单一变量可访问非乘积基，从而可提高噪声容限。对于当前源，其偏振相干性受部分“哪一晶体”擦除限制，单变量空间编码只有在其四结果读出将符号误差保持在百分之几以内时才会产生更多密钥。

items.title_en: NCPU: Towards Cell-Inspired Spatial Computing
items.title_zh: NCPU：迈向受细胞启发的空间计算
items.abstract_en: Simple cellular automata (CAs) can be computationally universal, but their rules are designed by hand. We train Neural Cellular Automata (NCAs), which learn a local update rule by gradient descent, to compute exact digital logic. Bits are encoded as clusters of cells on a 2D grid, and a result reaches the output only by propagating through intermediate cells. One model is trained per task: logic gates, 4- and 8-bit ripple-carry adders, and a preliminary 8-bit arithmetic logic unit (ALU). All gate and adder models reach 100% bit correctness in 10 of 10 seeds, and exhaustive tests over all input pairs find at most 1 error in 256 (4-bit) and 7 in 65,536 (8-bit). Adders trained on operands of up to 3 bits generalize to 8 bits. The adders propagate the carry as a wave, with a delay of about 3.5 steps per bit of the carry chain. Outputs are correct only within the trained rollout length.
items.abstract_zh: 简单元胞自动机（CA）可以在计算上通用，但其规则由人工设计。我们训练神经元胞自动机（NCA），其通过梯度下降学习局部更新规则，以计算精确的数字逻辑。比特被编码为二维网格上的细胞簇，结果仅通过中间细胞传播到达输出。每个任务训练一个模型：逻辑门、4位和8位行波进位加法器，以及一个初步的8位算术逻辑单元（ALU）。所有门和加法器模型在10/10个种子中达到100%比特正确率；对所有输入对的穷举测试发现，最多在256个（4位）中有1个错误，在65,536个（8位）中有7个错误。在最多3位操作数上训练的加法器可泛化到8位。加法器以波的形式传播进位，进位链每位延迟约3.5步。输出仅在训练过的展开长度内正确。

items.title_en: Tablassert: Declarative Extraction of Knowledge Graphs from Biomedical Tables
items.title_zh: Tablassert：从生物医学表格中声明式提取知识图谱
items.abstract_en: Tables published in biomedical research papers, particularly supplemental tables, capture knowledge assertions that may not be in the main text of the manuscript for several reasons, including low statistical significance, space limitations, and narrative scope. These tables include data (e.g., association statistics, assay readouts, curated gene lists, and omics) encoding relationships between biological entities. Tablassert converts such tabular data (Excel, CSV, TSV, Parquet) into knowledge graphs ready for the NCATS Biomedical Data Translator (Fecho et al. 2025). A user declares in YAML how each table's data map to subject-predicate-object-qualifier statements; Tablassert resolves free text (e.g., ''lung cancer'') to standard identifiers, attaches provenance and statistics, and emits graph files conforming to Translator standards (D. Unni, Bruskiewich, and Moxon 2026; D. R. Unni et al. 2022).
items.abstract_zh: 生物医学研究论文中发表的表格，尤其是补充表格，捕获了可能未出现在稿件正文中的知识断言，原因包括统计显著性低、篇幅限制和叙述范围。这些表格包含编码生物实体之间关系的数据（例如关联统计量、测定读数、整理好的基因列表和组学数据）。Tablassert 将此类表格数据（Excel、CSV、TSV、Parquet）转换为可供 NCATS Biomedical Data Translator 使用的知识图谱（Fecho et al. 2025）。用户在 YAML 中声明每个表格的数据如何映射到主语-谓语-宾语-限定语陈述；Tablassert 将自由文本（例如“肺癌”）解析为标准标识符，附加来源和统计信息，并生成符合 Translator 标准的图文件（D. Unni, Bruskiewich, and Moxon 2026; D. R. Unni et al. 2022）。

items.title_en: Wind-Aware Trajectory Planning for Deformable Aerial Formations
items.title_zh: 可变形空中编队的风感知轨迹规划
items.abstract_en: Coordinated aerial transport in dense urban environments requires drone formations to navigate confined spaces and adapt to spatially varying winds around buildings. Formation deformation enables passage through narrow spaces but changes individual drone velocities and the local winds they encounter, coupling formation motion with aerodynamic effects. We propose Family-Air, a wind-aware trajectory-family planner that constructs a virtual tube as shared collision-free flight space and jointly optimizes formation-center motion, deformation, and timing. A shared affine transformation represents a continuous trajectory family, incorporating spatially varying wind and deformation-induced velocities into a unified air-relative motion objective. The optimization enforces virtual-tube containment, inter-drone separation, and kinematic feasibility. Simulations across four urban wind-field scenarios demonstrate the importance of local wind-deformation coupling. Flight simulations further show improvements in trajectory tracking accuracy. These results demonstrate the potential of wind-aware trajectory-family planning for coordinated aerial transport in complex urban environments.
items.abstract_zh: 在密集城市环境中进行协同空中运输，要求无人机编队穿越受限空间并适应建筑物周围空间变化的风。编队变形使得能够通过狭窄空间，但会改变单个无人机的速度及其遇到的局部风，从而将编队运动与气动效应耦合。我们提出 Family-Air，一种风感知轨迹族规划器，其构建虚拟管作为共享无碰撞飞行空间，并联合优化编队中心运动、变形和时序。共享仿射变换表示连续轨迹族，将空间变化风和变形诱导速度纳入统一的相对于空气的运动目标。该优化强制满足虚拟管约束、无人机间分离和运动学可行性。在四个城市风场场景中的仿真表明局部风-变形耦合的重要性。飞行仿真进一步显示轨迹跟踪精度的提升。这些结果展示了风感知轨迹族规划在复杂城市环境中协同空中运输的潜力。

items.title_en: Part-Set Prototypes for Explainable Mountain Gazelles Sex Classification
items.title_zh: 用于可解释山地瞪羚性别分类的部件集合原型（Part-Set Prototypes）
items.abstract_en: Self-explainable visual models for fine-grained recognition are often hindered by rigid geometric constraints that cannot capture diverse semantic shapes in unconstrained "in-the-wild" imagery. Real-world camera-trap data introduces challenges, including non-optimal poses, lighting variations, occlusions, animal camouflage, and environmental shortcuts. To address this, we introduce set prototypes, a general architecture where both part cardinality and unconstrained spatial layouts are mined directly from data. Our joint-matching formulation places parts simultaneously on a frozen DINOv3 token grid via truncated Sinkhorn competition, allowing unsupported parts to abstain without spatial collapse. We evaluate our approach on Mountain Gazelle sex classification, a camera-trap benchmark, where our model achieves 0.878 macro-F1--outperforming prior architectures and at par with an unconstrained linear probe. The strongest prototypes localize to distinctive biological areas such as horns, neck and body, allowing ecologists to visually verify decisions before trusting the metric. This formulation generalizes naturally to diverse ecological monitoring challenges beyond a single species.
items.abstract_zh: 用于细粒度识别的自解释视觉模型常常受到刚性几何约束的阻碍，这些约束无法捕捉无约束“野外”图像中多样的语义形状。真实世界的相机陷阱数据带来挑战，包括非最佳姿态、光照变化、遮挡、动物伪装和环境捷径。为解决这一问题，我们引入集合原型（set prototypes），一种通用架构，其中部件基数和无约束空间布局均直接从数据中挖掘。我们的联合匹配公式通过截断 Sinkhorn 竞争将部件同时放置在冻结的 DINOv3 token 网格上，使不受支持的部件能够弃权而不发生空间塌缩。我们在山地瞪羚性别分类这一相机陷阱基准上评估我们的方法，模型达到 0.878 macro-F1——优于先前架构，并与无约束线性探针持平。最强的原型定位到角、颈和身体等独特生物区域，使生态学家能够在信任指标之前可视化验证决策。该公式自然泛化到超越单一物种的多样生态监测挑战。

items.title_en: Spatiotemporal Dynamics of Vascular Wall Cells during Ductus Arteriosus Development and Closure
items.title_zh: 动脉导管发育与闭合过程中血管壁细胞的时空动态
items.abstract_en: Background: The transition from fetal to postnatal circulation requires closure of the ductus arteriosus (DA), involving smooth muscle cell contraction followed by anatomical remodeling. However, the spatial organization and developmental transcriptional dynamics of vascular wall cells during this transition remain poorly understood. Methods: We analyzed vascular morphology and spatial transcript profiles of the mouse DA and aorta at five stages from embryonic day 14.5 (E14.5) to postnatal day 2.5 (P2.5), enabling paired comparisons within tissue sections. Selected findings were compared with an independent mouse single-cell RNA-sequencing dataset. Histological and spatial transcript analyses were also performed on human DA tissue and the adjacent pulmonary artery. Results: The DA exhibited transiently higher cell-cycle-associated transcription across multiple vascular wall populations at E16.5, preceding medial thickening at E18.5 and postnatal luminal closure. Prenatally, DA mural cells exhibited greater contractile-associated gene expression than aortic mural cells. This difference diminished after birth, accompanied by a marked shift toward synthetic-like transcriptional programs associated with extracellular matrix remodeling and proteolysis. Ductal endothelial cells exhibited postnatal divergence from aortic endothelial cells in matrix- and adhesion-associated gene expression. Adventitial fibroblasts displayed distinct extracellular matrix- and insulin-like growth factor-associated expression profiles. In a human postnatal DA specimen, synthetic-like mural cells were enriched in regions of disrupted elastic lamellae and prominent collagen staining and shared selected remodeling-associated markers with postnatal mouse DA mural cells. Conclusions: DA development and closure involve temporally organized transcriptional changes across vascular wall populations, characterized by prenatal cell-cycle-associated activity and rapid postnatal reorganization of mural transcriptional programs. These findings provide a spatial framework for understanding vascular cell plasticity and multicellular remodeling during DA closure.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：从胎儿循环向出生后循环的转变需要动脉导管（DA）闭合，涉及平滑肌细胞收缩继而发生解剖学重塑。然而，这一转变过程中血管壁细胞的空间组织和发育转录动态仍知之甚少。方法：我们分析了小鼠 DA 和主动脉在从胚胎第14.5天（E14.5）到出生后第2.5天（P2.5）五个阶段的血管形态和空间转录谱，从而能够在组织切片内进行配对比较。选取的发现与一个独立的小鼠单细胞 RNA 测序数据集进行比较。还对人类 DA 组织及相邻肺动脉进行了组织学与空间转录分析。结果：在 E16.5，DA 在多个血管壁细胞群中表现出短暂更高的细胞周期相关转录，这先于 E18.5 的中膜增厚和出生后管腔闭合。产前，DA 壁细胞的收缩相关基因表达高于主动脉壁细胞。出生后这种差异减小，伴随明显转向与细胞外基质重塑和蛋白酶解相关的合成样转录程序。导管内皮细胞在出生后与主动脉内皮细胞在基质和黏附相关基因表达上出现分歧。外膜成纤维细胞显示出独特的细胞外基质和胰岛素样生长因子相关表达谱。在一份出生后人类 DA 标本中，合成样壁细胞富集于弹性板层破坏和胶原染色明显的区域，并与出生后小鼠 DA 壁细胞共享部分重塑相关标志物。结论：DA 发育和闭合涉及血管壁各细胞群中按时间组织的转录变化，其特征是产前细胞周期相关活动以及出生后壁细胞转录程序的快速重组织。这些发现为理解 DA 闭合过程中的血管细胞可塑性和多细胞重塑提供了空间框架。

items.title_en: Integrated lasing and dual-band gain in neodymium-implanted silicon nitride
items.title_zh: 钕注入氮化硅中的集成激光与双波段增益
items.abstract_en: Lasers at wavelengths near 1 micrometer are used in quantum technologies, precision metrology, and sensing. Rare-earth gain at these wavelengths in photonic integrated circuits can reduce the size and enable the scalable fabrication of these lasers. We fabricate neodymium-based integrated waveguide amplifiers and a ring laser using neodymium-implanted LPCVD silicon nitride. The photonic integrated circuits were fabricated on a 200 mm commercial wafer platform, and individual dies were implanted with neodymium ions. We show that the amplifiers provide gain in two bands around wavelengths of 920 nm and 1100 nm, and we show lasing in a ring resonator. This demonstrates that neodymium-implanted LPCVD silicon nitride is a suitable gain material for integrated lasers.
items.abstract_zh: 波长接近1微米的激光器用于量子技术、精密计量和传感。光子集成电路中这些波长的稀土增益可以减小这类激光器的尺寸并实现可规模化制造。我们使用钕注入的 LPCVD 氮化硅制造了基于钕的集成波导放大器和环形激光器。光子集成电路在200 mm 商用晶圆平台上制造，各个裸片注入钕离子。我们表明放大器在920 nm和1100 nm附近两个波段提供增益，并展示了环形谐振器中的激射。这证明钕注入的 LPCVD 氮化硅是集成激光器的合适增益材料。

items.title_en: Optimal Transport Meets t-SNE: Integrated Visualization without Batch Effects in OT-tSNE
items.title_zh: 最优传输遇见 t-SNE：OT-tSNE 中无批次效应的集成可视化
items.abstract_en: Visual exploration is an integral step in understanding the structure of datasets. However, systematic variation between datasets collected under different conditions, known as batch effects, can obscure shared structure and complicate their joint visualization. Existing methods often rely on cross-batch nearest-neighbor relations to integrate the batches. Yet, these local correspondences can be unreliable for challenging cross-batch geometries. We propose optimal-transport t-SNE (OT-tSNE), which replaces nearest-neighbor-based matching with globally coupled affinities derived from entropic optimal transport. Controlled synthetic experiments demonstrated that nearest-neighbor-based methods can deteriorate, while optimal-transport affinities and OT-tSNE embeddings remain robust. Across seven real single-cell datasets, we benchmarked OT-tSNE against a broad range of integration and visualization methods and found that it achieves a Pareto-efficient trade-off between batch mixing and biological conservation, and integrates batches particularly well.
items.abstract_zh: 可视化探索是理解数据集结构不可或缺的一步。然而，在不同条件下收集的数据集之间的系统性变异（称为批次效应）会遮蔽共享结构，并使其联合可视化复杂化。现有方法通常依赖跨批次最近邻关系来整合批次。然而，对于具有挑战性的跨批次几何结构，这些局部对应关系可能不可靠。我们提出最优传输 t-SNE（OT-tSNE），它用来自熵最优传输的全局耦合亲和度替代基于最近邻的匹配。受控合成实验表明，基于最近邻的方法可能退化，而最优传输亲和度和 OT-tSNE 嵌入保持稳健。在七个真实单细胞数据集上，我们将 OT-tSNE 与广泛的整合和可视化方法进行基准比较，发现它在批次混合和生物信息保留之间实现了帕累托有效权衡，并且对批次的整合尤其好。

items.title_en: SAG-Mem-1.0 Technical Report
items.title_zh: SAG-Mem-1.0 技术报告
items.abstract_en: Long-term conversational memory requires retrieving complementary facts scattered across dialogue sessions, including intermediate evidence with limited similarity to the original question. Existing approaches often rely on derived memory representations or persistent relational structures, introducing construction costs and potentially losing source details. We present SAG-Mem, a conversational memory framework that preserves complete dialogue messages in non-overlapping chunks and discovers complementary evidence through query-time lexical expansion. Memory construction requires no model inference, using a lexical index without LLM-based extraction, summarization, or semantic relation construction. At query time, BM25 retrieves initial candidates, an evidence evaluator identifies useful chunks, and lexical cues from selected evidence guide an additional retrieval round. Retrieved dialogue is further annotated with calendar interpretations of supported relative-time expressions, preserving the original wording and temporal granularity. We also introduce SAG-Mem-Lite, an alternative configuration that replaces evidence scoring with embedding-based candidate scoring, achieving lower operational cost than Full Context and all memory-based baselines across both benchmarks with low query latency. On LoCoMo and LongMemEval, SAG-Mem achieves overall scores of 83.08 and 80.20, respectively, the highest among the evaluated methods on both benchmarks. On LongMemEval, it exceeds the strongest compared baseline by 7.20 points. SAG-Mem-Lite achieves scores of 77.09 and 77.20, respectively. These results support dialogue preservation and evidence-guided retrieval expansion as an effective design for long-term conversational memory.
items.abstract_zh: 长期对话记忆需要检索分散在多个对话会话中的互补事实，包括与原始问题相似度有限的中间证据。现有方法通常依赖派生记忆表示或持久关系结构，引入构建成本并可能丢失源细节。我们提出 SAG-Mem，一种对话记忆框架，它将完整对话消息保存在不重叠块中，并通过查询时词汇扩展发现互补证据。记忆构建无需模型推理，使用词汇索引，不使用基于 LLM 的抽取、摘要或语义关系构建。在查询时，BM25 检索初始候选，证据评估器识别有用块，来自所选证据的词汇线索指导额外的检索轮次。检索到的对话进一步标注对受支持的相对时间表达的日历解释，保留原始措辞和时间粒度。我们还引入 SAG-Mem-Lite，一种替代配置，用基于嵌入的候选评分替代证据评分，在两个基准上其运行成本低于 Full Context 和所有基于记忆的基线，且查询延迟低。在 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval 上，SAG-Mem 分别取得 83.08 和 80.20 的总体得分，是两个基准上被评估方法中最高的。在 LongMemEval 上，它比最强对比基线高 7.20 分。SAG-Mem-Lite 分别取得 77.09 和 77.20 的得分。这些结果支持将对话保留和证据引导的检索扩展作为长期对话记忆的有效设计。

items.title_en: Ada-BFM: Adapting Behavior Foundation Models for Humanoid Scene Interaction
items.title_zh: Ada-BFM：将行为基础模型适配于人形机器人场景交互
items.abstract_en: Behavior Foundation Models (BFMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose humanoid control through pretraining on large-scale behavioral data. However, their proficiency in whole-body coordination does not readily extend to scene interaction, which requires adapting motion to scene-dependent geometric constraints and contact dynamics. To bridge this gap, we introduce Ada-BFM, a post-training framework that adapts pretrained BFMs for humanoid scene interaction. Ada-BFM augments the original architecture with a lightweight adapter, enabling interaction-specific adjustments while leveraging pretrained control capabilities. Rather than producing a separate controller for each task, the framework yields a shared model for each interaction domain, supporting diverse tasks involving terrain or object interaction. Extensive experiments in simulation and the real world demonstrate that Ada-BFM enables diverse scene interaction behaviors, accelerates learning compared with training from scratch, and largely preserves pretrained behavioral competence. These findings establish Ada-BFM as an effective and efficient approach to extending the capabilities of BFMs beyond their pretraining settings while retaining their strengths in general whole-body control.
items.abstract_zh: 行为基础模型（BFM）通过在大规模行为数据上预训练，已成为通用人形机器人控制的一种有前景的范式。然而，其在全身协调方面的能力并不能轻易扩展到场景交互，后者需要使运动适应依赖场景的几何约束和接触动力学。为弥合这一差距，我们引入 Ada-BFM，一种后训练框架，可将预训练 BFM 适配于人形机器人场景交互。Ada-BFM 通过轻量级适配器增强原始架构，在利用预训练控制能力的同时实现交互特定的调整。该框架并非为每个任务生成单独控制器，而是为每个交互域产生一个共享模型，支持涉及地形或物体交互的多样任务。在仿真和真实世界中的大量实验表明，Ada-BFM 能够实现多样的场景交互行为，相比从头训练加速学习，并在很大程度上保留预训练的行为能力。这些发现确立了 Ada-BFM 是一种有效且高效的方法，可将 BFM 的能力扩展到其预训练设置之外，同时保留其在通用全身控制方面的优势。

items.title_en: $ε$-Seg++: Ensembling Across Hierarchy and Training Time for Label-Efficient EM Segmentation
items.title_zh: $ε$-Seg++：面向标签高效EM分割的跨层级与跨训练时间集成
items.abstract_en: Semantic segmentation of electron microscopy (EM) volumes is a central step in quantitative cell biology, but dense voxel-wise annotation is prohibitively expensive. $ε$-Seg showed that a hierarchical variational autoencoder trained on sparsely annotated voxels can yield competitive segmentations, but it classifies from its topmost latent level only and operates exclusively on 2D patches. We introduce $ε$-Seg++, which places a semantic expert at every level of the hierarchy and consolidates their predictions with a parameter-free product of experts. We further enable 3D inputs through a leakage-free sub-volume splitting protocol, which allows 2D and 3D models to be compared under identical sparse supervision. Because validation labels are just as scarce as training labels, we treat checkpoint selection as part of the method and average the top-ranked checkpoints, a second ensemble, this time across training time. On the BetaSeg FIB-SEM dataset, the multi-level experts improve 2D mean Dice by about 0.1 at 2,500 training labels. With up to 600 training labels, the 2D model matches or exceeds 3D $ε$-Seg at about one eleventh of its prediction cost. Above roughly a thousand labels, 3D inputs dominate, and at matched annotation cost 3D $ε$-Seg++ reaches a mean Dice of 0.905 versus 0.880 for D3PM, while predicting between 5.4 and 27 times faster (with our checkpoint ensemble or a single model, respectively). Checkpoint ensembling matches single-best selection on average and markedly improves the worst case when the validation set is small.
items.abstract_zh: 电子显微镜（EM）体积的语义分割是定量细胞生物学的核心步骤，但密集的体素级标注成本过高。$ε$-Seg 表明，在稀疏标注体素上训练的分层变分自编码器能够产生有竞争力的分割，但它仅从最顶层潜在层进行分类，并且仅在2D图像块上运行。我们提出 $ε$-Seg++，在层级的每一级放置一个语义专家，并用无参数的专家乘积整合其预测。我们进一步通过无泄漏子体积拆分协议支持3D输入，从而使2D和3D模型可在相同的稀疏监督下进行比较。由于验证标签与训练标签同样稀缺，我们将检查点选择视为方法的一部分，并对排名靠前的检查点取平均，这是第二个集成，这次是跨训练时间。在BetaSeg FIB-SEM数据集上，多级专家在2,500个训练标签时将2D平均Dice提高约0.1。在最多600个训练标签时，2D模型以约其十一分之一的预测成本匹配或超过3D $ε$-Seg。超过约一千个标签时，3D输入占优；在匹配标注成本下，3D $ε$-Seg++达到0.905的平均Dice，而D3PM为0.880，同时预测速度快5.4至27倍（分别采用我们的检查点集成或单一模型）。检查点集成平均上与单最佳选择相当，并在验证集较小时显著改善最坏情况。

items.title_en: Archetypal analysis provides interpretable mixture representations of microbiome community structure
items.title_zh: 原型分析为微生物组群落结构提供可解释的混合表示
items.abstract_en: Microbiome studies routinely reduce high-dimensional community profiles to a small number of coordinates for visualization and comparison. Ordination methods are powerful for detecting compositional differences, but their axes are often difficult to translate into explicit microbial community configurations; conversely, hard clustering can impose discrete states on variation that is frequently continuous. Here we evaluate Archetypal Analysis (AA) as an intermediate representation in which each microbiome is expressed as a convex combination of a small number of data-supported extreme community profiles. Across three applications, AA recovered biologically recognizable structure while preserving graded variation among samples. In a multi-biospecimen human microbiome dataset, different sample-source categories occupied characteristic regions of archetype space, while stool samples were represented by heterogeneous mixtures of archetypal profiles. In an early-life gut microbiome dataset, archetype usage changed systematically with age, describing microbial succession as changing contributions from community endpoints. In domestic dogs spanning forager, agrarian, pastoralist, urban, and industrialized lifestyles, groups showed characteristic but non-discrete combinations of archetypes, supporting generality across host species and ecological contexts. Across the displayed K-sensitivity analyses, the principal sample-source and early-life organization remained recognizable as model resolution changed, while repeated initialization and resampling analyses recovered similar archetypal structure. Held-out samples projected onto fixed training-derived archetypes retained metadata-associated organization within each dataset. Bray-Curtis principal coordinates analysis recovered the same broad biological structure, indicating that the value of AA is interpretive rather than simply greater separation, while taxa prioritized by AA retained substantial predictive information relative to equally sized random taxon sets. Together, these results support AA as a complementary microbiome representation that connects low-dimensional sample coordinates directly to interpretable taxonomic profiles and provides a natural framework for describing ecological states, gradients, and transitions without hard cluster assignments.
items.abstract_zh: 微生物组研究通常将高维群落谱降至少数坐标，以便可视化和比较。排序方法在检测组成差异方面很有力，但其轴往往难以转化为明确的微生物群落配置；相反，硬聚类可能对常常是连续的变化施加离散状态。在此，我们评估原型分析（AA）作为一种中间表示，其中每个微生物组被表示为少量有数据支持的极端群落谱的凸组合。在三个应用中，AA恢复了生物学上可识别的结构，同时保留了样本间的渐变变异。在一个多生物样本人类微生物组数据集中，不同样本来源类别占据原型空间的 characteristic 区域，而粪便样本由原型谱的异质性混合表示。在一个生命早期肠道微生物组数据集中，原型使用随年龄系统性变化，将微生物演替描述为来自群落端点的贡献变化。在涵盖觅食、农耕、游牧、城市和工业化生活方式的家犬中，各组表现出特征性但非离散的原型组合，支持跨宿主物种和生态背景的普适性。在所展示的K敏感性分析中，随着模型分辨率变化，主要样本来源和生命早期组织仍可识别，而重复初始化和重采样分析恢复了相似的原型结构。将留出样本投影到固定的由训练得到的原型上，在每个数据集内保留了与元数据相关的组织。Bray-Curtis主坐标分析恢复了相同的广泛生物结构，表明AA的价值在于可解释性，而非仅仅是更大的分离度，同时AA优先选择的分类单元相对于同等大小的随机分类单元集合保留了大量预测信息。总之，这些结果支持AA作为一种补充性微生物组表示，它将低维样本坐标直接与可解释的分类学谱联系起来，并为描述生态状态、梯度和转变提供了无需硬聚类分配的自然框架。

items.title_en: Reducing RSA-2048 Factoring Resources Below One Billion Toffolis via LLM-Driven Verifiable Quantum Compilation
items.title_zh: 通过LLM驱动的可验证量子编译将RSA-2048分解资源降至十亿Toffoli门以下
items.abstract_en: Modular exponentiation dominates the logical cost of factoring 2048-bit RSA integers (RSA-2048) with Shor's algorithm. Recent approaches based on approximate residue number systems (RNS) sharply reduce the required logical qubits, yet still demand billions of Toffoli gates. Optimizing these circuits is difficult because shared ancilla qubits and measurement-based uncomputation tightly couple the arithmetic stages, while rare overflows in compressed registers occur too infrequently for random simulation to detect. Here we use large language model (LLM)-driven search to redesign the RNS pipeline across stages and build a deterministic compiler that produces a Pareto frontier of RSA-2048 circuits. We bound rare overflow probabilities analytically and verify the resulting elementary gate sequences across all constituent RNS primes on representative circuits. Relative to Gidney's 2025 baseline under matched adder accounting, our frontier cuts the minimum qubit-Toffoli product by 70.1% and lowers expected factoring Toffolis by up to 78.6% at matched accumulator precision, bringing RSA-2048 factoring below one billion Toffolis for the first time.
items.abstract_zh: 模幂运算主导了用Shor算法分解2048位RSA整数（RSA-2048）的逻辑成本。近期基于近似剩余数系统（RNS）的方法大幅减少了所需逻辑量子比特，但仍需要数十亿个Toffoli门。优化这些电路很困难，因为共享辅助量子比特和基于测量的反计算紧密耦合算术阶段，而压缩寄存器中的稀有溢出发生得过于稀少，随机模拟难以检测。在此，我们使用大语言模型（LLM）驱动的搜索跨阶段重新设计RNS流水线，并构建确定性编译器，生成RSA-2048电路的帕累托前沿。我们解析地界定稀有溢出概率，并在代表性电路上验证所有组成RNS素数上的所得基本门序列。相对于Gidney 2025基线在匹配加法器核算下，我们的前沿将最小量子比特-Toffoli乘积降低70.1%，并在匹配累加器精度下将预期分解Toffoli门数最多降低78.6%，首次将RSA-2048分解降至十亿个Toffoli门以下。

items.title_en: EEGJev: A System One Decision Model and Benchmark for Multi-Task EEG Question Answering
items.title_zh: EEGJev：面向多任务EEG问答的系统1决策模型与基准
items.abstract_en: A single electroencephalographic (EEG) recording can support multiple decoding tasks. Fixed-label tests cannot show how EEG foundation models handle changing questions or options. We introduce EEGJev, a fast decision model that scores candidate answers in one pass. Our benchmark, EEGJev-Bench, covers six question types across 19 public EEG sources. We held the recording and options fixed while switching between questions about attributes paired during training, such as facial expression and the hand participants were asked to use. Across 13 test sources, EEGJev selected a label for the requested attribute with 99.70% accuracy (49.20% under uniform choice). Balanced accuracy for the specific answer was 62.04%. Its 95th-percentile response time was shorter than NeuroLM's on matched validation questions answered individually. EEGJev lets users switch decoding targets by changing the question. With EEGJev-Bench, researchers can test whether new decoders follow the question more reliably, identify the correct answer more often, or both.
items.abstract_zh: 单次脑电图（EEG）记录可以支持多个解码任务。固定标签测试无法展示EEG基础模型如何处理变化的问题或选项。我们提出EEGJev，一种快速决策模型，一次即可对候选答案打分。我们的基准EEGJev-Bench涵盖19个公开EEG来源的六种问题类型。我们固定记录和选项，同时在关于训练中配对属性（例如面部表情和参与者被要求使用的手）的问题之间切换。在13个测试来源上，EEGJev为所请求属性选择标签的准确率为99.70%（均匀选择下为49.20%）。具体答案的平衡准确率为62.04%。其在单独回答的匹配验证问题上的第95百分位响应时间短于NeuroLM。EEGJev让用户通过改变问题来切换解码目标。借助EEGJev-Bench，研究人员可以测试新解码器是否更可靠地遵循问题、更经常识别正确答案，或两者兼有。

items.title_en: AIChipBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Automated AI Accelerator Design
items.title_zh: AIChipBench：面向自动化AI加速器设计的LLM智能体基准测试
items.abstract_en: A language-model decoder carries state between decoding steps, and in hardware a wrong state update can leave the current token correct and corrupt the output several tokens later, so a design can pass output tests and still be wrong. AIChipBench asks what LLM coding agents need to build such hardware correctly. Agents implement quantized Qwen3.5, Gemma 3, Gemma 4, and Llama 3.2 decoders in synthesizable register-transfer-level (RTL) code against an executable integer reference that specifies the outputs and the stored state at every decoding step. They debug against public tests under fixed budgets; their frozen designs are graded on held-out token sequences, resets, memory stalls, and synthesis, and a second track asks them to speed up a correct design at nearly fixed area. Across 9,136 attempts by four coding agents, the difficulty lies in stored state. Feedback that points to the first state mismatch raises acceptance over output-only feedback in all 12 agent--task cells of a matched study, by 25.0 to 46.9 percentage points, and halves the agent-hours per accepted design. Regraded on new sequences and conditions, 45 of 69 accepted designs fail within the 32 steps their tests required. More than a third of attempts to speed up a correct design end without one. An overall score ranks Sol 5.6 and Fable 5.1 above Astra 6 and Opus 5.5, and both halves of the instances give this order in all 200 random splits. Hardware agents therefore need debugging feedback that exposes stored state, and their benchmarks need final tests well beyond the development cases.
items.abstract_zh: 语言模型解码器在解码步骤之间携带状态，而在硬件中，错误的状态更新可能使当前词元保持正确，却在若干词元之后损坏输出，因此一个设计可以通过输出测试却仍然是错误的。AIChipBench追问LLM编码智能体需要什么才能正确构建此类硬件。智能体用可综合的寄存器传输级（RTL）代码实现量化的Qwen3.5、Gemma 3、Gemma 4和Llama 3.2解码器，对照一个可执行的整数参考模型，该参考模型规定每个解码步骤的输出和存储状态。他们在固定预算下针对公开测试进行调试；其冻结设计在留出词元序列、复位、存储器停顿和综合上进行评分，第二个赛道要求他们在面积几乎固定的情况下加速一个正确设计。在四个编码智能体的9,136次尝试中，难点在于存储状态。在一项匹配研究中，指向首次状态不匹配的反馈在全部12个智能体-任务单元中相对于仅输出反馈提高了接受率，提高25.0至46.9个百分点，并使每个被接受设计的智能体小时数减半。在新的序列和条件下重新评分时，69个被接受设计中有45个在其测试所要求的32步内失败。超过三分之一的加速正确设计的尝试最终未能得到正确设计。总体得分将Sol 5.6和Fable 5.1排在Astra 6和Opus 5.5之上，并且在全部200次随机划分中，实例的两个半部分都给出这一顺序。因此，硬件智能体需要能暴露存储状态的调试反馈，其基准测试也需要远超开发用例的最终测试。

items.title_en: NoveltyGate: Novelty, Not Error, Decides Which VLA Prefix Tokens to Compute Exactly
items.title_zh: NoveltyGate：新颖性而非误差决定哪些VLA前缀词元需精确计算
items.abstract_en: Flow-matching vision-language-action (VLA) models such as $π_{0.5}$ re-encode the camera images and the instruction with a 2B-parameter backbone at every control step, and the feed-forward layers of this prefix account for most of its compute. A natural way to save this compute is to send most tokens through a low-rank MLP and compute exactly only the tokens whose approximation error is large. We find that this intuition is wrong. Even a verifier that knows every token's exact error picks the wrong tokens, producing 1.3--1.7$\times$ larger action deviation than a simple test of whether a token's input is novel, that is, whether it falls outside the subspace seen during calibration. Large errors concentrate in tokens the policy relies on little, such as the third-person camera, while the novelty test favors the wrist camera, a view the action depends on heavily. We call this the error--reliance gap. Building on it, we propose NoveltyGate, a training-free method that routes each prefix token, once per layer and before any multiplication, to either a low-rank or the original MLP. Deciding once per layer instead of once per matrix product avoids moving wide intermediate tensors and keeps every shape static, so the whole prefix runs as a single CUDA graph. On LIBERO, NoveltyGate accelerates the $π_{0.5}$ prefix by up to 1.61$\times$, stays 2.7--2.9$\times$ closer to the original policy than channel pruning and low-rank compression at equal compute, and preserves closed-loop task success.
items.abstract_zh: 流匹配视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型（如 $π_{0.5}$）在每个控制步骤用20亿参数骨干网络重新编码相机图像和指令，而该前缀的前馈层占其计算量的大部分。节省这部分计算的一种自然方式是让大多数词元通过低秩MLP，仅对近似误差大的词元进行精确计算。我们发现这一直觉是错误的。即使验证器知道每个词元的精确误差，它也会选错词元，产生的动作偏差比简单检验词元输入是否新颖（即是否落在校准期间所见子空间之外）大1.3–1.7×。大误差集中在策略依赖较少的词元上，例如第三人称相机，而新颖性检验偏向腕部相机，这是动作高度依赖的视图。我们将此称为误差-依赖差距。基于此，我们提出NoveltyGate，一种免训练方法，每层一次、在任何乘法之前将每个前缀词元路由到低秩MLP或原始MLP。每层决定一次而不是每个矩阵乘积决定一次，避免移动宽中间张量并保持所有形状静态，因此整个前缀作为单个CUDA图运行。在LIBERO上，NoveltyGate将 $π_{0.5}$ 前缀加速最多1.61×，在同等计算量下与原始策略的接近程度比通道剪枝和低秩压缩高2.7–2.9×，并保持闭环任务成功率。

items.title_en: RoMo Hands: A Large Scale Richly Organized Text to Hand Motion Dataset
items.title_zh: RoMo Hands：一个大规模、组织丰富的文本到手部运动数据集
items.abstract_en: While text-driven body motion generation has matured, pure-hand synthesis remains bottlenecked by data. Existing datasets often treat hands as rigid end-effectors, lack fine-grained captions, or are too limited in scale to support robust generalization. We introduce RoMo Hands, an in-the-wild, text-paired dataset of ~542K sequences (884 hours, 95.5M frames at 30 fps) which is an order of magnitude larger than prior work. To ensure high-quality supervision, a stringent dexterity filter discards low-articulation sequences, focusing the distribution on complex bimanual movement. Each clip is paired with five captions at increasing granularities from global semantic tags to atomic finger states, organized under a hierarchical taxonomy. To bridge the gap between body and hand architectures, we propose a novel 393-D bimanual representation that adapts redundant body-motion paradigms to the high-DoF kinematics of hands. Systematic benchmarking of diffusion, masked-token, and autoregressive generators reveals distinct trade-offs under these hand-specific adaptations, including a sharp divergence between semantic alignment and kinematic plausibility. Our dataset, representation, and benchmark establish a rigorous foundation for the next generation of dexterous motion synthesis. Project page: https://romodataset.github.io/romo-hands/.
items.abstract_zh: 尽管文本驱动的身体运动生成已趋于成熟，纯手部合成仍受数据瓶颈制约。现有数据集通常将手视为刚性末端执行器、缺乏细粒度描述，或规模过小难以支持稳健泛化。我们提出RoMo Hands，一个野外采集、文本配对的数据集，包含约542K个序列（884小时，30 fps下9550万帧），规模比先前工作大一个数量级。为确保高质量监督，采用严格的灵巧性过滤器丢弃低关节活动度的序列，使分布聚焦于复杂双手运动。每个片段配对五条描述，粒度递增，从全局语义标签到原子手指状态，并组织在分层分类体系下。为弥合身体与手部架构之间的差距，我们提出一种新的393维双手表示，将冗余的身体运动范式适配到手部高自由度运动学。对扩散、掩码令牌和自回归生成器的系统基准测试揭示了在这些手部特定适配下的不同权衡，包括语义对齐与运动学合理性之间的显著分歧。我们的数据集、表示和基准为下一代灵巧运动合成奠定了严谨基础。项目页面：https://romodataset.github.io/romo-hands/。

items.title_en: Lattice models of chiral random motion: A short review
items.title_zh: 手性随机运动的晶格模型：简短综述
items.abstract_en: Chirality, a systematic rotational bias, is ubiquitous in many random motion patterns, from bacteria cells, that swim in circles near surfaces and spinning colloids, to charged particles diffusing under the influence of magnetic fields. In two dimensions, chirality renders random transport \textit{odd}: the diffusion tensor acquires an antisymmetric part that leaves the mean-squared displacement invariant but modifies fluxes and boundary currents. Lattice models for random motion are a natural setting to study chirality, since they are exactly solvable, connect directly to heterogeneous media, cellular automata, and programmable robots, and in discrete time admit fully chiral limits with a localised bulk and edge transport. Lattice walks with a rotational bias have been introduced in different communities several times since 1960, yet without a common language or conceptual connection between them. Here we review these models from the perspective that on the lattice, chirality requires memory. Taking the recently introduced chiral random walk model as a template, we describe the walker with an internal degree of freedom. With a chiral biased updating rule, the full diffusion tensor of this chiral walker turns odd. Within this picture, we can unite persistent and chiral walks, run-and-tumble motion, and cyclic random motions in one framework. We discuss how the memory is followed into the environment; in Lorentz lattice gases, kinetic and rotor walks, and random odd environments; and into the path; in spiral self-avoiding walks.
items.abstract_zh: 手性，即系统性旋转偏置，广泛存在于许多随机运动模式中，从在表面附近做圆周游动的细菌细胞和旋转胶体，到在磁场影响下扩散的带电粒子。在二维中，手性使随机输运变为奇的：扩散张量获得反对称部分，该部分保持均方位移不变，但改变通量和边界流。随机运动的晶格模型是研究手性的自然框架，因为它们可精确求解、直接联系到异质介质、元胞自动机和可编程机器人，并在离散时间中允许具有局域体输运和边缘输运的完全手性极限。自1960年以来，不同领域多次引入具有旋转偏置的晶格行走，但彼此之间缺乏共同语言或概念联系。本文从“在晶格上手性需要记忆”的视角综述这些模型。以最近引入的手性随机行走模型为模板，我们用内部自由度描述行走者。在手性偏置更新规则下，该手性行走者的完整扩散张量变为奇的。在这一图景中，我们可以将持续行走与手性行走、运行-翻滚运动以及循环随机运动统一在一个框架中。我们讨论记忆如何进入环境——在洛伦兹晶格气体、动力学行走和转子行走以及随机奇环境中——以及如何进入路径——在螺旋自回避行走中。

items.title_en: Floquet dark-mode manipulation in a three-mode optomechanical system
items.title_zh: 三模光机械系统中的Floquet暗模操控
items.abstract_en: We propose a Floquet sideband method to manipulate the dark-mode effect in a three-mode optomechanical system consisting of a single cavity mode coupled to two mechanical modes. We introduce a periodic frequency modulation for one mechanical mode to generate the Floquet sidebands, one of which is selected to match the resonance frequency of the other mechanical mode, allowing complete destructive interference to produce a mechanical dark mode decoupled from the cavity mode. The semiclassical operating point is determined self-consistently within the framework for linearization of optomechanical interaction, and the linear stability is examined under the rotating-wave approximation. We evaluate the validity of the approximate Hamiltonian by examining the fidelity between the states governed by the approximate and exact Hamiltonians. We further demonstrate dark-mode control by inspecting the bright/dark-mode populations of the system, when a frequency detuning is introduced suddenly. These results may provide a basis for further study of quantum-state storage using the Floquet mechanical dark modes.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种Floquet边带方法，用于操控三模光机械系统中的暗模效应，该系统由单个腔模耦合到两个机械模构成。我们对一个机械模引入周期性频率调制以产生Floquet边带，并选择其中一个边带与其他机械模的共振频率匹配，从而允许完全相消干涉以产生与腔模解耦的机械暗模。半经典工作点在光机械相互作用线性化的框架内自洽确定，并在旋转波近似下检验线性稳定性。我们通过考察近似哈密顿量和精确哈密顿量所支配状态之间的保真度，评估近似哈密顿量的有效性。我们进一步通过检查系统在突然引入频率失谐时的亮/暗模布居，展示暗模控制。这些结果可能为利用Floquet机械暗模进行量子态存储的进一步研究提供基础。

items.title_en: Shifter Quantization: Compact Representations for Native Integer Computation
items.title_zh: Shifter量化：原生整数计算的紧凑表示
items.abstract_en: Groupwise quantization is used in LLM quantization to improve accuracy at low bit widths, but grouping weights keeps standard integer MMA from spanning the full dot product for efficient GPU inference. We develop a new quantization method, Shifter Quantization (SQ), that reconstructs native-width integer operands by appending and shifting shared bits. To further extend the efficiency, we develop a special variant of SQ, Shifter Integer (SHI), to use INT4 kernels. We show that SQ and SHI formats perform better than standard groupwise quantization in quality, as measured by projection error and KL divergence, and in inference speed, as measured during decoding and prefill. For low precision like 2-bit quantization, SQ2 and SHI2 achieve 2.71-3.77x the 4,096-token prefill throughput of llama.cpp on a Q2_K checkpoint and reduce WikiText-2 KL by 6.6-7.8%. For mid precision like 4-bit quantization, SQ4 achieves 1.43-2.47x the prefill throughput of NInfer's groupwise-integer baselines across the tested models and prompt lengths, with 24-40% lower KL than the NInfer baselines. For high precision like 8-bit quantization, SQ8 achieves 27.4% higher batch-one prefill throughput and 72.7% lower KL than vLLM's online FP8.
items.abstract_zh: 分组量化在LLM量化中用于提高低比特宽度下的精度，但对权重分组使标准整数MMA无法覆盖完整点积以实现高效GPU推理。我们开发了一种新的量化方法——Shifter量化（SQ），通过追加和移位共享比特来重构原生宽度整数操作数。为进一步提升效率，我们开发了SQ的一种特殊变体——Shifter整数（SHI），以使用INT4内核。我们表明，SQ和SHI格式在质量（以投影误差和KL散度衡量）和推理速度（在解码和预填充期间测量）上均优于标准分组量化。对于2比特量化等低精度，SQ2和SHI2在Q2_K检查点上达到llama.cpp的4,096 token预填充吞吐量的2.71-3.77倍，并将WikiText-2 KL降低6.6-7.8%。对于4比特量化等中等精度，SQ4在测试模型和提示长度上达到NInfer分组整数基线的预填充吞吐量的1.43-2.47倍，且KL比NInfer基线低24-40%。对于8比特量化等高精度，SQ8相比vLLM的在线FP8实现批大小为1的预填充吞吐量高27.4%，KL低72.7%。

items.title_en: Towards Realistic Evaluation of Uncertainty Quantification for LLM-Based Recommender Systems
items.title_zh: 面向基于LLM的推荐系统不确定性量化的现实评估
items.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) provide a flexible interface for recommendation systems. However, their issued rankings require reliable instance-level uncertainty monitoring. In this scenario, comparing uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods becomes challenging because LLM rankers lack a standard item-classification head. Their scores may depend on option labels, prompts, generation procedures, and the available user and item evidence. Existing methods derive uncertainty from different sources and apply it at different stages of the recommendation process. Some methods evaluate an issued ranking, whereas others use uncertainty to change the ranking itself, making direct comparison difficult. Here we introduce a fixed-ranking benchmark which evaluates eight heterogeneous UQ signals as record-level monitors under a shared output contract. We evaluate these signals across four recommendation datasets and two LLM backbones under a shared fixed-ranking protocol. From the results, we draw three main observations. First, UQ method ordering changes across backbones even on the same reference instances. Second, ranking-aligned Top10Mass provides the strongest scalar Error@10 detection in several evaluation conditions, reflecting effective cutoff-aligned monitoring, while its advantage narrows for popularity-tail targets. Third, scalar UQ signals are weak at identifying which control has the larger clipped NDCG@10 difference, whereas source-specific signals, including Perturbation Rank Instability and simple listwise distances, provide stronger paired-control agreement, reflecting their sensitivity to the two controlled evidence sources. These findings motivate us to evaluate ranking-failure detection, robustness across recommendation conditions, and responses to controlled evidence changes as distinct properties of UQ.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）为推荐系统提供了灵活接口。然而，其给出的排序需要可靠的实例级不确定性监测。在此场景下，比较不确定性量化（UQ）方法变得具有挑战性，因为LLM排序器缺乏标准的物品分类头。其得分可能取决于选项标签、提示、生成过程以及可用的用户和物品证据。现有方法从不同来源导出不确定性，并将其应用于推荐过程的不同阶段。一些方法评估已给出的排序，而另一些方法使用不确定性改变排序本身，导致直接比较困难。本文引入一个固定排序基准，在共享输出契约下将八种异构UQ信号作为记录级监测器进行评估。我们在共享固定排序协议下，跨四个推荐数据集和两个LLM骨干评估这些信号。根据结果，我们得出三个主要观察。第一，即使在相同参考实例上，UQ方法排序也会随骨干变化。第二，与排序对齐的Top10Mass在若干评估条件下提供最强的标量Error@10检测，反映出有效的截断对齐监测，而其优势在流行度尾部目标上收窄。第三，标量UQ信号在识别哪个对照具有更大裁剪NDCG@10差异方面较弱，而来源特定信号——包括扰动排序不稳定性（Perturbation Rank Instability）和简单列表级距离——提供更强的成对对照一致性，反映出它们对两个受控证据来源的敏感性。这些发现促使我们将排序失败检测、跨推荐条件的鲁棒性以及对受控证据变化的响应作为UQ的不同属性进行评估。

items.title_en: One Policy, Many Bodies: Cooperative Human-Object Interaction with Heterogeneous Teams
items.title_zh: 一个策略，多种身体：异构团队中的人-物协作交互
items.abstract_en: Physics-based human-object interaction (HOI) has enabled multiple characters to cooperatively transport objects, but existing cooperative controllers largely assume homogeneous embodiments and predefined interaction tasks. We ask whether a single physics-based policy can enable cooperation across diverse embodiments, team compositions, and interaction skills. We present MorphHOI, a decentralised framework built on a key insight: effective heterogeneous cooperation requires a unified representation across embodiments while accounting for differences in their physical capabilities. To realise this insight, we introduce a canonical body interface that unifies observation and action spaces, together with an embodiment-conditioned transformer that adapts cooperative decisions to the physical capabilities of each agent and its teammates. To extend cooperation to new interaction skills, we reuse the learned cooperative policy through task-specific tokens and lightweight adaptation, preserving its original capabilities. Our framework achieves success rates of up to 96.7\% on seen embodiments, 95.6\% on unseen embodiments, and 91.4\% on novel payloads. Furthermore, the learned cooperation extends to diverse interaction skills with high success rates, including box carrying, transport on stairs, and waypoint following, while preserving previously acquired cooperative capabilities.
items.abstract_zh: 基于物理的人-物交互（HOI）已使多个角色能够协作搬运物体，但现有协作控制器大多假设同质具身和预定义交互任务。我们探究单一基于物理的策略能否在多样具身、团队组成和交互技能之间实现协作。我们提出MorphHOI，一个去中心化框架，基于一个关键洞见：有效的异构协作需要跨具身的统一表示，同时考虑其物理能力差异。为实现这一洞见，我们引入一个规范身体接口，统一观测空间和动作空间，并引入一个以具身为条件的Transformer，使协作决策适应每个智能体及其队友的物理能力。为将协作扩展到新的交互技能，我们通过任务特定token和轻量适配复用已学习的协作策略，同时保留其原始能力。我们的框架在已见具身上达到高达96.7%的成功率，在未见具身上达到95.6%，在新颖载荷上达到91.4%。此外，所学协作可扩展到多种交互技能并具有高成功率，包括搬箱子、在楼梯上运输和航点跟随，同时保留先前获得的协作能力。

items.title_en: SUPRA: Synthesizing Amyloid PET from MRI and Plasma Biomarkers with an Explicit Regional SUVR Prior
items.title_zh: SUPRA：利用显式区域SUVR先验从MRI和血浆生物标志物合成淀粉样蛋白PET
items.abstract_en: Amyloid positron emission tomography (PET) quantifies brain amyloid-$β$ as a standardized uptake value ratio (SUVR), but is costly and not widely available. Structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is routine, and plasma biomarkers such as phosphorylated tau 217 (p-tau217) are becoming practical. Synthesizing amyloid PET from MRI alone is ill-posed, because brain anatomy reveals little about amyloid burden. We present SUPRA (SUVR prior-guided amyloid synthesis), which divides this task between MRI and plasma biomarkers. A regression maps the plasma panel to regional SUVR levels, painted onto the subject's MRI segmentation as an explicit prior. A 3D network then adds a residual correction guided by MRI. The output is in absolute SUVR, and the model also runs on p-tau217 alone. On the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) cohort (111 test pairs), SUPRA reaches a peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of 23.4 dB, against at most 20.7 dB for four published models, and rank correlations of 0.56 to 0.67 with true SUVR in the composite cortex, an early-accumulation region and the striatum, against at most 0.24. In a second, cognitively unimpaired cohort with other plasma platforms (143 test pairs), it reaches 22.8 dB and 0.32 to 0.61, against at most 21.4 dB and 0.20. Its area under the curve for amyloid positivity is 0.91 and 0.82, against at most 0.63. Ablations show that plasma supplies the amyloid information and the network the image quality. Combining MRI with a blood test yields synthetic amyloid PET that is realistic and tracks burden across regions.
items.abstract_zh: 淀粉样蛋白正电子发射断层扫描（PET）以标准化摄取值比（SUVR）量化脑淀粉样蛋白-β，但成本高且不易广泛获得。结构磁共振成像（MRI）是常规检查，而磷酸化tau 217（p-tau217）等血浆生物标志物正变得实用。仅从MRI合成淀粉样蛋白PET是不适定的，因为脑解剖结构几乎不能揭示淀粉样蛋白负荷。我们提出SUPRA（SUVR先验引导的淀粉样蛋白合成），将这一任务分配给MRI和血浆生物标志物。一个回归模型将血浆指标组合映射为区域SUVR水平，并将其绘制到受试者的MRI分割上作为显式先验。随后一个3D网络加入由MRI引导的残差校正。输出为绝对SUVR值，该模型也可仅使用p-tau217运行。在阿尔茨海默病神经影像学倡议（ADNI）队列（111个测试对）上，SUPRA达到23.4 dB的峰值信噪比（PSNR），而四个已发表模型至多为20.7 dB；在复合皮层、一个早期蓄积区域和纹状体中，其与真实SUVR的秩相关为0.56至0.67，而对比模型至多为0.24。在第二个使用其他血浆平台的认知未受损队列（143个测试对）中，它达到22.8 dB和0.32至0.61，而对比模型至多为21.4 dB和0.20。其淀粉样蛋白阳性的曲线下面积（AUC）为0.91和0.82，而对比模型至多为0.63。消融实验表明，血浆提供淀粉样蛋白信息，网络提供图像质量。将MRI与血液检测结合可生成逼真的合成淀粉样蛋白PET，并追踪各区域的负荷。

items.title_en: A generative framework for unified representations bridging electrophysiological and haemodynamic brain activity
items.title_zh: 一种桥接电生理与血流动力学脑活动的统一表征生成框架
items.abstract_en: Electrophysiological and haemodynamic recordings resolve brain activity at complementary temporal and spatial scales, yet paired acquisition remains difficult to scale. We propose a generative framework that aligns paired multimodal recordings in a unified representation space and generates modality-specific haemodynamic responses from EEG. In paired cohorts, the framework generated fMRI BOLD and fNIRS haemoglobin responses that reproduced regional dynamics, cortical maps, functional connectivity and task structure. Generated BOLD followed Real BOLD time courses and cortical patterns, while Generated haemoglobin responses tracked task-evoked HbO and HbR dynamics. The framework enabled decoding across visual, motor-imagery and mental-arithmetic tasks, independent-record decoding, external BOLD localization and low-sample augmentation. Paired feature-space calibration supported bidirectional retrieval. The proposed framework extends cortical analysis and brain decoding to EEG recordings when Real haemodynamic data are sparse.
items.abstract_zh: 电生理和血流动力学记录在互补的时间与空间尺度上解析脑活动，但配对采集仍难以扩展。我们提出一个生成框架，该框架在统一表征空间中对齐配对的多模态记录，并从脑电图（EEG）生成模态特异性的血流动力学响应。在配对队列中，该框架生成的功能磁共振成像（fMRI）血氧水平依赖（BOLD）和功能性近红外光谱（fNIRS）血红蛋白响应，重现了区域动态、皮层图谱、功能连接和任务结构。生成的BOLD遵循真实BOLD的时间过程和皮层模式，生成的血红蛋白响应追踪任务诱发的HbO和HbR动态。该框架支持跨视觉、运动想象和心理算术任务的解码、独立记录解码、外部BOLD定位和低样本增强。配对特征空间校准支持双向检索。所提框架在真实血流动力学数据稀疏时，将皮层分析和脑解码扩展到EEG记录。

items.title_en: Dark and bright solitons in a multimodal lithium tantalate microresonator
items.title_zh: 多模态钽酸锂微谐振器中的暗孤子和亮孤子
items.abstract_en: Bright-soliton and dark-pulse microcombs provide complementary outputs. Integrating both states in a single resonator would expand the operating capabilities of an integrated coherent source, but requires opposite group-velocity-dispersion (GVD) channels while reconciling localized interfamily interaction for dark-pulse formation with spectral isolation for independent bright-soliton pumping. Wavelength-addressed access to both states is achieved in a LiTaO$_3$ microring through two TE-like transverse mode families. The higher-order TE$_{10}$ family fulfills two distinct roles in different spectral regions. Within localized avoided-mode-crossing regions, mode-resolved spectroscopy implicates TE$_{10}$ in perturbing the normal-GVD TE$_{00}$ resonance sequence. Away from these regions, TE$_{10}$ retains anomalous GVD and remains spectrally isolated as an independently pumpable bright-soliton channel; at representative pump resonances, the closest resonance of the non-addressed family is separated by 75--192 loaded cavity linewidths. With the input polarization held fixed, pumping TE$_{00}$ and TE$_{10}$ resonances generates dark-pulse and bright-soliton microcombs, respectively. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first experimental realization of a dark-pulse microcomb in an integrated LiTaO$_3$ microring. These results establish transverse-mode-family engineering as a route to combining localized modal interaction with independent spectral addressing in a single microresonator.
items.abstract_zh: 亮孤子与暗脉冲微梳提供互补输出。在单一谐振器中集成这两种状态将扩展集成相干源的工作能力，但需要相反群速度色散（GVD）的通道，同时要协调用于暗脉冲形成的局域族间相互作用与用于独立亮孤子泵浦的光谱隔离。在LiTaO3微环中，通过两个类TE横模模族实现了对两种状态的波长寻址访问。高阶TE10模族在不同光谱区域承担两种不同角色。在局域避免模式交叉区域内，模式分辨光谱表明TE10参与扰动正常GVD的TE00谐振序列。在这些区域之外，TE10保持反常GVD，并作为可独立泵浦的亮孤子通道保持光谱隔离；在代表性泵浦谐振处，非寻址模族最近的谐振相隔75--192个加载腔线宽。在输入偏振保持固定的情况下，泵浦TE00和TE10谐振分别产生暗脉冲微梳和亮孤子微梳。据我们所知，这是在集成LiTaO3微环中首次实验实现暗脉冲微梳。这些结果确立了横模模族工程作为一种在单一微谐振器中结合局域模式相互作用与独立光谱寻址的途径。

items.title_en: The Reliability Function of Error-Correcting Output Codes with Noisy Binary Classifiers
items.title_zh: 带噪声二分类器的纠错输出码的可靠性函数
items.abstract_en: Error-correcting output coding (ECOC) builds a multi-class classifier from binary classifiers. We study the excess error rate of ECOC over the Bayes (MAP) classifier when each binary classifier outputs a posterior estimate whose log-odds is corrupted by Gaussian noise. Recasting decoding as a test over a Gaussian channel, we derive an upper bound from the union and Chernoff bounds and a lower bound from the nearest competing category and the Mills ratio. The bounds show that a large Hamming distance is both necessary and sufficient for reducing the excess error rate. The excess error rate stays bounded away from zero, by a constant that depends on the two largest posteriors and the noise level but not on the number of categories $M$, whenever the distance between the code words of the two most probable categories is bounded; for equidistant codes this distance is $d_{\min}$. Conversely, it is at most $M-1$ times a factor that is exponentially small in the minimum distance $d_{\min}$, and it vanishes whenever $κ\,d_{\min}-\ln(M-1)\to\infty$ for an explicit $κ$ (for general codes, under a posterior condition). For $n$-vs-rest codes with $n\geq2$, the upper and lower exponents coincide asymptotically, which determines the reliability function of ECOC in closed form. The results extend to correlated Gaussian noise with the Hamming distance replaced by an effective distance; when noise is shared at the level of categories, the effective distance stays bounded and the excess error rate does not vanish for any code. All theorems are machine-checked in Lean 4. In a semi-synthetic setting, the measured decay agrees with the predicted exponent. On ResNet-50 features of CIFAR-10/100 and ImageNet-1k, the excess error over a log-likelihood decoding reference decreases with $d_{\min}$ and, for larger $M$, levels off at a moderate distance, while codes with $d_{\min}=1$ degrade as $M$ grows.
items.abstract_zh: 纠错输出编码（ECOC）由二分类器构建多类分类器。我们研究当每个二分类器输出的后验估计的对数几率被高斯噪声破坏时，ECOC相对于贝叶斯（MAP）分类器的超额错误率。将解码重新表述为高斯信道上的检验，我们从并集界和切尔诺夫界推导出上界，并从最近竞争类别和米尔斯比推导出下界。这些界表明，大的汉明距离对于降低超额错误率既是必要的也是充分的。当两个最可能类别的码字之间的距离有界时，超额错误率以一个常数远离零保持有界，该常数取决于两个最大后验和噪声水平，而不取决于类别数M；对于等距码，该距离为d_min。相反，它至多为M-1倍的一个因子，该因子在最小距离d_min上指数小；并且当κ d_min - ln(M-1) → ∞时它消失，其中κ为显式常数（对于一般码，在后验条件下）。对于n≥2的n对余码，上下指数渐近一致，从而以闭式确定了ECOC的可靠性函数。结果可推广到相关高斯噪声，其中汉明距离由有效距离替代；当噪声在类别层面共享时，有效距离保持有界，且对任何码超额错误率都不消失。所有定理均在Lean 4中经机器验证。在半合成设置中，测得的衰减与预测指数一致。在CIFAR-10/100和ImageNet-1k的ResNet-50特征上，相对于对数似然解码参考的超额误差随d_min增大而下降，并且对于较大的M，在中等距离处趋于平稳，而d_min=1的码随M增大而退化。

items.title_en: One Style Fits All? Cultural Values Embedded in Conversational AI via a People-Pleasing Lens
items.title_zh: 一种风格适合所有人？——从讨好倾向视角看对话式AI中嵌入的文化价值观
items.abstract_en: Conversational AI systems trained on large-scale web corpora inevitably encode the cultural values and interactional norms embedded in their training data, yet our understanding of how deployed LLMs reflect or reinforce culture-specific social expectations remains limited. This study examined how supportive versus challenging chatbot interaction styles shape user experience and continuance intention, and whether people-pleasing tendency (PPT) moderates these effects across cultures. Taiwanese (N = 49) and Korean (N = 52) participants completed a collaborative tourism-planning task. Results showed that: (1) supportive chatbots consistently led to higher continuance intention, satisfaction, and trust; (2) PPT did not moderate these effects; and (3) cultural variation emerged only in perceived threat, where higher PPT was associated with greater baseline threat in the Taiwanese but not the Korean sample. These findings reveal how a general-purpose LLM style may differentially activate culturally situated social scripts, raising implications for culturally inclusive conversational AI design.
items.abstract_zh: 在大规模网络语料上训练的对话式AI系统不可避免地编码其训练数据中嵌入的文化价值观和互动规范，然而我们对已部署大语言模型（LLM）如何反映或强化特定文化的社会期望仍知之甚少。本研究考察支持型与挑战型聊天机器人互动风格如何塑造用户体验和持续使用意愿，以及讨好倾向（PPT）是否在跨文化中调节这些效应。台湾（N = 49）和韩国（N = 52）参与者完成了一项协作旅游规划任务。结果表明：（1）支持型聊天机器人始终带来更高的持续使用意愿、满意度和信任；（2）PPT未调节这些效应；（3）文化差异仅出现在感知威胁上，其中较高的PPT与台湾样本中更高的基线威胁相关，而在韩国样本中并非如此。这些发现揭示了通用LLM风格如何差异性地激活文化情境化的社会脚本，并对文化包容性的对话式AI设计具有启示。

items.title_en: One Latent World for Heterogeneous LiDARs: A Scan Pattern Agnostic 4D World Model via Direct Ray Decoding
items.title_zh: 异构LiDAR的单一潜在世界：通过直接光线解码的扫描模式无关4D世界模型
items.abstract_en: LiDAR world models generate and predict metric 3D observations in the form of LiDAR scans. They typically synthesize scans following the scan pattern of their training sensor or render them from an intermediate 3D surface or field. However, following one scan pattern limits transfer to LiDARs with other patterns, and rendering from intermediate geometry can cause incorrect depths and false returns. In this paper, we propose a scan pattern agnostic 4D LiDAR world model that decouples the scene from sensor observation, so one spatial latent can be observed by heterogeneous LiDARs at the same mounting position without regeneration. Our decoder predicts the hit probability and depth of each ray directly from the latent, combining global scene context with local features retrieved at a preliminary depth. Without an intermediate surface or field, it reduces incorrect depths and false returns, and as each ray is decoded independently from one latent, LiDARs that share a ray receive the same return and observe one consistent scene. Finally, a diffusion transformer generates scenes in this latent and predicts 4D sequences from observed latents warped by the given ego and object motion. On KITTI-360 and nuScenes, our model generates realistic scenes and reduces the registration error between predicted frames by about 70% relative to the best compared world model. Its decoder yields 19 to 28% lower depth error than the rendering used by other world models, and generated scans benefit several downstream tasks. Our code will be open-sourced. More details are available at https://minwoo0611.github.io/OneLatentWorld.
items.abstract_zh: LiDAR世界模型以LiDAR扫描的形式生成并预测度量3D观测。它们通常按照训练传感器的扫描模式合成扫描，或从中间3D表面或场渲染扫描。然而，遵循单一扫描模式限制了对具有其他模式的LiDAR的迁移，而从中间几何渲染可能导致错误深度和虚假回波。本文提出一种扫描模式无关的4D LiDAR世界模型，将场景与传感器观测解耦，使得同一安装位置上的异构LiDAR可观测同一个空间潜在表示而无需重新生成。我们的解码器直接从潜在表示预测每条光线的命中概率和深度，将全局场景上下文与在初步深度处检索到的局部特征相结合。无需中间表面或场，它减少了错误深度和虚假回波；由于每条光线从同一潜在表示独立解码，共享同一条光线的LiDAR获得相同回波并观测到一致场景。最后，一个扩散Transformer在该潜在空间中生成场景，并根据经给定自车和物体运动变形的观测潜在表示预测4D序列。在KITTI-360和nuScenes上，我们的模型生成逼真场景，并相对于最佳对比世界模型将预测帧之间的配准误差降低约70%。其解码器相比其他世界模型所用渲染产生低19%至28%的深度误差，生成的扫描有利于若干下游任务。我们的代码将开源。更多细节见 https://minwoo0611.github.io/OneLatentWorld。

items.title_en: Linear Probes Can Guide: Training-Free Control of Representation Generators
items.title_zh: 线性探针可以引导：表示生成器的免训练控制
items.abstract_en: Representation-space generative models, such as Representation Autoencoders (RAEs), leverage pretrained vision foundation models (VFMs) primarily to accelerate training and improve sample fidelity. Yet VFMs are more than reconstruction tokenizers, as they feature rich representation spaces that are highly organized and linearly readable. We observe that this removes a key obstacle of post-hoc guidance: by linearity of expectation, a clean probe applied to an ideal denoiser's prediction yields the exact posterior mean of the probe scores at any noise level. This regime, which we call Semantic Mean-Space, turns semantic guidance into a Bayesian linear inverse problem, bypassing the need for training-time conditioning. With this foundation, we propose LiSM, a unified framework for Linear Guidance in Semantic Mean-Space. To validate the framework, we developed and adapted different solvers, and characterized them based on how they estimate probe-space uncertainty and propagate the correction through the representation. In addition, we propose Fit-Path, a solver designed to achieve strong global and local control. Our results in four control setups (class, attributes, foreground, and keypoints) show that LiSM methods, and Fit-Path in particular, provide effective, lightweight control across global and local tasks, outperforming noise-aware and pixel-space guidance.
items.abstract_zh: 表示空间生成模型，例如表示自编码器（RAEs），主要利用预训练视觉基础模型（VFMs）来加速训练并提高样本保真度。然而，VFMs 不仅仅是重建分词器，因为它们具有丰富、高度组织化且线性可读的表示空间。我们观察到，这消除了事后引导的一个关键障碍：根据期望的线性性，将干净的探针应用于理想去噪器的预测，在任何噪声水平下都能得到探针分数的精确后验均值。我们将这一情形称为语义均值空间（Semantic Mean-Space），它将语义引导转化为贝叶斯线性逆问题，从而绕过训练时条件化的需要。在此基础之上，我们提出 LiSM，一个用于语义均值空间中线性引导（Linear Guidance in Semantic Mean-Space）的统一框架。为验证该框架，我们开发并适配了不同的求解器，并根据它们如何估计探针空间不确定性以及如何通过表示传播校正来刻画它们。此外，我们提出 Fit-Path，一种旨在实现强全局和局部控制的求解器。我们在四种控制设置（类别、属性、前景和关键点）中的结果表明，LiSM 方法，尤其是 Fit-Path，在全局和局部任务上提供了有效、轻量的控制，优于噪声感知引导和像素空间引导。

items.title_en: When Can an AI Agent Serve as a Model of Human Psychopathology?
items.title_zh: AI 智能体何时能作为人类精神病理学的模型？
items.abstract_en: Language models and AI agents are increasingly described in psychiatric terms, such as anxious, depressed, addicted or helpless. A recent study even proposed language models as experimental systems for psychiatry and as a platform for piloting psychological treatments. We ask when an experiment on an AI agent can provide evidence about a specified human psychiatric process. A claim to such evidence has three parts. Something changed in the agent, and the agent's history caused the change. Nothing other than a process shared with people explains that change. The change matches one theory of the human process and not that theory's rivals. Psychiatry and its neighbouring fields have an evidence standard for each part, from the diagnostic manuals' rule for induced states, from clinical test scores and from animal models. We translate each standard into a criterion that a machine study can meet. For a language model the most critical alternative to a shared process is extrapolation from its training text, which already contains descriptions of how people respond to trauma and how they answer questionnaires. We show how to probe that alternative. Further, we audited forty-three published studies that apply psychiatric terms to a machine or induce a comparable state in one. Most compared the machine with an identical copy that had not gone through the history that induced the state. None excluded extrapolation from training text. Three tested a psychiatric theory against its rivals, and none of the three tests was conclusive. Until better evidence exists, a treatment pilot on a language model is best read as the model's forecast of patient response, and not as an experiment on a model organism. Evidence for a model organism will come from states induced by what happens to the machine, from experiments on its internal workings, and from tests on which rival theories disagree.
items.abstract_zh: 语言模型和 AI 智能体正越来越多地被用精神科术语描述，例如焦虑、抑郁、成瘾或无助。最近一项研究甚至提出将语言模型作为精神病学的实验系统，以及作为试点心理治疗的平台。我们追问：在什么情况下，对 AI 智能体进行的实验能够为某个特定的人类精神病理学过程提供证据。对此类证据的主张包含三个部分。智能体中某事物发生了变化，并且智能体的历史导致了该变化。除了与人类共享的过程之外，没有其他东西能解释该变化。该变化符合关于该人类过程的某一种理论，而不符合该理论的竞争理论。精神病学及其邻近领域对每个部分都有证据标准，这些标准来自诊断手册关于诱发状态的规定、临床测试分数以及动物模型。我们将每项标准转化为机器研究能够满足的判据。对于语言模型而言，与共享过程相比最关键的替代解释是从其训练文本中进行外推，而训练文本已经包含关于人们如何应对创伤以及如何回答问卷的描述。我们展示了如何探查这一替代解释。此外，我们审计了 43 项已发表研究，这些研究将精神科术语应用于机器或在机器中诱发可比状态。大多数研究将机器与一个相同副本进行比较，该副本未经历诱发该状态的历史。没有一项排除了从训练文本外推。三项研究用竞争理论检验了某一精神病学理论，且这三项检验均不具决定性。在存在更好的证据之前，对语言模型进行治疗试点最好被解读为模型对患者反应的预测，而不是对模式生物的实验。模式生物的证据将来自由机器所经历的事情诱发的状态、对其内部运作的实验，以及竞争理论存在分歧的检验。

items.title_en: Quantum-Memory Forensics for Tampered Quantum Seals: Resource-Dependent Sample Gains
items.title_zh: 被篡改量子封印的量子存储器取证：依赖资源的样本收益
items.abstract_en: Quantum seals reveal that an object was disturbed, but not where, with which tool, or when the tool changed. We study quantum-memory forensics for sealed items returning through an untrusted network where one tool opens many. Each seal cell is half of a Bell pair whose partner the verifier keeps in a protected quantum memory, a secret Pauli frame turns any attack into a Pauli channel, and a three-tier report localizes the tampering, learns a hidden-parity fingerprint of the tool and detects a tool switch in arrival order, not necessarily in attack order. Attribution concerns attackers who do not erase that fingerprint, which a random Pauli layer would do cheaply. Each result is stated within one of four verifier classes. For per-unit verifiers, which never couple two seal units and hold no untouched reference, the sample separation is asymptotically exponential, by reduction from a known lower bound for one parity of strength up to 1/3. On ten tampered cells it is proved to be at least \qnProvedUniformMin-fold against non-adaptive stabilizer probes and observed in simulation at \qnEoneRatioFine-fold. Against an implemented self-referencing strategy the simulated gain is about twice the inverse squared strength. The value also depends on the attack: destroying the untouched cells makes the reference necessary, whereas copying errors exposes the fingerprint to reference-free probes. We derive the vault's qubit inventory and simulate a seal requirement curve: ten times more seal noise lengthens the seal's lifetime \qnSealLifeGainFive-fold at \qnSealRhoFive{} times the attribution cost at $r=10$.
items.abstract_zh: 量子封印能够揭示某个物体受到了干扰，但不能揭示干扰发生在何处、使用了哪种工具，或工具何时被更换。我们研究密封物品通过不可信网络返回时的量子存储器取证，其中一种工具可以打开许多物品。每个封印单元是一对贝尔对的一半，验证者将另一半保存在受保护的量子存储器中；一个秘密的泡利框架（Pauli frame）将任何攻击转化为泡利信道；三级报告可定位篡改、学习工具的一个隐藏奇偶校验指纹，并按到达顺序（而不一定是攻击顺序）检测工具切换。归因关注的是不擦除该指纹的攻击者，而随机泡利层可以低成本地擦除该指纹。每个结果都在四类验证者之一中陈述。对于按单元验证者——它们从不会耦合两个封印单元，也不持有未受触碰的参考——样本分离渐近指数级，这是通过归约自一个已知下界得到的，该下界针对强度最高为 1/3 的一种奇偶校验。在十个被篡改单元上，证明其相对于非自适应稳定器探针至少为 \qnProvedUniformMin 倍，并在仿真中观测到 \qnEoneRatioFine 倍。针对一种已实现的自引用策略，仿真收益约为强度倒数平方的两倍。该值还取决于攻击：摧毁未受触碰的单元使参考成为必要，而复制错误则使指纹暴露给无参考探针。我们推导了该保管库的量子比特清单，并仿真了一条封印需求曲线：封印噪声增加十倍会使封印寿命延长 \qnSealLifeGainFive 倍，代价是在 $r=10$ 时归因成本为 \qnSealRhoFive{} 倍。

items.title_en: Joint Detection of Constructive Speech, Hate Speech and Agreement in Online Conversations
items.title_zh: 在线对话中建设性言论、仇恨言论与同意表达的联合检测
items.abstract_en: Online hate speech is an ever-growing issue with negative impacts on both groups and individuals, potentially causing users to withdraw from online conversations and debate. With some prominent social media platforms reducing their moderation efforts, constructive speech has emerged as an alternative strategy for countering hate. Automated detection of constructive and hateful speech can aid monitoring and improve understanding of their prevalence and online dynamics. In this work, we collect and annotate a large dataset of English and Danish social media comments for hateful tone, constructive tone, and agreement with parent comments. We fine-tune several multilingual LLMs to classify along these three dimensions and compare context-enriched and non-context-enriched model architectures. The E5-large LLM performs best on both the context-enriched (82% average F1) and non-context-enriched (81.6% average F1) classification tasks, demonstrating the potential of multilingual LLMs for scalable detection of hateful and constructive speech across languages.
items.abstract_zh: 在线仇恨言论是一个不断加剧的问题，对群体和个人都有负面影响，可能导致用户退出在线对话和辩论。随着一些知名社交媒体平台减少其审核力度，建设性言论已成为对抗仇恨的一种替代策略。自动检测建设性言论和仇恨言论有助于监测，并增进对其普遍性和在线动态的理解。在本工作中，我们收集并标注了一个大型数据集，包含英语和丹麦语社交媒体评论，并针对仇恨语气、建设性语气以及与父评论的同意程度进行标注。我们微调了若干多语言 LLM，以沿这三个维度进行分类，并比较了上下文增强与非上下文增强的模型架构。E5-large LLM 在上下文增强（平均 F1 82%）和非上下文增强（平均 F1 81.6%）分类任务上均表现最佳，展示了多语言 LLM 在跨语言可扩展检测仇恨言论和建设性言论方面的潜力。

items.title_en: EnvTrap: Revealing the Environment-Only Attack Surface in Embodied AI via Consequence-Blind Action Execution
items.title_zh: EnvTrap：通过后果盲动作执行揭示具身 AI 中仅环境攻击面
items.abstract_en: As AI models evolve from text and vision to physical agents, embodied AI faces a fundamentally different attack surface. Prior attacks on embodied systems have used crafted instructions, adversarial visual inputs, and training-time policy modifications; we study environment-only object rearrangements with unchanged models and instructions. We reveal an attack surface in safety-critical spatial relations among existing objects. An adversary who rearranges objects, without modifying instructions or accessing models, can cause hazardous consequences. In this work, we propose EnvTrap, a diagnostic pipeline that constructs paired safe, trap, and null-trap (benign but misleading) embodied scenarios. We demonstrate that environment-only perturbations raise hazardous-action rates to an average of 83.4% across the five evaluated action policies, with similar vulnerability patterns confirmed in world models. On a consequence-prediction task, model accuracy remains near chance, while human evaluators achieve high accuracy. We further propose a consequence-aware defense that reduces trap trigger rates by an average of 76.3 percentage points across action policies in simulation and by 62.9 percentage points pooled across physical backends. Together, these findings link environment-only attacks to a broader deficit in physical reasoning: embodied models recognize task-relevant objects yet fail to anticipate how spatial relations change the consequences of acting on them. EnvTrap makes this gap directly testable and turns hazardous layouts into training scenarios for safer embodied action. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/INKSIR/Envtrap.
items.abstract_zh: 随着 AI 模型从文本和视觉演进为物理智能体，具身 AI 面临着一个根本不同的攻击面。此前针对具身系统的攻击使用了精心设计的指令、对抗性视觉输入以及训练时的策略修改；我们研究在不改变模型和指令的情况下仅对环境中的物体进行重排。我们揭示了现有物体之间安全关键空间关系中的一个攻击面。攻击者在不修改指令或不访问模型的情况下重排物体，可以造成危险后果。在本工作中，我们提出 EnvTrap，一个诊断流程，用于构建成对的安全、陷阱和空陷阱（良性但具误导性）的具身场景。我们证明，仅环境扰动使五种被评估动作策略的危险动作率平均升至 83.4%，并在世界模型中确认了类似的脆弱性模式。在后果预测任务上，模型准确率仍接近随机水平，而人类评估者达到高准确率。我们进一步提出一种后果感知防御，在仿真中将各动作策略的陷阱触发率平均降低 76.3 个百分点，并在物理后端汇总降低 62.9 个百分点。总之，这些发现将仅环境攻击与更广泛的物理推理缺陷联系起来：具身模型能识别任务相关物体，却未能预判空间关系如何改变作用其上的后果。EnvTrap 使这一差距可直接检验，并将危险布局转化为训练场景，以促进更安全的具身动作。我们的代码和数据可在 https://github.com/INKSIR/Envtrap 获取。
